```dart
const List<String> standardProductCategories = [
  'Granit',
  'Kerama granit',
  'Kafel',
  'Marmar',
  'Tayyor mahsulot',
  'Xomashyo',
  'Qo‘shimcha',
];

class Product {
  final int id;
  final String name;
  final String?
      category; // Standart kategoriyalar: Granit, Kerama granit, Kafel, Marmar, Tayyor mahsulot, Xomashyo, Qo‘shimcha
  final String sku;
  final String qrCode;
  final String unit; // m2, dona, kg, m
  final double? donaM2; // faqat toshlar uchun (0.25)
  final double? thickness; // tosh qalinligi (sm, masalan: 2.0 sm)
  final double?
      tileLength; // kafel/keramogranit bo'yi (sm, masalan: 60 yoki 120 sm)
  final double? tileWidth; // kafel/keramogranit eni (sm, masalan: 60 sm)
  final int? boxPieces; // 1 pachkadagi donalar soni (masalan: 4 dona)
  final double? boxM2; // 1 pachka kvadrati (m2)
  final String? sort; // 1, 1.5, 2, 3, oliy
  final bool hasSorts; // 1, 1.5, 2 sortlari mavjudligi (kassada tanlanadi)
  final String?
      color; // rangi (masalan: Ko'k, Oq, Qora yoki vergul bilan ajratilgan)
  final double? priceSort1; // 1-sort narxi
  final double? priceSort1_5; // 1.5-sort narxi
  final double? priceSort2; // 2-sort narxi
  final double price; // bazaviy birlik narxi
  final double costPrice;
  final double stock;
  final double
      minStock; // kamida qancha bo'lishi kerak (ogohlantirish chegarasi)
  final String? imageUrl;

  const Product({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    this.category,
    this.sku = '',
    this.qrCode = '',
    required this.unit,
    this.donaM2,
    this.thickness,
    this.tileLength,
    this.tileWidth,
    this.boxPieces,
    this.boxM2,
    this.sort,
    this.hasSorts = false,
    this.color,
    this.priceSort1,
    this.priceSort1_5,
    this.priceSort2,
    required this.price,
    this.costPrice = 0,
    this.stock = 0,
    this.minStock = 15,
    this.imageUrl,
  });

  bool get hasDona => donaM2 != null && donaM2! > 0;
  bool get isTile =>
      category != null &&
      (category!.toLowerCase() == 'kafel' ||
          category!.toLowerCase() == 'kerama granit');
  bool get hasPachka =>
      (boxM2 != null && boxM2! > 0) ||
      (donaM2 != null && boxPieces != null && boxPieces! > 0);
  double? get effectiveBoxM2 =>
      boxM2 ??
      ((donaM2 != null && boxPieces != null && boxPieces! > 0)
          ? donaM2! * boxPieces!
          : null);

  List<String> get availableColors {
    if (color == null || color!.trim().isEmpty) return const [];
    return color!
        .split(RegExp(r'[,/•|]'))
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
  }

  bool get hasMultipleColors => availableColors.length > 1;

  /// Xizmatlar (kesish, silliqlash, faska, chizish) mahsulotlar katalogiga aralashmasligi uchun
  bool get isService => category?.trim().toLowerCase() == 'xizmat';

  double priceForSort(String? s) {
    if (s == '1' && priceSort1 != null && priceSort1! > 0) return priceSort1!;
    if (s == '1.5' && priceSort1_5 != null && priceSort1_5! > 0)
      return priceSort1_5!;
    if (s == '2' && priceSort2 != null && priceSort2! > 0) return priceSort2!;
    return price;
  }

  String get sortLabel {
    if (sort != null && sort!.isNotEmpty) {
      final s = sort!.trim();
      if (s.toLowerCase() == 'oliy') return 'Oliy sort';
      if (RegExp(r'^(1|1\.5|2|3)$').hasMatch(s)) return '$s-sort';
      return s;
    }
    if (color != null && color!.isNotEmpty) {
      return color!.trim();
    }
    final match =
        RegExp(r'\((1|1\.5|2|3|Oliy|oliy)[ -]sort\)', caseSensitive: false)
            .firstMatch(name);
    if (match != null) {
      final s = match.group(1)!;
      return s.toLowerCase() == 'oliy' ? 'Oliy sort' : '$s-sort';
    }
    if (hasSorts) {
      return '1 • 1.5 • 2 sort';
    }
    return '';
  }

  Product copyWith({
    int? id,
    String? name,
    String? category,
    String? sku,
    String? qrCode,
    String? unit,
    double? donaM2,
    double? thickness,
    double? tileLength,
    double? tileWidth,
    int? boxPieces,
    double? boxM2,
    String? sort,
    bool? hasSorts,
    String? color,
    double? priceSort1,
    double? priceSort1_5,
    double? priceSort2,
    double? price,
    double? costPrice,
    double? stock,
    double? minStock,
    String? imageUrl,
  }) =>
      Product(
        id: id ?? this.id,
        name: name ?? this.name,
        category: category ?? this.category,
        sku: sku ?? this.sku,
        qrCode: qrCode ?? this.qrCode,
        unit: unit ?? this.unit,
        donaM2: donaM2 ?? this.donaM2,
        thickness: thickness ?? this.thickness,
        tileLength: tileLength ?? this.tileLength,
        tileWidth: tileWidth ?? this.tileWidth,
        boxPieces: boxPieces ?? this.boxPieces,
        boxM2: boxM2 ?? this.boxM2,
        sort: sort ?? this.sort,
        hasSorts: hasSorts ?? this.hasSorts,
        color: color ?? this.color,
        priceSort1: priceSort1 ?? this.priceSort1,
        priceSort1_5: priceSort1_5 ?? this.priceSort1_5,
        priceSort2: priceSort2 ?? this.priceSort2,
        price: price ?? this.price,
        costPrice: costPrice ?? this.costPrice,
        stock: stock ?? this.stock,
        minStock: minStock ?? this.minStock,
        imageUrl: imageUrl ?? this.imageUrl,
      );

  factory Product.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => Product(
        id: (j['id'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
        name: (j['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        category: j['category']?.toString(),
        sku: (j['sku'] ?? '').toString(),
        qrCode: (j['qr_code'] ?? '').toString(),
        unit: (j['unit'] ?? 'm²').toString(),
        donaM2: j['dona_m2'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['dona_m2']),
        thickness: j['thickness'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['thickness']),
        tileLength:
            j['tile_length'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['tile_length']),
        tileWidth: j['tile_width'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['tile_width']),
        boxPieces: (j['box_pieces'] as num?)?.toInt(),
        boxM2: j['box_m2'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['box_m2']),
        sort: j['sort']?.toString(),
        hasSorts: j['has_sorts'] == true,
        color: j['color']?.toString(),
        priceSort1:
            j['price_sort1'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['price_sort1']),
        priceSort1_5:
            j['price_sort1_5'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['price_sort1_5']),
        priceSort2:
            j['price_sort2'] == null ? null : parseNum(j['price_sort2']),
        price: parseNum(j['price']),
        costPrice: parseNum(j['cost_price']),
        stock: parseNum(j['stock']),
        minStock: j['min_stock'] == null ? 15.0 : parseNum(j['min_stock']),
        imageUrl:
            (j['image_url'] != null && j['image_url'].toString().isNotEmpty)
                ? j['image_url'].toString()
                : null,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is Product && runtimeType == other.runtimeType && id == other.id;

  @override
  int get hashCode => id.hashCode;

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson({double initialStock = 0}) => {
        'name': name,
        'category': category,
        'sku': sku.isEmpty ? null : sku,
        'qr_code': qrCode.isEmpty ? null : qrCode,
        'unit': unit,
        'dona_m2': donaM2,
        'thickness': thickness,
        'tile_length': tileLength,
        'tile_width': tileWidth,
        'box_pieces': boxPieces,
        'box_m2': boxM2,
        'sort': sort,
        'has_sorts': hasSorts,
        'color': color,
        'price_sort1': priceSort1,
        'price_sort1_5': priceSort1_5,
        'price_sort2': priceSort2,
        'price': price,
        'cost_price': costPrice,
        'stock': stock,
        'min_stock': minStock,
        'initial_stock': initialStock,
        'image_url': imageUrl,
      };
}

class CartLine {
  final Product product;
  double quantity;
  bool inDona;
  bool inPachka; // Pachkada sotish (Kafel / Kerama granit)
  String? sort; // '1', '1.5', '2'
  String? color; // rangi (masalan: Ko'k, Oq, Qora)
  double? cutLength; // metrda
  double? cutWidth; // metrda
  double? cutThickness; // santimetrda (sm)
  int? cutPieces; // donasi
  String? cutSpec; // masalan: '1.2 × 0.6 m (2 sm, 5 dona)'
  double? unitPriceOverride;

  CartLine(
    this.product, {
    this.quantity = 1,
    this.inDona = false,
    this.inPachka = false,
    this.sort,
    this.color,
    this.cutLength,
    this.cutWidth,
    this.cutThickness,
    this.cutPieces,
    this.cutSpec,
    this.unitPriceOverride,
  }) {
    if (product.hasSorts && sort == null) {
      sort = '1.5';
    }
    if (color == null && product.availableColors.isNotEmpty) {
      color = product.availableColors.first;
    } else if (color == null &&
        product.color != null &&
        product.color!.isNotEmpty) {
      color = product.color;
    }
  }

  double get unitPrice => unitPriceOverride ?? product.priceForSort(sort);
  double get baseQty {
    if (inPachka && product.effectiveBoxM2 != null) {
      return quantity * product.effectiveBoxM2!;
    }
    if (inDona && product.hasDona) {
      return quantity * product.donaM2!;
    }
    return quantity;
  }

  double get lineTotal => baseQty * unitPrice;

  String get displayName {
    final col = (color != null &&
            color!.isNotEmpty &&
            !product.name.toLowerCase().contains(color!.toLowerCase()))
        ? ' ($color)'
        : '';
    final s = (sort != null && sort!.isNotEmpty) ? ' [$sort-sort]' : '';
    final c = (cutSpec != null && cutSpec!.isNotEmpty) ? ' [$cutSpec]' : '';
    return '${product.name}$col$s$c';
  }

  CartLine copy() => CartLine(
        product,
        quantity: quantity,
        inDona: inDona,
        inPachka: inPachka,
        sort: sort,
        color: color,
        cutLength: cutLength,
        cutWidth: cutWidth,
        cutThickness: cutThickness,
        cutPieces: cutPieces,
        cutSpec: cutSpec,
        unitPriceOverride: unitPriceOverride,
      );
}

class HeldCart {
  final String id;
  final String label;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final List<CartLine> lines;

  HeldCart({
    required this.id,
    required this.label,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.lines,
  });

  double get total => lines.fold(0, (a, l) => a + l.lineTotal);
  int get count => lines.length;
}

  SaleResult copyWith({

  final DateTime? deliveredTime;
  final String? note;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  final List<DeliveryItem> items;

  const Delivery({
    required this.id,

    this.driverPhone,
    required this.recipientName,

    this.destinationAddress,
    this.deliveryFee = 0,
    this.feePayer = 'customer',
    this.status = 'loading',
    this.dispatchTime,
    this.deliveredTime,
    this.note,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.items = const [],
  });

  bool get isLoading => status == 'loading';
  bool get isOnTheWay => status == 'on_the_way';
  bool get isDelivered => status == 'delivered';
  bool get isCancelled => status == 'cancelled';

  String get statusLabel {
    switch (status) {
      case 'on_the_way':
        return 'Yo‘lda';
      case 'delivered':
        return 'Yetkazildi';
      case 'cancelled':
        return 'Bekor qilingan';
      default:
        return 'Yuklanmoqda';
    }
  }

  String get feePayerLabel {
    switch (feePayer) {
      case 'store':
        return 'Do‘kon hisobidan (Bepul)';
      case 'included':
        return 'Narx ichida';
      default:
        return 'Mijoz to‘laydi';
    }
  }

  factory Delivery.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => Delivery(
        id: (j['id'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,

        deliveryFee: parseNum(j['delivery_fee']),

        status: (j['status'] ?? 'loading').toString(),
        dispatchTime: j['dispatch_time'] != null
            ? DateTime.tryParse(j['dispatch_time'].toString())
            : null,
        deliveredTime: j['delivered_time'] != null
            ? DateTime.tryParse(j['delivered_time'].toString())
            : null,
        note: j['note']?.toString(),
        createdAt: j['created_at'] != null
            ? DateTime.tryParse(j['created_at'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
            : DateTime.now(),
        items: (j['items'] as List<dynamic>?)
                ?.map((e) => DeliveryItem.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
                .toList() ??
            const [],
      );

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        if (id > 0) 'id': id,

        if (note != null) 'note': note,

  Delivery copyWith({

  }) =>
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import 'core/theme.dart';
import 'data/repositories.dart';
import 'data/repository_factory.dart';
import 'state/auth_controller.dart';
import 'state/cart_controller.dart';
import 'state/currency_controller.dart';
import 'state/theme_controller.dart';
import 'ui/home_shell.dart';
import 'ui/login_screen.dart';

void main() {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  final repos = buildRepositories();
  runApp(StonexApp(repos: repos));
}

class StonexApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const StonexApp({super.key, required this.repos});
  final AppRepositories repos;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MultiProvider(
      providers: [
        Provider<AppRepositories>.value(value: repos),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AuthController(repos.auth)),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => CartController(repos.sales)),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => CurrencyController()),
        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => ThemeController()),
      ],
      child: Consumer<ThemeController>(
        builder: (_, themeCtrl, __) => MaterialApp(
          title: 'NTM — Namuna Tosh Markazi',
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
          theme: buildTheme(Brightness.light),
          darkTheme: buildTheme(Brightness.dark),
          themeMode: themeCtrl.mode,
          home: Consumer<AuthController>(
            builder: (_, auth, __) {
              if (auth.loading && auth.user == null) {
                return const Scaffold(
                  backgroundColor: AppColors.panel,
                  body: Center(
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.neonLime),
                  ),
                );
              }
              return auth.user == null ? const LoginScreen() : HomeShell(user: auth.user!);
            },
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';

class AuthController extends ChangeNotifier {
  AuthController(this._repo) {
    tryRestoreSession();
  }
  final AuthRepository _repo;

  AppUser? user;
  bool loading = true;
  String? error;

  Future<void> tryRestoreSession() async {
    try {
      user = await _repo.tryRestoreSession();
    } catch (_) {}
    loading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> login(String username, String password, Role role) async {
    loading = true;
    error = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      // Rolni tanlash hech narsa bermaydi: server haqiqiy akkaunt va rolni tekshiradi.
      user = await _repo.login(username, password, role);
    } catch (e) {
      error = e.toString();
    }
    loading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    await _repo.logout();
    user = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';

class CartController extends ChangeNotifier {
  CartController(this._sales);
  final SalesRepository _sales;

  final List<CartLine> lines = [];
  final List<HeldCart> heldCarts = [];
  bool busy = false;

  double get total => lines.fold(0, (a, l) => a + l.lineTotal);

  void add(
    Product p, {
    double quantity = 1,
    String? sort,
    String? color,
    double? cutLength,
    double? cutWidth,
    double? cutThickness,
    int? cutPieces,
    String? cutSpec,
  }) {
    final effectiveSort = sort ?? (p.hasSorts ? '1.5' : (p.sort != null && p.sort!.isNotEmpty ? p.sort : null));
    final effectiveColor = color ?? (p.availableColors.isNotEmpty ? p.availableColors.first : p.color);
    final existing = lines.where((l) =>
        l.product.id == p.id &&
        l.sort == effectiveSort &&
        l.color == effectiveColor &&
        l.cutSpec == cutSpec);
    if (existing.isNotEmpty && cutSpec == null) {
      existing.first.quantity += quantity;
    } else {
      lines.add(CartLine(
        p,
        quantity: quantity,
        sort: effectiveSort,
        color: effectiveColor,
        cutLength: cutLength,
        cutWidth: cutWidth,
        cutThickness: cutThickness ?? p.thickness,
        cutPieces: cutPieces,
        cutSpec: cutSpec,
      ));
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void update(
    CartLine l, {
    double? quantity,
    bool? inDona,
    bool? inPachka,
    String? sort,
    String? color,
    double? cutLength,
    double? cutWidth,
    double? cutThickness,
    int? cutPieces,
    String? cutSpec,
    double? unitPriceOverride,
  }) {
    if (quantity != null && quantity > 0) l.quantity = quantity;
    if (inPachka != null) {
      l.inPachka = inPachka && l.product.hasPachka;
      if (l.inPachka) l.inDona = false;
    }
    if (inDona != null) {
      l.inDona = inDona && l.product.hasDona;
      if (l.inDona) l.inPachka = false;
    }
    if (sort != null) l.sort = sort;
    if (color != null) l.color = color;
    if (cutLength != null) l.cutLength = cutLength;
    if (cutWidth != null) l.cutWidth = cutWidth;
    if (cutThickness != null) l.cutThickness = cutThickness;
    if (cutPieces != null) l.cutPieces = cutPieces;
    if (cutSpec != null) l.cutSpec = cutSpec;
    if (unitPriceOverride != null) l.unitPriceOverride = unitPriceOverride;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void remove(CartLine l) {
    lines.remove(l);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clear() {
    lines.clear();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Joriy savatni kechiktirish (boshqa mijozga navbat berish uchun saqlab qo'yish)
  void holdCurrentCart({String? label}) {
    if (lines.isEmpty) return;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final timeStr = '${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    final defaultLabel = '${heldCarts.length + 1}-mijoz ($timeStr)';

    heldCarts.add(HeldCart(
      id: now.millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      label: (label != null && label.trim().isNotEmpty) ? label.trim() : defaultLabel,
      createdAt: now,
      lines: lines.map((l) => l.copy()).toList(),
    ));
    lines.clear();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Kechiktirilgan savatni qayta tiklash
  void restoreHeldCart(HeldCart cart) {
    if (!heldCarts.contains(cart)) return;

    // Agar kassa savatida tovarlar bo'lsa, uni avtomatik kechiktiramiz (swap)
    if (lines.isNotEmpty) {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final timeStr = '${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
      heldCarts.add(HeldCart(
        id: now.millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        label: '${heldCarts.length + 1}-mijoz ($timeStr)',
        createdAt: now,
        lines: lines.map((l) => l.copy()).toList(),
      ));
    }

    lines.clear();
    lines.addAll(cart.lines.map((l) => l.copy()));
    heldCarts.remove(cart);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Kechiktirilgan savatni o'chirish (mijoz qaytib kelmasa)
  void removeHeldCart(HeldCart cart) {
    heldCarts.remove(cart);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Muvaffaqiyatli bo'lsa savatni tozalaydi; xato bo'lsa savat saqlanadi va xato yuqoriga uzatiladi.
  Future<SaleResult> checkout({
    required double paid,
    double? currencyRate,
    double? paidUzs,
    double? paidUsd,
    String status = 'completed',
    String? note,
    int? customerId,
    String? customerName,
    String? customerPhone,
    String? customerPassport,
    String? customerPhotoUrl,
  }) async {
    busy = true;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final res = await _sales.createSale(
        lines: List.of(lines),
        paidAmount: paid,
        currencyRate: currencyRate,
        paidUzs: paidUzs,
        paidUsd: paidUsd,
        status: status,
        note: note,
        customerId: customerId,
        customerName: customerName,
        customerPhone: customerPhone,
        customerPassport: customerPassport,
        customerPhotoUrl: customerPhotoUrl,
      );
      lines.clear();
      return res;
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

import '../core/config.dart';

class CurrencyController extends ChangeNotifier {
  CurrencyController() {
    // Controller yaratilishi bilan internetdan yangi kursni oladi
    fetchLiveRate();
  }

  double _usdRate = 12023.0; // Standart boshlang'ich kurs
  double _cbuRate = 12023.0; // Markaziy bank kursi
  String _cbuDiff = '0.00';
  String _cbuDate = '';
  DateTime? _lastUpdated;
  bool _isLoading = false;
  bool _isCustom = false;
  String? _errorMessage;

  double get usdRate => _usdRate;
  double get cbuRate => _cbuRate;
  String get cbuDiff => _cbuDiff;
  String get cbuDate => _cbuDate;
  DateTime? get lastUpdated => _lastUpdated;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;
  bool get isCustom => _isCustom;
  String? get errorMessage => _errorMessage;

  /// So'mdan AQSH dollariga hisoblash
  double toUsd(double uzs) {
    if (_usdRate <= 0) return 0.0;
    return uzs / _usdRate;
  }

  /// AQSH dollaridan so'mga hisoblash
  double toUzs(double usd) {
    return usd * _usdRate;
  }

  /// Do'kon o'zining tijoriy kursini belgilashi (masalan $1 = 12 100 so'm)
  void setCustomRate(double customRate) {
    if (customRate <= 0) return;
    _usdRate = customRate;
    _isCustom = true;
    _lastUpdated = DateTime.now();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Do'kon kursini yana Markaziy Bank kursiga tenglashtirish
  void resetToCbuRate() {
    _usdRate = _cbuRate;
    _isCustom = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Markaziy Bankdan yoki server keshidan oxirgi kursni yangilash
  Future<void> fetchLiveRate() async {
    _isLoading = true;
    _errorMessage = null;
    notifyListeners();

    bool success = false;

    // 1. Birinchi navbatda backend server orqali tekshirish
    try {
      final backendUrl = Uri.parse('${AppConfig.apiBaseUrl}/finance/currency-rate');
      final resp = await http.get(backendUrl).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(resp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final rateVal = (data['rate'] as num?)?.toDouble();
        if (rateVal != null && rateVal > 0) {
          _cbuRate = rateVal;
          _cbuDiff = (data['diff'] ?? '').toString();
          _cbuDate = (data['date'] ?? '').toString();
          if (!_isCustom) {
            _usdRate = rateVal;
          }
          _lastUpdated = DateTime.now();
          success = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {
      // Backend mavjud bo'lmasa yoki timeout bo'lsa, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri CBU ochiq API sidan olamiz
    }

    // 2. Agar backend orqali olinmagan bo'lsa, CBU ochiq API sidan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olish
    if (!success) {
      try {
        final cbuUrl = Uri.parse('https://cbu.uz/uz/arkhiv-kursov-valyut/json/');
        final resp = await http.get(cbuUrl).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
        if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
          final list = jsonDecode(resp.body) as List<dynamic>;
          for (final item in list) {
            if (item is Map<String, dynamic> && item['Ccy'] == 'USD') {
              final rateVal = double.tryParse((item['Rate'] ?? '').toString()) ?? 12023.0;
              _cbuRate = rateVal;
              _cbuDiff = (item['Diff'] ?? '0.00').toString();
              _cbuDate = (item['Date'] ?? '').toString();
              if (!_isCustom) {
                _usdRate = rateVal;
              }
              _lastUpdated = DateTime.now();
              success = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        _errorMessage = 'Internetdan kursni yangilab bo‘lmadi';
      }
    }

    _isLoading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class ThemeController extends ChangeNotifier {
  ThemeMode _mode = ThemeMode.light;

  ThemeMode get mode => _mode;
  bool get isDark => _mode == ThemeMode.dark;

  void setMode(ThemeMode mode) {
    if (_mode != mode) {
      _mode = mode;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void toggle() {
    _mode = isDark ? ThemeMode.light : ThemeMode.dark;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:camera/camera.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

import '../core/theme.dart';

/// Windows va Mobil qurilmalarda mijoz yoki pasport suratini olish uchun qulay dialog.
class CameraCaptureDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CameraCaptureDialog({super.key});

  @override
  State<CameraCaptureDialog> createState() => _CameraCaptureDialogState();
}

class _CameraCaptureDialogState extends State<CameraCaptureDialog> {
  CameraController? _controller;
  List<CameraDescription> _cameras = [];
  bool _initializing = true;
  bool _hasCamera = false;
  Uint8List? _capturedBytes;
  bool _capturing = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initCamera();
  }

  Future<void> _initCamera() async {
    try {
      _cameras = await availableCameras();
      if (_cameras.isNotEmpty) {
        final ctrl = CameraController(
          _cameras.first,
          ResolutionPreset.medium,
          enableAudio: false,
          imageFormatGroup: ImageFormatGroup.jpeg,
        );
        _controller = ctrl;
        await ctrl.initialize();
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _hasCamera = true;
            _initializing = false;
          });
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _hasCamera = false;
            _initializing = false;
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _hasCamera = false;
          _initializing = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _takePicture() async {
    if (_controller == null || !_controller!.value.isInitialized || _capturing) return;
    setState(() => _capturing = true);
    try {
      final xFile = await _controller!.takePicture();
      final bytes = await xFile.readAsBytes();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _capturedBytes = bytes;
          _capturing = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Suratga olishda xatolik: $e';
          _capturing = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickFromFile() async {
    try {
      final picker = ImagePicker();
      final picked = await picker.pickImage(
        source: ImageSource.gallery,
        maxWidth: 1200,
        maxHeight: 1200,
        imageQuality: 82,
      );
      if (picked != null) {
        final bytes = await picked.readAsBytes();
        if (mounted && bytes.isNotEmpty) {
          Navigator.pop(context, bytes);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _error = 'Fayl tanlashda xatolik: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      child: Container(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 440),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // Sarlavha va yopish
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_rounded, size: 20),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Text(
                  'Suratga olish',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 17),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Kamera / Rasm qismi
            Container(
              height: 280,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
              ),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: _buildCameraBody(),
            ),

            if (_error != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Text(
                _error!,
                style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            ],

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Boshqaruv tugmalari
            if (_capturedBytes != null) ...[
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () => setState(() => _capturedBytes = null),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Qayta olish'),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, _capturedBytes),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Tasdiqlash'),
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime,
                        foregroundColor: AppColors.ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ] else if (_hasCamera) ...[
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _pickFromFile,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_outlined, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Fayldan tanlash'),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _capturing ? null : _takePicture,
                      icon: _capturing
                          ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                          : const Icon(Icons.camera_alt_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Suratga olish'),
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: AppColors.darkCard,
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ] else ...[
              FilledButton.icon(
                onPressed: _pickFromFile,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_rounded, size: 18),
                label: const Text('Kompyuterdan fayl tanlash'),
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppColors.darkCard,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCameraBody() {
    if (_capturedBytes != null) {
      return Image.memory(
        _capturedBytes!,
        fit: BoxFit.contain,
      );
    }

    if (_initializing) {
      return const Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: AppColors.neonLime),
            SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text('Kamera ishga tushirilmoqda...', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 13)),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    if (!_hasCamera || _controller == null || !_controller!.value.isInitialized) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.videocam_off_rounded, size: 48, color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              const Text(
                'Veb-kamera topilmadi',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 15),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              const Text(
                'Kompyuteringizdan rasm faylini tanlashingiz mumkin',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 12),
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Stack(
      fit: StackFit.expand,
      children: [
        CameraPreview(_controller!),
        Positioned(
          bottom: 12,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          child: Center(
            child: Material(
              color: Colors.white,
              shape: const CircleBorder(),
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: _capturing ? null : _takePicture,
                customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                child: const Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  child: Icon(Icons.camera_rounded, color: AppColors.ink, size: 28),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Windows yoki Mobil qurilmalarda xavfsiz rasm olish/tanlash funksiyasi
Future<Uint8List?> pickOrCaptureCustomerImage(BuildContext context, ImageSource source) async {
  if (source == ImageSource.camera && Platform.isWindows) {
    return showDialog<Uint8List?>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: true,
      builder: (_) => const CameraCaptureDialog(),
    );
  }

  try {
    final picker = ImagePicker();
    final picked = await picker.pickImage(
      source: source,
      maxWidth: 1200,
      maxHeight: 1200,
      imageQuality: 82,
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      return await picked.readAsBytes();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    if (source == ImageSource.camera && context.mounted) {
      return showDialog<Uint8List?>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (_) => const CameraCaptureDialog(),
      );
    }
  }
  return null;
}
```

```dart
/// Mahsulot rasmi yoki rasmi yo'q bo'lsa zamonaviy default mahsulot belgisi
class ProductThumbnail extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProductThumbnail({
    super.key,
    this.imageUrl,
    required this.name,
    this.size = 42,
    this.width,
    this.height,
    this.borderRadius = 12,
    this.borderRadiusGeometry,
    this.fit = BoxFit.cover,
  });

  final String? imageUrl;
  final String name;
  final double size;
  final double? width;
  final double? height;
  final double borderRadius;
  final BorderRadiusGeometry? borderRadiusGeometry;
  final BoxFit fit;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final w = width ?? size;
    final h = height ?? size;
    final r = borderRadiusGeometry ?? BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius);

    Widget fallbackAvatar() => Container(
          width: w,
          height: h,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E2822) : AppColors.neonLimeSoft,
            borderRadius: r,
            border: Border.all(
              color: context.borderColor,
              width: 0.8,
            ),
          ),
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          child: Icon(
            Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
            color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink,
            size: (w < h ? w : h) * 0.45,
          ),
        );

    final raw = imageUrl?.trim() ?? '';
    if (raw.isEmpty) {
      return fallbackAvatar();
    }

    Widget imageWidget;
    try {
      if (raw.startsWith('data:image/') || raw.contains(';base64,')) {
        // Base64 Data URI
        final comma = raw.indexOf(',');
        final b64 = comma != -1 ? raw.substring(comma + 1).trim() : raw;
        final bytes = base64Decode(b64);
        imageWidget = Image.memory(
          Uint8List.fromList(bytes),
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fit: fit,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallbackAvatar(),
        );
      } else if (!raw.startsWith('http://') &&
          !raw.startsWith('https://') &&
          !raw.startsWith('/') &&
          File(raw).existsSync()) {
        // Mahalliy kompyuter / telefon fayl yo'li
        imageWidget = Image.file(
          File(raw),
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fit: fit,
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallbackAvatar(),
        );
      } else {
        // Server URL
        final resolvedUrl = ApiClient.resolveUrl(raw);
        imageWidget = Image.network(
          resolvedUrl,
          width: w,
          height: h,
          fit: fit,
          loadingBuilder: (context, child, loadingProgress) {
            if (loadingProgress == null) return child;
            return const Center(
              child: SizedBox(
                width: 24,
                height: 24,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
              ),
            );
          },
          errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => fallbackAvatar(),
        );
      }
    } catch (_) {
      return fallbackAvatar();
    }

    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: r,
      child: Container(
        width: w,
        height: h,
        color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E2822) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
        child: imageWidget,
      ),
    );
  }
}

Color getStoneColor(String? colorName) {
  if (colorName == null) return Colors.grey;
  final c = colorName.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (c.contains('qora') || c.contains('black') || c.contains('dark')) return const Color(0xFF1E293B);
  if (c.contains('oq') || c.contains('white')) return const Color(0xFFF1F5F9);
  if (c.contains('ko‘k') || c.contains("ko'k") || c.contains('kok') || c.contains('blue')) return const Color(0xFF2563EB);
  if (c.contains('kulrang') || c.contains('grey') || c.contains('gray')) return const Color(0xFF64748B);
  if (c.contains('bej') || c.contains('beige') || c.contains('krem')) return const Color(0xFFD4B996);
  if (c.contains('yashil') || c.contains('green')) return const Color(0xFF10B981);
  if (c.contains('qizil') || c.contains('red')) return const Color(0xFFEF4444);
  if (c.contains('jigarrang') || c.contains('brown')) return const Color(0xFF854D0E);
  if (c.contains('sariq') || c.contains('yellow')) return const Color(0xFFF59E0B);
  return const Color(0xFF64748B);
}

class StoneColorBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  const StoneColorBadge({super.key, required this.colorName, this.fontSize = 10});
  final String colorName;
  final double fontSize;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final dotColor = getStoneColor(colorName);
    final isWhite = dotColor.value == const Color(0xFFF1F5F9).value;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF21262D) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 8,
            height: 8,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: dotColor,
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(
                color: isWhite ? Colors.grey : dotColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                width: 1,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
          Text(
            colorName,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: fontSize,
```

```dart
/// Kursni ko'rish, Markaziy Bankdan yangilash yoki o'zgartirish dialogi
Future<void> showCurrencyDialog(BuildContext context) {
  return showDialog<void>(
    context: context,
    builder: (ctx) => const _CurrencySettingsDialog(),
  );
}

class _CurrencySettingsDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _CurrencySettingsDialog();

  @override
  State<_CurrencySettingsDialog> createState() => _CurrencySettingsDialogState();
}

class _CurrencySettingsDialogState extends State<_CurrencySettingsDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _customRateCtrl;
  bool _useCustom = false;
  double _calcUsd = 100;
  double _calcUzs = 1000000;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final currency = context.read<CurrencyController>();
    _useCustom = currency.isCustom;
    _customRateCtrl = TextEditingController(text: currency.usdRate.round().toString());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _customRateCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final currency = context.watch<CurrencyController>();
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),

              color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.15),

              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                const Text(
                  'Valyuta kursi (USD / UZS)',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                ),
                Text(
                  'Markaziy Bank kursi va do‘kon narxlari',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.mutedColor),

              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 440,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // 1. Markaziy Bank (CBU) Rasmiy Kursi Kartochkasi
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1C222B) : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF2C3340) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),

                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          '🇺🇿 O‘zbekiston Markaziy Banki (CBU)',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                        ),
                        const Spacer(),
                        if (currency.isLoading)
                          const SizedBox(
                            width: 14,
                            height: 14,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Color(0xFF10B981)),
                          )
                        else
                          InkWell(
                            onTap: () => currency.fetchLiveRate(),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            child: const Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 14, color: Color(0xFF10B981)),
                                  SizedBox(width: 4),
                                  Text(
                                    'Yangilash',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                      textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          '1 USD = ',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: AppColors.muted),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          money(currency.cbuRate),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 22,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        if (currency.cbuDiff.isNotEmpty && currency.cbuDiff != '0.00')
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: currency.cbuDiff.startsWith('-')
                                  ? const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.12)
                                  : const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.12),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              currency.cbuDiff,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: currency.cbuDiff.startsWith('-')
                                    ? const Color(0xFFEF4444)
                                    : const Color(0xFF10B981),

                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    if (currency.cbuDate.isNotEmpty) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        'Rasmiy sana: ${currency.cbuDate}',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: context.mutedColor),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // 2. Do'kon kursi rejimini tanlash
              const Text(
                'Savdoda qo‘llaniladigan kurs:',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),

              const SizedBox(height: 8),

              RadioListTile<bool>(
                value: false,
                groupValue: _useCustom,
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                dense: true,
                title: const Text('Markaziy Bank rasmiy kursi (avtomatik)'),
                subtitle: Text('Har kuni internetdan yangilanadi: ${money(currency.cbuRate)}',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: context.mutedColor)),
                onChanged: (val) {
                  setState(() {
                    _useCustom = false;
                  });
                  currency.resetToCbuRate();
                },
              ),

              RadioListTile<bool>(
                value: true,
                groupValue: _useCustom,
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                dense: true,
                title: const Text('Do‘konning maxsus kursi (qo‘lda kiritish)'),
                subtitle: const Text('Kassa va hisob-kitoblarda belgilangan qat’iy kurs',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5)),
                onChanged: (val) {
                  setState(() {
                    _useCustom = true;
                  });
                },
              ),

              if (_useCustom) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _customRateCtrl,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          labelText: '1 USD kursi (so‘m)',
                          prefixText: '\$1 = ',
                          suffixText: 'so‘m',
                          filled: true,
                          fillColor: isDark ? const Color(0xFF161B22) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    FilledButton(
                      onPressed: () {
                        final val = parseInput(_customRateCtrl.text);
                        if (val != null && val > 0) {
                          currency.setCustomRate(val);
                          showMessage(context, 'Do‘kon kursi \$1 = ${money(val)} qilib belgilandi');
                        }
                      },
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      ),
                      child: const Text('Saqlash'),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],

              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // 3. Tezkor konvertor kalkulyatori
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF141820) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    const Text('Tezkor hisob-kitob (Kalkulyator):',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            '\$100 = ${money(currency.toUzs(_calcUsd))}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            '1 mln so‘m = ${moneyUsd(currency.toUsd(_calcUzs))}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Yopish'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'camera_capture_dialog.dart';
import 'common.dart';

class CustomersScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomersScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CustomersScreen> createState() => _CustomersScreenState();
}

class _CustomersScreenState extends State<CustomersScreen> {
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Customer>> _future;
  String _selectedFilter = 'Barchasi'; // 'Barchasi', 'Qarzdorlar', 'Faol xaridorlar'

  CustomerRepository get _repo => context.read<AppRepositories>().customers;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _future = _repo.listCustomers();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reload() {
    setState(() {
      _future = _repo.listCustomers();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _openCustomerDialog([Customer? customer]) async {
    final updated = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (_) => CustomerDialog(customer: customer),
    );
    if (updated == true) {
      _reload();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openCustomerDetails(Customer customer) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _CustomerDetailsDialog(
        customer: customer,
        onEdit: () {
          Navigator.pop(context);
          _openCustomerDialog(customer);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final wide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(wide ? 28 : 14, 4, wide ? 28 : 14, 24),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // Yuqori qidiruv va yangi mijoz qo'shish paneli
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: SizedBox(
                  height: 44,
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _searchCtrl,
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: context.inkColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                    textAlignVertical: TextAlignVertical.center,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: context.cardColor,
                      isDense: true,
                      hintText: 'Mijoz ismi, telefoni yoki pasporti bo‘yicha qidirish...',
                      hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: AppColors.muted),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20, color: AppColors.muted),
                      suffixIcon: _searchCtrl.text.isEmpty
                          ? null
                          : IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18),
                              onPressed: () {
                                _searchCtrl.clear();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            ),
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30), borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor)),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30), borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor)),
                      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30), borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink, width: 1.5)),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              SizedBox(
                height: 44,
                child: FilledButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () => _openCustomerDialog(),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.person_add_alt_1_rounded, size: 18),
                  label: Text(wide ? 'Yangi Mijoz' : '+', style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13)),
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                    foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30)),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: wide ? 18 : 14),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),

          // Filter chiplari
          SingleChildScrollView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            child: Row(
              children: ['Barchasi', 'Qarzdorlar', 'Faol xaridorlar'].map((cat) {
                final sel = _selectedFilter == cat;
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                  child: ChoiceChip(
                    label: Text(
                      cat,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: sel ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                        color: sel ? Colors.white : AppColors.ink,
                      ),
                    ),
                    selected: sel,
                    selectedColor: AppColors.darkCard,
                    backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      side: BorderSide(color: sel ? AppColors.darkCard : AppColors.border),
                    ),
                    showCheckmark: false,
                    onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedFilter = cat),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          // Asosiy ro'yxat
          Expanded(
            child: FutureBuilder<List<Customer>>(
              future: _future,
              builder: (context, snap) {
                if (snap.hasError) {
                  return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reload);
                }
                if (!snap.hasData) {
                  return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
                }

                var list = snap.data!;

                // Qidiruv filtri
                final q = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (q.isNotEmpty) {
                  list = list.where((c) {
                    final n = c.name.toLowerCase();
                    final p = (c.phone ?? '').toLowerCase();
                    final pass = (c.passport ?? '').toLowerCase();
                    return n.contains(q) || p.contains(q) || pass.contains(q);
                  }).toList();
                }

                // Kategoriya filtri
                if (_selectedFilter == 'Qarzdorlar') {
                  list = list.where((c) => c.totalDebt > 0.5).toList();
                } else if (_selectedFilter == 'Faol xaridorlar') {
                  list = list.where((c) => c.salesCount > 0).toList();
                }

                if (list.isEmpty) {
                  return Center(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.people_outline_rounded, size: 54, color: context.mutedColor),
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          Text(
                            q.isNotEmpty ? 'Mijoz topilmadi' : 'Hozircha mijozlar ro‘yxati bo‘sh',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 16, color: context.inkColor),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Text(
                            q.isNotEmpty ? 'Boshqa ism, telefon yoki pasport bilan qidiring' : 'Yangi savdo paytida yoki "+ Yangi Mijoz" tugmasi orqali qo‘shing',
                            style: TextStyle(color: context.mutedColor, fontSize: 13),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }

                // Statistika hisoblash
                final totalDebtSum = list.fold<double>(0, (sum, c) => sum + c.totalDebt);
                final totalSpentSum = list.fold<double>(0, (sum, c) => sum + c.totalSpent);

                return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    // Statistika paneli
                    Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: context.cardColor,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: _StatMini(
                              label: 'Jami mijozlar',
                              value: '${list.length} nafar',
                              color: context.inkColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(width: 1, height: 28, color: context.borderColor),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _StatMini(
                              label: 'Umumiy xarid',
                              value: money(totalSpentSum),
                              color: AppColors.green,
                            ),
                          ),
                          Container(width: 1, height: 28, color: context.borderColor),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _StatMini(
                              label: 'Umumiy nasiya',
                              value: money(totalDebtSum),
                              color: totalDebtSum > 0 ? AppColors.danger : AppColors.muted,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Mijozlar kartalari
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView.separated(
                        itemCount: list.length,
                        separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                          final c = list[i];
                          final hasDebt = c.totalDebt > 0.5;

                          return InkWell(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                            onTap: () => _openCustomerDetails(c),
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: context.cardColor,
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                                border: Border.all(color: hasDebt ? AppColors.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.3) : context.borderColor),
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  // Mijoz / Pasport rasmi
                                  GestureDetector(
                                    onTap: (c.photoUrl != null && c.photoUrl!.isNotEmpty)
                                        ? () => showProductImagePreview(
                                              context,
                                              imageUrl: c.photoUrl,
                                              name: c.name,
                                              subtitle: 'Pasport: ${c.passport ?? 'Kiritilmagan'} • Telefon: ${c.phone ?? 'Yo‘q'}',
                                            )
                                        : null,
                                    child: ProductThumbnail(
                                      imageUrl: c.photoUrl,
                                      name: c.name,
                                      size: 54,
                                      borderRadius: 14,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 14),

                                  // Ismi, telefoni, pasporti
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                      children: [
                                        Row(
                                          children: [
                                            Expanded(
                                              child: Text(
                                                c.name,
                                                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 15, color: context.inkColor),
                                                maxLines: 1,
                                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                            if (c.passport != null && c.passport!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                              Container(

                                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                  color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF21262D) : const Color(0xFFEFF6FF),
                                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                                  border: Border.all(color: context.isDark ? AppColors.border : const Color(0xFFBFDBFE)),
                                                ),
                                                child: Text(
                                                  c.passport!,
                                                  style: TextStyle(
                                                    fontSize: 11,

                                            ],

                                        ),
                                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                        Row(
                                          children: [
                                            Icon(Icons.phone_outlined, size: 13, color: context.mutedColor),

class _StatMini extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatMini({required this.label, required this.value, required this.color});
  final String label;
  final String value;
  final Color color;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.muted)),
        const SizedBox(height: 2),
        Text(value, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: color), maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Mijoz ma'lumotlarini to'liq ko'rish dialogi
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _CustomerDetailsDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CustomerDetailsDialog({required this.customer, required this.onEdit});
  final Customer customer;
  final VoidCallback onEdit;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = customer;
    final hasDebt = c.totalDebt > 0.5;

class CustomerDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CustomerDialog({super.key, this.customer});
  final Customer? customer;

  @override
  State<CustomerDialog> createState() => _CustomerDialogState();
}

class _CustomerDialogState extends State<CustomerDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  late final _nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.customer?.name ?? '');
  late final _phoneCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.customer?.phone ?? '');
  late final _passportCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.customer?.passport ?? '');
  String? _photoUrl;
  bool _saving = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _photoUrl = widget.customer?.photoUrl;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameCtrl.dispose();
    _phoneCtrl.dispose();
    _passportCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _pickImage(ImageSource source) async {
    try {
      final custRepo = context.read<AppRepositories>().customers;
      final bytes = await pickOrCaptureCustomerImage(context, source);
      if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) return;

      String finalUrl;
      try {
        final decoded = img.decodeImage(Uint8List.fromList(bytes));
        if (decoded != null) {
          final resized = (decoded.width > 480 || decoded.height > 480)
              ? img.copyResize(decoded, width: decoded.width >= decoded.height ? 480 : null, height: decoded.height > decoded.width ? 480 : null)
              : decoded;
          final jpg = img.encodeJpg(resized, quality: 78);
          finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(jpg)}';
        } else {
          finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
        }
      } catch (_) {
        finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
      }

      LocalImageStore.saveCustomerImage(widget.customer?.id, finalUrl, _phoneCtrl.text, _nameCtrl.text);

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _photoUrl = finalUrl;
          _error = null;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _error = 'Rasm olishda xatolik: $e');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    setState(() {
      _saving = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final repo = context.read<AppRepositories>().customers;
      final name = _nameCtrl.text.trim();
      final phone = _phoneCtrl.text.trim();
      final passport = _passportCtrl.text.trim();

      if (widget.customer == null) {
        // Yangi mijoz
        await repo.createCustomer(
          Customer(
            id: 0,
            name: name,
            phone: phone.isNotEmpty ? phone : null,
            passport: passport.isNotEmpty ? passport : null,
            photoUrl: _photoUrl,
          ),
        );
      } else {
        // Tahrirlash
        await repo.updateCustomer(
          widget.customer!.copyWith(
            name: name,
            phone: phone.isNotEmpty ? phone : null,
            passport: passport.isNotEmpty ? passport : null,
            photoUrl: _photoUrl,
          ),
        );
      }
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = e.toString();
          _saving = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isEdit = widget.customer != null;

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      child: Container(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 440),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      isEdit ? 'Mijozni tahrirlash' : 'Yangi mijoz qo‘shish',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    IconButton(
                      onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Fotosurat qismi
                Center(
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => _pickImage(ImageSource.gallery),
                        child: Stack(
                          children: [
                            ProductThumbnail(
                              imageUrl: _photoUrl,
                              name: _nameCtrl.text.isNotEmpty ? _nameCtrl.text : 'Mijoz',
                              size: 88,
                              borderRadius: 22,
                            ),
                            Positioned(
                              bottom: 0,
                              right: 0,
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                                decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                                  color: AppColors.darkCard,
                                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                ),
                                child: const Icon(Icons.camera_alt_rounded, size: 16, color: Colors.white),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          TextButton.icon(
                            onPressed: () => _pickImage(ImageSource.camera),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_rounded, size: 16),
                            label: const Text('Kamera', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          TextButton.icon(
                            onPressed: () => _pickImage(ImageSource.gallery),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.photo_library_rounded, size: 16),
                            label: const Text('Galereya', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                          ),
                          if (_photoUrl != null) ...[
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            IconButton(
                              onPressed: () => setState(() => _photoUrl = null),
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: AppColors.danger),
                              tooltip: 'Rasmni o‘chirish',
                            ),
                          ],
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Ismi
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _nameCtrl,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Ism va Familiya *',
                    hintText: 'Masalan: Rustam Karimov',
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded, size: 20),
                  ),
                  validator: (v) => (v == null || v.trim().isEmpty) ? 'Ism kiritilishi shart' : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Telefon
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _phoneCtrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,

                // Pasport
                TextFormField(

                if (_error != null) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  children: [
```

```dart
import 'dart:math' as math;

import '../core/format.dart';
```
