```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/local_image_store.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'deliveries_screen.dart';
import 'receipt_dialog.dart';

class OrdersScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const OrdersScreen({super.key, this.onNewOrder});
  final VoidCallback? onNewOrder;

  @override
  State<OrdersScreen> createState() => _OrdersScreenState();
}

class _OrdersScreenState extends State<OrdersScreen> {
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _statusFilter = 'Faol (Kutilmoqda)'; // 'Barchasi', 'Faol (Kutilmoqda)', 'Topshirilgan', 'Bekor qilingan'
  bool _loading = true;
  String? _error;
  List<SaleResult> _orders = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadOrders();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadOrders() async {
    setState(() {
      _loading = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
      final allSales = await repos.sales.listSales(limit: 200);
      // Buyurtmalar: status == 'order' yoki 'cancelled' yoki (status == 'completed' va izohi mavjud/avval buyurtma bo'lgan)
      final orders = allSales.where((s) => s.isOrder || s.status == 'cancelled' || s.note != null).toList();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _orders = orders;
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = e.toString();
          _loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  List<SaleResult> get _filteredOrders {
    var list = _orders;

    // Status filter
    if (_statusFilter == 'Faol (Kutilmoqda)') {
      list = list.where((o) => o.status == 'order').toList();
    } else if (_statusFilter == 'Topshirilgan') {
      list = list.where((o) => o.status == 'completed').toList();
    } else if (_statusFilter == 'Bekor qilingan') {
      list = list.where((o) => o.status == 'cancelled').toList();
    }

    // Search filter
    final q = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q.isNotEmpty) {
      list = list.where((o) {
        final idStr = '#${o.id}';
        final name = o.customerName?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
        final phone = o.customerPhone?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
        final note = o.note?.toLowerCase() ?? '';
        final items = o.items.map((i) => i.productName.toLowerCase()).join(' ');
        return idStr.contains(q) ||
            o.id.toString().contains(q) ||
            name.contains(q) ||
            phone.contains(q) ||
            note.contains(q) ||
            items.contains(q);
      }).toList();
    }

    return list;
  }

  Future<void> _fulfillOrder(SaleResult order) async {
    final updated = await showDialog<SaleResult?>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => OrderFulfillDialog(order: order),
    );

    if (updated != null && mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
          content: Text('✓ Buyurtma #${order.id} muvaffaqiyatli topshirildi va ombordan chiqarildi!'),
        ),
      );
      _loadOrders();
      await ReceiptDialog.show(context, updated);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _cancelOrder(SaleResult order) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.warning_amber_rounded, color: Color(0xFFEF4444), size: 24),
            SizedBox(width: 10),
            Text('Buyurtmani bekor qilish', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text('Haqiqatan ham #${order.id} sonli buyurtmani bekor qilmoqchimisiz?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Yo‘q')),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEF4444)),
            child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
      await repos.sales.cancelOrder(order.id);
      if (!mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          content: Text('Buyurtma #${order.id} bekor qilindi'),
        ),
      );
      _loadOrders();
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating, content: Text(e.toString()), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _payDebtDialog(SaleResult order) async {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: order.debt.round().toString());
    var method = 'cash';
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: Text(
            'To‘lov qabul qilish — Buyurtma #${order.id}',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16),
          ),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 360,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.pending_actions_rounded, color: Color(0xFFEF4444), size: 20),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Qolgan summa: ${money(order.debt)}',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: ctrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'To‘lov summasi'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SegmentedButton<String>(
                  segments: const [
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'cash', label: Text('Naqd')),
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'card', label: Text('Karta')),
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'bank', label: Text('Hisob')),
                  ],
                  selected: {method},
                  onSelectionChanged: (s) => setS(() => method = s.first),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Bekor')),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime, foregroundColor: AppColors.ink),
              child: const Text('To‘lovni tasdiqlash', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    final val = parseInput(ctrl.text);
    ctrl.dispose();
    if (ok == true && val != null && val > 0 && mounted) {
      try {
        final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
        final updated = await repos.sales.payDebt(order.id, val, method: method);
        if (!mounted) return;
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
            content: Text('Buyurtma #${order.id} uchun ${money(val)} qabul qilindi'),
          ),
        );
        _loadOrders();
        await ReceiptDialog.show(context, updated);
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating, content: Text(e.toString()), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _createDeliveryForOrder(SaleResult order) async {
    final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
    final items = order.items
        .map((i) => DeliveryItem(
              productId: i.productId,
              productName: i.productName,
              quantity: i.quantity,
              unit: 'dona',
            ))
        .toList();

    final created = await showDialog<Delivery>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => DeliveryEditDialog(
        saleId: order.id,
        initialRecipientName: order.customerName,
        initialRecipientPhone: order.customerPhone,
        initialAddress: order.note,
        initialItems: items,
      ),
    );

    if (created != null && mounted) {
      try {
        await repos.deliveries.create(created);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
            content: Text('✓ Buyurtma #${order.id} uchun yetkazib berish (mashina: ${created.vehicleNumber}) reysga qo‘shildi'),
          ),
        );
      } catch (e) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating, content: Text('Xatolik: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Widget _buildFilterSegment({
    required String label,
    required int count,
    required Color? dotColor,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 6.5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
          boxShadow: isSelected
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(context.isDark ? 0.25 : 0.08),
                    blurRadius: 4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                  ),
                ]
              : null,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            if (!isSelected && dotColor != null && count > 0) ...[
              Container(
                width: 6.5,
                height: 6.5,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: dotColor,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
            ],
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                color: isSelected
                    ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)
                    : (context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF94A3B8) : const Color(0xFF64748B)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1.5),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isSelected
                    ? (context.isDark
                        ? AppColors.ink.withOpacity(0.15)
                        : Colors.white.withOpacity(0.2))
                    : (context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF262C36) : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
              ),
              child: Text(
                '$count',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 10.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  color: isSelected
                      ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)
                      : context.inkColor,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filtered = _filteredOrders;
    final totalOrders = _orders.length;
    final activeOrders = _orders.where((o) => o.status == 'order').length;
    final completedOrders = _orders.where((o) => o.status == 'completed').length;
    final cancelledOrders = _orders.where((o) => o.status == 'cancelled').length;
    final totalAdvances = _orders.fold<double>(0, (a, o) => a + o.paid);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: _loadOrders,
        color: AppColors.neonLime,
        child: ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          children: [
            // KPI kartochkalari
            LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, constraints) {
                final isNarrow = constraints.maxWidth < 640;
                final cardWidth = isNarrow ? (constraints.maxWidth - 12) / 2 : (constraints.maxWidth - 36) / 4;
                return Wrap(
                  spacing: 12,
                  runSpacing: 12,
                  children: [
                    _KpiCard(
                      title: 'Jami Buyurtmalar',
                      value: '$totalOrders ta',
                      icon: Icons.assignment_rounded,
                      color: const Color(0xFF3B82F6),
                      width: cardWidth,
                    ),
                    _KpiCard(
                      title: 'Kutilmoqda (Faol)',
                      value: '$activeOrders ta',
                      icon: Icons.hourglass_top_rounded,
                      color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                      width: cardWidth,
                    ),
                    _KpiCard(
                      title: 'Topshirilgan',
                      value: '$completedOrders ta',
                      icon: Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                      color: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                      width: cardWidth,
                    ),
                    _KpiCard(
                      title: 'Avanslar Summasi',
                      value: money(totalAdvances),
                      icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
                      color: AppColors.neonLimeDark,
                      width: cardWidth,
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Qidiruv va Filterlar (Zamonaviy burchaksiz kapsulalar)
            LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, c) {
                final isWide = c.maxWidth > 820;

                final searchField = SizedBox(
                  height: 42,
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _searchCtrl,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'Mijoz ismi, telefon, buyurtma # yoki mahsulot nomi...',
                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        color: context.subtextColor.withOpacity(0.8),
                      ),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 19),
                      suffixIcon: _searchCtrl.text.isNotEmpty
                          ? IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_rounded, size: 16),
                              onPressed: () {
                                _searchCtrl.clear();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            )
                          : null,
                      filled: true,
                      fillColor: context.cardBg,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 0),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
                      ),
                      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                        borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
                      ),
                      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                        borderSide: BorderSide(
                          color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF3B82F6),
                          width: 1.4,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                  ),
                );

                final filterCapsule = SingleChildScrollView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3.5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.isDark ? AppColors.darkCard : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                      border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor.withOpacity(0.6)),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        for (final item in [
                          ('Faol (Kutilmoqda)', activeOrders, const Color(0xFFF59E0B)),
                          ('Barchasi', totalOrders, null),
                          ('Topshirilgan', completedOrders, const Color(0xFF10B981)),
                          ('Bekor qilingan', cancelledOrders, const Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                        ])
                          _buildFilterSegment(
                            label: item.$1,
                            count: item.$2,
                            dotColor: item.$3,
                            isSelected: _statusFilter == item.$1,
                            onTap: () => setState(() => _statusFilter = item.$1),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                );

                if (isWide) {
                  return Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(child: searchField),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      filterCapsule,
                    ],
                  );
                }

                return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    searchField,
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    filterCapsule,
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // Buyurtmalar ro'yxati
            if (_loading)
              const Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.all(40),
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.neonLime),
                ),
              )
            else if (_error != null)
              Center(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Color(0xFFEF4444), size: 40),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Text('Xatolik yuz berdi: $_error', textAlign: TextAlign.center),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      FilledButton(onPressed: _loadOrders, child: const Text('Qayta urinish')),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              )
            else if (filtered.isEmpty)
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(36),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.cardBg,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.assignment_late_outlined, size: 54, color: context.subtextColor.withOpacity(0.5)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Text(
                      'Buyurtmalar topilmadi',
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16, color: context.inkColor),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      'Kassada tovarlarni savatga qo‘shib, to‘lov oynasida "Buyurtma (Pre-order)" sifatida saqlashingiz mumkin.',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: context.subtextColor),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
            else
              for (final order in filtered)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  child: _OrderCard(
                    order: order,
                    onFulfill: () => _fulfillOrder(order),
                    onCancel: () => _cancelOrder(order),
                    onPay: () => _payDebtDialog(order),
                    onReceipt: () => ReceiptDialog.show(context, order),
                    onDelivery: () => _createDeliveryForOrder(order),
                  ),
                ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _KpiCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _KpiCard({
    required this.title,
    required this.value,
    required this.icon,
    required this.color,
    required this.width,
  });

  final String title;
  final String value;
  final IconData icon;
  final Color color;
  final double width;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: width,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.cardBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.12),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 22),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  title,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: context.subtextColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(
                  value,
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: context.inkColor),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _OrderCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _OrderCard({
    required this.order,
    required this.onFulfill,
    required this.onCancel,
    required this.onPay,
    required this.onReceipt,
    required this.onDelivery,
  });

  final SaleResult order;
  final VoidCallback onFulfill;
  final VoidCallback onCancel;
  final VoidCallback onPay;
  final VoidCallback onReceipt;
  final VoidCallback onDelivery;

    final isOrder = order.status == 'order';

    String statusText;

      statusColor = const Color(0xFFF59E0B);

          const SizedBox(height: 10),

          // 5. Harakat tugmalari (Zamonaviy burchaksiz kapsulalar)

                if (isOrder) ...[

                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: onDelivery,

                    ),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFF0284C7),
                      side: BorderSide(color: const Color(0xFF0284C7).withOpacity(0.5)),
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF0284C7).withOpacity(0.06),

                    ),
                  ),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: onCancel,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 15, color: Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                    label: const Text(
                      'Bekor qilish',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Color(0xFFEF4444)),
                    ),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: const Color(0xFFEF4444),
                      side: BorderSide(color: const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.4)),
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.05),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  ),
                  // Topshirish (Primary)
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: onFulfill,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.task_alt_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Topshirish', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 9),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class OrderFulfillDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const OrderFulfillDialog({super.key, required this.order});

  final SaleResult order;

  @override
  State<OrderFulfillDialog> createState() => _OrderFulfillDialogState();
}

class _OrderFulfillDialogState extends State<OrderFulfillDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  String _receiverType = 'customer'; // 'customer', 'driver', 'agent'
  String _deliveryType = 'pickup'; // 'pickup', 'delivery'

  late final TextEditingController _nameCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _phoneCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _docOrCarCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _noteCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _payAmountCtrl;

  bool _payDebtNow = true;
  String _payMethod = 'cash'; // 'cash', 'card', 'transfer'
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;

  List<AppUser> _drivers = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final ord = widget.order;
    _nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: ord.customerName ?? '');
    _phoneCtrl = TextEditingController(text: ord.customerPhone ?? '');
    _docOrCarCtrl = TextEditingController();
    _noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
    _payAmountCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: ord.debt > 0 ? ord.debt.round().toString() : '0',
    );
    _loadDrivers();
  }

  Future<void> _loadDrivers() async {
    try {
      final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
      final users = await repos.users.list();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _drivers = users.where((u) => u.role == Role.haydovchi && u.isActive).toList();
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameCtrl.dispose();
    _phoneCtrl.dispose();
    _docOrCarCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    _payAmountCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onReceiverTypeChanged(String type) {
    setState(() {
      _receiverType = type;
      if (type == 'customer') {
        _nameCtrl.text = widget.order.customerName ?? '';
        _phoneCtrl.text = widget.order.customerPhone ?? '';
        _deliveryType = 'pickup';
      } else if (type == 'driver') {
        _deliveryType = 'delivery';
        if (_drivers.isNotEmpty) {
          _nameCtrl.text = _drivers.first.fullName;
          _phoneCtrl.text = '';
        } else {
          _nameCtrl.text = 'Haydovchi';
        }
      } else if (type == 'agent') {
        _deliveryType = 'pickup';
        _nameCtrl.text = '';
        _phoneCtrl.text = '';
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
      double? payAmount;
      if (widget.order.debt > 0.005 && _payDebtNow) {
        payAmount = double.tryParse(_payAmountCtrl.text.replaceAll(' ', '')) ?? 0.0;
      }

      final updated = await repos.sales.fulfillOrder(
        widget.order.id,
        receivedByName: _nameCtrl.text.trim(),
        receivedByPhone: _phoneCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _phoneCtrl.text.trim(),
        deliveryType: _deliveryType,
        receiverDocOrCar: _docOrCarCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _docOrCarCtrl.text.trim(),
        note: _noteCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _noteCtrl.text.trim(),
        payAmount: payAmount,
        payMethod: _payMethod,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, updated);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _busy = false;
          _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final ord = widget.order;
    final hasDebt = ord.debt > 0.005;

    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 20, 20, 16),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(9),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.12),
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
            ),
            child: const Icon(Icons.task_alt_rounded, color: Color(0xFF10B981), size: 22),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Buyurtmani topshirish',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 17),
                ),
                Text(
                  'Buyurtma #${ord.id} • Jami: ${money(ord.total)}',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.subtextColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          IconButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
            visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,

      ),

        width: 520,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: _formKey,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [

                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.1),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                      border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.3)),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        const Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, color: Color(0xFFEF4444), size: 18),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),

                    ),
                  ),
                ],

                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(Icons.person_outline_rounded, size: 15, color: context.subtextColor),
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Text(
                                ord.customerName ?? 'Noma‘lum mijoz',
                                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13, color: context.inkColor),

                          ),

                    ),

                      children: [

        ),

          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),

            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
          ),
          icon: _busy
              ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
              : const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 18),
          label: Text(
            _busy ? 'Topshirilmoqda...' : 'Topshirish va Tasdiqlash',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPresetChip(String label, String type) {
    final isSel = _receiverType == type;
    return ChoiceChip(
      label: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600)),
      selected: isSel,
      selectedColor: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.18),
      side: BorderSide(color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : context.borderColor),
      onSelected: (_) => _onReceiverTypeChanged(type),
      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNotePresetChip(String text) {
    return ActionChip(
      label: Text(text, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
      backgroundColor: context.borderColor.withOpacity(0.3),
      side: BorderSide.none,
      onPressed: () {
        setState(() {
          if (_noteCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
            _noteCtrl.text = text;
          } else if (!_noteCtrl.text.contains(text)) {
            _noteCtrl.text = '${_noteCtrl.text}, $text';
          }
        });
      },
      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDeliveryTypeOption({
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required IconData icon,
    required String value,
  }) {
    final isSel = _deliveryType == value;
    final color = isSel ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : context.subtextColor;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () => setState(() => _deliveryType = value),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.08) : context.cardColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSel ? const Color(0xFF10B981) : context.borderColor,
            width: isSel ? 1.5 : 1.0,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(7),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: color.withOpacity(0.12),
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: Icon(icon, size: 16, color: color),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                      color: isSel ? context.inkColor : context.subtextColor,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: context.subtextColor),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'dart:convert';

import '../state/auth_controller.dart';
import 'receipt_dialog.dart';
import 'stone_services_dialog.dart';

String _u(String unit) => unit == 'm2' ? 'm²' : unit;

double _roundClean(double val) {
  if ((val - val.round()).abs() < 0.01) {
    return val.roundToDouble();
  }
  return double.parse(val.toStringAsFixed(3));
}

BoxDecoration _cardBox({Color? color, double radius = 22}) => BoxDecoration(
      color: color,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
      boxShadow: const [BoxShadow(color: Color(0x0F000000), blurRadius: 12, offset: Offset(0, 4))],
    );

ShapeBorder get _dialogShape => RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24));


bool _isCategoryMatch(Product p, String selectedCategory) {
  if (p.isService) return false;
  if (selectedCategory == 'Barchasi') return true;

  String norm(String s) => s
      .toLowerCase()
      .replaceAll('‘', "'")
      .replaceAll('’', "'")
      .replaceAll('ʻ', "'")
      .replaceAll('ʼ', "'")
      .replaceAll('`', "'")
      .trim();

  final sel = norm(selectedCategory);

  // 1. Mahsulotning o'z kategoriyasi bilan solishtirish
  if (p.category != null && p.category!.trim().isNotEmpty) {
    final cat = norm(p.category!);
    if (cat == sel) return true;
    if (sel == 'kerama granit' && (cat.contains('keramo') || cat.contains('kerama') || cat.contains('plitka'))) return true;
    if (sel == 'granit' && cat.contains('granit') && !cat.contains('kerama') && !cat.contains('keramo')) return true;
    if (sel.startsWith("qo'shimcha") && (cat.contains("qo'shimcha") || cat.contains('material') || cat.contains('aksessuar') || cat.contains('kley'))) return true;
    if (sel == 'kafel' && (cat.contains('kafel') || cat.contains('plita'))) return true;
    if (sel == 'marmar' && cat.contains('marmar')) return true;
    if (sel == 'xomashyo' && cat.contains('xomashyo')) return true;
    if (sel.startsWith('tayyor') && cat.contains('tayyor')) return true;
  }

  // 2. Mahsulot nomi bo'yicha intellektual moslik
  final n = norm(p.name);
  if (n.contains(sel)) return true;

  if (sel == 'kerama granit' && (n.contains('keramogranit') || n.contains('keramo') || n.contains('kerama'))) return true;
  if (sel == 'granit' && (n.contains('angola') || n.contains('tan brown') || n.contains('black crystal') || n.contains('granit'))) {
    if (p.category == null || !norm(p.category!).contains('keram')) return true;
  }
  if (sel == 'marmar' && (n.contains('miramir') || n.contains('marmar') || n.contains('travertin'))) return true;
  if (sel == 'kafel' && (n.contains('kafel') || n.contains('plita'))) return true;
  if (sel.startsWith("qo'shimcha") && (n.contains('kley') || n.contains('akfix') || n.contains('disk') || n.contains('cherepashka') || n.contains("chizg'ich") || n.contains('qalamtarosh') || n.contains('qalamqosh') || n.contains('rizak'))) return true;
  if (sel == 'xomashyo' && (n.contains('sim') || n.contains('blok') || n.contains('xomashyo'))) return true;

  return false;
}

class PosScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PosScreen({super.key});
  @override
  State<PosScreen> createState() => _PosScreenState();
}

class _PosScreenState extends State<PosScreen> {
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Product>> _future;
  String _selectedCategory = 'Barchasi';
  int _mobileTab = 0; // 0: Katalog, 1: Savat
  bool _isScannerOpen = false;

  static const _categories = [
    'Barchasi',
    'Granit',
    'Kerama granit',
    'Kafel',
    'Marmar',
    'Tayyor mahsulot',
    'Xomashyo',
    'Qo‘shimcha',
  ];

  ProductRepository get _repo => context.read<AppRepositories>().products;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    HardwareKeyboard.instance.addHandler(_handleKeyEvent);
    _future = context.read<AppRepositories>().products.list();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    HardwareKeyboard.instance.removeHandler(_handleKeyEvent);
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  bool _handleKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
    if (event is KeyDownEvent && event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.f2) {
      if (!_isScannerOpen && mounted) {
        _openQrScanner();
      }
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  void _reload() {
    setState(() {
      _future = _repo.list();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _openQrScanner() async {
    if (_isScannerOpen) return;
    _isScannerOpen = true;
    final wide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;
    if (wide && Platform.isWindows) {
      await showDialog<void>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: true,
        builder: (ctx) => _DesktopQrScannerDialog(
          onCartUpdated: () {
            if (mounted) setState(() {});
          },
        ),
      );
    } else {
      await Navigator.of(context).push<void>(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (ctx) => QrScannerScreen(
            onCartUpdated: () {
              if (mounted) setState(() {});
            },
            onGoToCart: () {
              if (mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  _mobileTab = 1;
                });
              }
            },
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    _isScannerOpen = false;
    if (mounted) _reload();
  }

  Future<void> _onSubmit(String text) async {
    final code = text.trim();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;

    if (isReceiptQr(code)) {
      final saleId = extractSaleId(code);
      if (saleId != null) {
        try {
          final sales = await context.read<AppRepositories>().sales.listSales(limit: 500);
          final matched = sales.where((s) => s.id == saleId).firstOrNull;
          if (matched != null && mounted) {
            _search.clear();
            await ReceiptDialog.show(context, matched);
            return;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    try {
      final p = await _repo.findByCode(code);
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (p != null) {
        context.read<CartController>().add(p);
        _search.clear();
        _reload();
      } else {
        showMessage(context, 'Bu kod bo‘yicha mahsulot topilmadi', error: true);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(context, e.toString(), error: true);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cartController = context.watch<CartController>();
    final wide = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width >= 900;

    final searchAndFilter = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

                    suffixIcon: _search.text.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : IconButton(

          if (_mobileTab == 0 && cartController.lines.isNotEmpty) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: AppColors.darkCard,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                boxShadow: const [BoxShadow(color: Color(0x22000000), blurRadius: 10, offset: Offset(0, 4))],
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          '${cartController.lines.length} ta mahsulot',
                          style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFA9BDB0), fontSize: 11),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        Text(
                          money(cartController.total),
                          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 15),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => setState(() => _mobileTab = 1),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime,
                      foregroundColor: AppColors.ink,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.shopping_cart_checkout_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Savat', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ProductCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ProductCard({super.key, required this.product, required this.index, required this.onTap});
  final Product product;
  final int index;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  @override
  State<_ProductCard> createState() => _ProductCardState();
}

class _ProductCardState extends State<_ProductCard> {
  bool _hover = false;
  bool _down = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final p = widget.product;
    final out = p.stock <= 0;
    final lifted = _hover && !out;
    final intro = Duration(milliseconds: 320 + widget.index.clamp(0, 10) * 45);

    final cart = context.watch<CartController>();
    final inCartLines = cart.lines.where((l) => l.product.id == p.id).toList();
    final inCart = inCartLines.isNotEmpty;
    final inCartCount = inCartLines.fold<double>(0, (sum, l) => sum + l.quantity);

    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: 1),
      duration: intro,
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, t, child) => Opacity(
        opacity: t,
        child: Transform.translate(offset: Offset(0, (1 - t) * 22), child: child),
      ),
      child: MouseRegion(
        cursor: out ? SystemMouseCursors.forbidden : SystemMouseCursors.click,
        onEnter: (_) => setState(() => _hover = true),
        onExit: (_) => setState(() => _hover = false),
        child: GestureDetector(
          onTap: out ? null : widget.onTap,
          onTapDown: out ? null : (_) => setState(() => _down = true),
          onTapUp: (_) => setState(() => _down = false),
          onTapCancel: () => setState(() => _down = false),
          child: AnimatedScale(
            scale: _down ? 0.97 : 1,
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
            child: AnimatedContainer(
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
              curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
              transform: Matrix4.translationValues(0, lifted ? -4 : 0, 0),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: context.cardColor,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(color: lifted ? AppColors.green : context.borderColor, width: 1.4),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Color(lifted ? 0x24000000 : 0x0A000000),
                    blurRadius: lifted ? 20 : 10,
                    offset: Offset(0, lifted ? 8 : 4),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(19),
                child: Opacity(
                  opacity: out ? 0.55 : 1,
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      // Katta rasm qismi (Image Banner)
                      SizedBox(
                        height: 104,
                        child: Stack(
                          fit: StackFit.expand,
                          children: [
                            ProductThumbnail(
                              imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
                              name: p.name,
                              width: double.infinity,
                              height: 104,
                              borderRadiusGeometry: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(19)),
                            ),
                            if (p.category != null && p.category!.isNotEmpty)
                              Positioned(
                                bottom: 6,
                                left: 6,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2.5),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(
                                    p.category!,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 9.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            // Qoldiq belgisi (Stock badge)
                            Positioned(
                              top: 8,
                              right: 8,
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: out
                                      ? const Color(0xFFE53935)
                                      : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                  boxShadow: const [
                                    BoxShadow(color: Color(0x22000000), blurRadius: 4, offset: Offset(0, 2)),
                                  ],
                                ),
                                child: Text(
                                  out ? 'Tugagan' : 'Qoldiq: ${qty(p.stock)} ${_u(p.unit)}',
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    color: Colors.white,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            // Katta ko'rish (Zoom preview) tugmasi agar rasm bo'lsa
                            if (p.imageUrl != null && p.imageUrl!.trim().isNotEmpty)
                              Positioned(
                                top: 8,
                                left: 8,
                                child: Material(
                                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                  child: InkWell(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                    onTap: () => showProductImagePreview(
                                      context,
                                      imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
                                      name: p.name,
                                      subtitle: '${money(p.price)} / ${_u(p.unit)} • Qoldiq: ${qty(p.stock)} ${_u(p.unit)}',
                                    ),
                                    child: const Padding(
                                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(5),
                                      child: Icon(Icons.fullscreen_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 16),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      // Mahsulot matni va narxi
                      Expanded(
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, 10),
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                p.name,
                                maxLines: 2,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 13.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  height: 1.22,
                                  color: context.inkColor,
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (p.sortLabel.isNotEmpty)
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                                  child: Container(
                                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1.5),
                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF332512) : const Color(0xFFFEF3C7),
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                    ),
                                    child: Text(
                                      p.sortLabel,
                                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Color(0xFFD97706)),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                              else if (p.color != null && p.color!.isNotEmpty)
                                Padding(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                                  child: StoneColorBadge(colorName: p.color!, fontSize: 9.5),
                                ),
                              Row(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                                children: [
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Column(
                                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                      children: [
                                        Text(
                                          money(p.price),
                                          maxLines: 1,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 14,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                            color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                        Text(
                                          '${moneyUsd(context.watch<CurrencyController>().toUsd(p.price))} / ${_u(p.unit)}',
                                          maxLines: 1,
                                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: context.mutedColor),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                  AnimatedContainer(
                                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: inCart ? 8 : 0),
                                    height: 34,
                                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 34),
                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: inCart
                                          ? const Color(0xFFF59E0B) // Savatda bo'lsa sariq / amber
                                          : (lifted
                                              ? AppColors.neonLime
                                              : (context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF21262D) : AppColors.darkCard)),
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                      boxShadow: inCart
                                          ? [
                                              BoxShadow(
                                                color: const Color(0xFFF59E0B).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                                                blurRadius: 8,
                                                offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                                              ),
                                            ]
                                          : null,
                                    ),
                                    child: inCart
                                        ? Row(
                                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                                            children: [
                                              const Icon(
                                                Icons.shopping_cart_rounded,
                                                color: Color(0xFF161B22),
                                                size: 15,
                                              ),
                                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                              Text(
                                                qty(inCartCount),
                                                style: const TextStyle(
                                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                                  color: Color(0xFF161B22),
                                                ),
                                              ),
                                            ],
                                          )
                                        : Icon(
                                            Icons.add_shopping_cart_rounded,
                                            color: lifted ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                                            size: 16,
                                          ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CartPanel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CartPanel({required this.onSold});
  final VoidCallback onSold;

  Future<void> _editQty(BuildContext context, CartLine l) async {
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: qty(l.quantity));
    var inDona = l.inDona;
    var inPachka = l.inPachka;
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
          surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
          shape: _dialogShape,
          title: Text(l.product.name, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 320,
            child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: [
              TextField(
                controller: ctrl,
                autofocus: true,
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Miqdor (${inPachka ? "pachka" : (inDona ? "dona" : _u(l.product.unit))})',
                ),
                onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
              ),
              if (l.product.hasPachka) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SegmentedButton<String>(
                  segments: [
                    ButtonSegment(value: 'm2', label: Text(_u(l.product.unit))),
                    ButtonSegment(
                      value: 'pachka',
                      label: Text('pachka (${qty(l.product.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1)} m²)'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  selected: {inPachka ? 'pachka' : 'm2'},
                  onSelectionChanged: (s) {
                    setS(() {
                      final cur = parseInput(ctrl.text) ?? 0;
                      final box = l.product.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1.0;
                      if (s.first == 'pachka' && !inPachka) {
                        inPachka = true;
                        inDona = false;
                        ctrl.text = qty(_roundClean(cur / box));
                      } else if (s.first == 'm2' && inPachka) {
                        inPachka = false;
                        ctrl.text = qty(_roundClean(cur * box));
                      }
                    });
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Builder(builder: (_) {
                  final cur = parseInput(ctrl.text) ?? 0;
                  final box = l.product.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1.0;
                  final propText = inPachka
                      ? '${qty(cur)} pachka = ${qty(_roundClean(cur * box))} m²'
                      : '${qty(cur)} m² = ${qty(_roundClean(cur / box))} pachka';
                  return Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0D9488)).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      '🔄 Proporsional: $propText',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0F766E),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ] else if (l.product.hasDona) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SegmentedButton<bool>(
                  segments: [
                    ButtonSegment(value: false, label: Text(_u(l.product.unit))),
                    const ButtonSegment(value: true, label: Text('dona')),
                  ],
                  selected: {inDona},
                  onSelectionChanged: (s) => setS(() => inDona = s.first),
                ),
              ],
              if (l.product.unit == 'm2') ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx, false);
                    _openCutCalculator(context, l);
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.straighten_rounded, size: 16),
                  label: const Text('📐 Razmer kalkulyatorini ochish'),
                ),
              ],
            ]),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('Bekor')),
            FilledButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true), child: const Text('OK')),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
    final v = parseInput(ctrl.text);
    ctrl.dispose();
    if (ok == true && v != null && v > 0) {
      cart.update(l, quantity: v, inDona: inDona, inPachka: inPachka);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openCutCalculator(BuildContext context, CartLine l) async {
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();
    // Bo'yi faqat santimetrda (sm), Eni esa metrda (m) kiritiladi va hisoblanadi
    final initialLenSm = l.cutLength != null ? (l.cutLength! * 100) : 120.0;
    final lengthCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: initialLenSm % 1 == 0 ? initialLenSm.toInt().toString() : initialLenSm.toString(),
    );
    final initialWidM = l.cutWidth != null ? l.cutWidth! : 0.6;
    final widthCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: initialWidM % 1 == 0 ? initialWidM.toInt().toString() : initialWidM.toString(),
    );
    final countCtrl = TextEditingController(text: l.cutPieces != null ? l.cutPieces.toString() : '1');
    final initialThickness = l.cutThickness ?? l.product.thickness ?? 2.0;
    final thicknessCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: initialThickness > 0
          ? (initialThickness % 1 == 0 ? initialThickness.toInt().toString() : initialThickness.toString())
          : '2.0',
    );

    double calcArea() {
      final lenSm = parseInput(lengthCtrl.text) ?? 0;
      final widM = parseInput(widthCtrl.text) ?? 0;
      final cnt = parseInput(countCtrl.text) ?? 1;
      final lenM = lenSm / 100; // Bo'yi faqat sm dan metrga
      return (lenM * widM * cnt);
    }

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) {
          final area = calcArea();
          final lineSum = area * l.unitPrice;

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
            shape: _dialogShape,
            title: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.straighten_rounded, color: AppColors.ink, size: 22),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const Text('Razmer / Kesish Kalkulyatori', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16)),
                      Text(l.displayName, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.subtextColor)),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 380,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF21262D) : const Color(0xFFEFF2F6),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.straighten_rounded, size: 16, color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'Bo‘yi faqat santimetrda (sm) · Eni metrda (m)',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: context.inkColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 14),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: lengthCtrl,
                            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Bo‘yi (sm)',
                              hintText: '120',
                              suffixText: 'sm',
                            ),
                            onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: widthCtrl,
                            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Eni (m)',
                              hintText: '0.6',
                              suffixText: 'm',
                            ),
                            onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: countCtrl,
                            keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Soni (dona)',
                              hintText: '1',
                              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.pin_rounded, size: 18),
                            ),
                            onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: thicknessCtrl,
                            keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Qalinligi (sm)',
                              hintText: '2.0',
                              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.layers_outlined, size: 18),
                            ),
                            onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        border: Border.all(color: AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text('Hisoblangan maydon:', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: context.inkColor)),
                              Text(
                                '${area.toStringAsFixed(3)} m²',
                                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontSize: 17, color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              Text('Jami summa:', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.subtextColor)),
                              Text(
                                money(lineSum),
                                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 14, color: AppColors.green),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: const Text('Bekor'),
              ),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                  foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
                ),
                child: const Text('Qo‘llash', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (ok == true && context.mounted) {
      final lenSm = parseInput(lengthCtrl.text) ?? 0;
      final widM = parseInput(widthCtrl.text) ?? 0;
      final cnt = (parseInput(countCtrl.text) ?? 1).toInt();
      final thick = parseInput(thicknessCtrl.text) ?? initialThickness;
      final lenM = lenSm / 100;
      final area = lenM * widM * cnt;
      if (area > 0) {
        final thickStr = thick > 0 ? '${thick % 1 == 0 ? thick.toInt() : thick} sm' : '';
        final lenStr = '${lenSm % 1 == 0 ? lenSm.toInt() : lenSm} sm';
        final widStr = '${widM % 1 == 0 ? widM.toInt() : widM} m';
        final spec = thickStr.isNotEmpty
            ? '$lenStr × $widStr ($thickStr, $cnt dona)'
            : '$lenStr × $widStr ($cnt dona)';
        cart.update(
          l,
          quantity: double.parse(area.toStringAsFixed(3)),
          cutLength: lenM,
          cutWidth: widM,
          cutThickness: thick,
          cutPieces: cnt,
          cutSpec: spec,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkout(BuildContext context) async {
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();
    final result = await showDialog<_CheckoutInput>(context: context, builder: (_) => _CheckoutDialog(total: cart.total));
    if (result == null || !context.mounted) return;
    try {
      final res = await cart.checkout(
        paid: result.paid,
        currencyRate: result.currencyRate,
        paidUzs: result.paidUzs,
        paidUsd: result.paidUsd,
        status: result.status,
        note: result.note,
        customerId: result.customerId,
        customerName: result.name,
        customerPhone: result.phone,
        customerPassport: result.passport,
        customerPhotoUrl: result.photoUrl,
      );
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      if (res.isOrder) {
        showMessage(context, 'Buyurtma #${res.id} muvaffaqiyatli saqlandi. Avans: ${money(res.paid)}');
      } else {
        showMessage(context, 'Savdo #${res.id} saqlandi. To‘landi: ${money(res.paid)}'
            '${res.debt > 0 ? ', nasiya: ${money(res.debt)}' : ''}');
      }
      onSold();
      await ReceiptDialog.show(context, res);
    } catch (e) {
      if (context.mounted) showMessage(context, e.toString(), error: true);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cart = context.watch<CartController>();
    final empty = cart.lines.isEmpty;
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      decoration: _cardBox(radius: 24),
      child: Column(children: [

                  ),

                    backgroundColor: Color(0xFFD97706),

                    const Spacer(),
```
