class _CartLineTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CartLineTile({super.key, required this.line, required this.onEdit, this.onCutCalculator});
  final CartLine line;
  final VoidCallback onEdit;
  final VoidCallback? onCutCalculator;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cart = context.watch<CartController>();
    final l = line;
    final p = l.product;
    final unit = l.inPachka ? 'pachka' : (l.inDona ? 'dona' : _u(p.unit));
    final short = l.baseQty > p.stock;
    final sub = l.inPachka
        ? '${money(l.unitPrice)} / ${_u(p.unit)}  ·  ${qty(l.baseQty)} ${_u(p.unit)} (${qty(l.quantity)} pachka)'
        : '${money(l.unitPrice)} / ${_u(p.unit)}${l.inDona ? '  ·  ${qty(l.baseQty)} ${_u(p.unit)}' : ''}';

    return TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
      tween: Tween(begin: 0, end: 1),
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      builder: (context, t, child) => Opacity(
        opacity: t,
        child: Transform.translate(offset: Offset((1 - t) * 24, 0), child: child),
      ),
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 8, 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.cardBg,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(color: short ? AppColors.danger : context.borderColor.withOpacity(0.6)),
        ),
        child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
          Row(children: [
            GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => showProductImagePreview(
                context,
                imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
                name: p.name,
                subtitle: '${money(p.price)} / ${_u(p.unit)} • Savatda: ${qty(line.quantity)} ${_u(p.unit)}',
              ),
              child: ProductThumbnail(
                imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
                name: p.name,
                size: 38,
                borderRadius: 10,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
                Text(
                  p.name,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 14, color: context.inkColor),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        sub,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.subtextColor),
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (p.sortLabel.isNotEmpty || (l.sort != null && l.sort!.isNotEmpty)) ...[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 1),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF332512) : const Color(0xFFFEF3C7),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          l.sort != null && l.sort!.isNotEmpty
                              ? (l.sort == 'oliy' ? 'Oliy sort' : '${l.sort}-sort')
                              : p.sortLabel,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: Color(0xFFD97706)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ]),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Olib tashlash',
              visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
              icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: context.subtextColor),
              onPressed: () => cart.remove(l),
            ),
          ]),

          if (p.hasPachka) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 6,
              runSpacing: 4,
              crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Text('O‘lchov: ', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.subtextColor)),
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: const Text('m²', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5)),
                  selected: !l.inPachka,
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  onSelected: (sel) {
                    if (sel && l.inPachka) {
                      cart.update(l, inPachka: false, quantity: _roundClean(l.baseQty));
                    }
                  },
                ),
                ChoiceChip(
                  label: Text(
                    'Pachka (${p.effectiveBoxM2 != null ? '${qty(p.effectiveBoxM2!)} m²' : ''})',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5),
                  ),
                  selected: l.inPachka,
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  onSelected: (sel) {
                    if (sel && !l.inPachka) {
                      final box = p.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1.0;
                      final pQty = l.quantity / box;
                      cart.update(l, inPachka: true, quantity: _roundClean(pQty));
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],

          // Variant / Rang va Razmer bo'yicha kesish (bitta qatorda, "Rang:" so'zisiz)
          if ((p.availableColors.length > 1) ||
              (l.color != null && l.color!.isNotEmpty) ||
              (p.unit == 'm2')) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 6,
              runSpacing: 4,
              crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
              children: [
                // 1. Rang yoki Sort/Variant tanlovi
                if (p.availableColors.length > 1) ...[
                  for (final col in p.availableColors)
                    ChoiceChip(
                      avatar: Container(
                        width: 7,
                        height: 7,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: getStoneColor(col),
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                      ),
                      label: Text(col, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5)),
                      selected: (l.color ?? p.availableColors.first) == col,
                      onSelected: (sel) {
                        if (sel) cart.update(l, color: col);
                      },
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    ),
                ] else if (l.color != null && l.color!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  StoneColorBadge(colorName: l.color!, fontSize: 10),
                ],

                // 2. Razmer bo'yicha kesish (variant/rang yonida)
                if (p.unit == 'm2') ...[
                  InkWell(
                    onTap: onCutCalculator,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: (l.cutSpec != null)
                            ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.18) : AppColors.greenSoft)
                            : context.borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: (l.cutSpec != null)
                              ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.green)
                              : context.borderColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.straighten_rounded,
                            size: 13,
                            color: (l.cutSpec != null)
                                ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink)
                                : context.subtextColor,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Text(
                            l.cutSpec != null ? '📐 ${l.cutSpec}' : '📐 Razmer kesish',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: (l.cutSpec != null)
                                  ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink)
                                  : context.subtextColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (l.cutSpec != null)
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 14),
                      visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      tooltip: 'Razmerni tozalash',
                      onPressed: () => cart.update(l, cutSpec: '', cutLength: null, cutWidth: null, cutThickness: null, cutPieces: null),
                    ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ],

          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Row(children: [
            Material(
              color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF242C38) : const Color(0xFFEFF2F6),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
                _StepBtn(icon: Icons.remove_rounded, onTap: () {
                  final q = l.quantity - 1;
                  if (q > 0) {
                    cart.update(l, quantity: q);
                  } else {
                    cart.remove(l);
                  }
                }),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: onEdit,
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 6),
                    child: Text('${qty(l.quantity)} $unit', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13, color: context.inkColor)),
                  ),
                ),
                _StepBtn(icon: Icons.add_rounded, onTap: () => cart.update(l, quantity: l.quantity + 1)),
              ]),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: FittedBox(
                  fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                  child: Text(
                    money(l.lineTotal),
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 14, color: context.inkColor),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
          if (short)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
              child: Text('⚠ Omborda yetarli emas', style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StepBtn extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StepBtn({required this.icon, required this.onTap});
  final IconData icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        onTap: onTap,
        child: SizedBox(width: 32, height: 32, child: Icon(icon, size: 18, color: context.inkColor)),
      );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// To'lov oynasi
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _CheckoutInput {
  final double paid;
  final double? currencyRate;
  final double? paidUzs;
  final double? paidUsd;
  final String status;
  final String? note;
  final int? customerId;
  final String? name;
  final String? phone;
  final String? passport;
  final String? photoUrl;

  _CheckoutInput({
    required this.paid,
    this.currencyRate,
    this.paidUzs,
    this.paidUsd,
    this.status = 'completed',
    this.note,
    this.customerId,
    this.name,
    this.phone,
    this.passport,
    this.photoUrl,
  });
}

class _CheckoutDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _CheckoutDialog({required this.total});
  final double total;
  @override
  State<_CheckoutDialog> createState() => _CheckoutDialogState();
}

class _CheckoutDialogState extends State<_CheckoutDialog> {
  late final _paidUzs = TextEditingController(text: widget.total.round().toString());
  final _paidUsd = TextEditingController(text: '0');
  final _name = TextEditingController();
  final _phone = TextEditingController();
  final _passport = TextEditingController();
  final _note = TextEditingController();
  bool _isOrder = false;
  String? _photoUrl;
  int? _selectedCustomerId;
  List<Customer> _existingCustomers = [];
  bool _uploadingImage = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadCustomers();
  }

  Future<void> _loadCustomers() async {
    try {
      final list = await context.read<AppRepositories>().customers.listCustomers();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _existingCustomers = list;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _paidUzs.dispose();
    _paidUsd.dispose();
    _name.dispose();
    _phone.dispose();
    _passport.dispose();
    _note.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _setPaidUzs(double v) {
    setState(() {
      _paidUzs.text = v.round().toString();
      _paidUsd.text = '0';
      _error = null;
    });
  }

  void _setPaidUsd(double v) {
    setState(() {
      _paidUsd.text = v.toStringAsFixed(2);
      _paidUzs.text = '0';
      _error = null;
    });
  }

  void _setSplit(double uzs, double usd) {
    setState(() {
      _paidUzs.text = uzs.round().toString();
      _paidUsd.text = usd.toStringAsFixed(2);
      _error = null;
    });
  }

  void _selectCustomer(Customer c) {
    setState(() {
      _selectedCustomerId = c.id;
      _name.text = c.name;
      _phone.text = c.phone ?? '';
      _passport.text = c.passport ?? '';
      _photoUrl = c.photoUrl;
      _error = null;
    });
  }

  void _clearCustomer() {
    setState(() {
      _selectedCustomerId = null;
      _name.clear();
      _phone.clear();
      _passport.clear();
      _photoUrl = null;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _pickImage(ImageSource source) async {
    final custRepo = context.read<AppRepositories>().customers;
    setState(() {
      _uploadingImage = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      final bytes = await pickOrCaptureCustomerImage(context, source);
      if (bytes == null || bytes.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _uploadingImage = false);
        return;
      }

      String finalUrl;
      try {
        final decoded = img.decodeImage(Uint8List.fromList(bytes));
        if (decoded != null) {
          final resized = (decoded.width > 480 || decoded.height > 480)
              ? img.copyResize(decoded, width: decoded.width >= decoded.height ? 480 : null, height: decoded.height > decoded.width ? 480 : null)
              : decoded;
          final jpg = img.encodeJpg(resized, quality: 78);
          finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(jpg)}';
        } else {
          finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
        }
      } catch (_) {
        finalUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(bytes)}';
      }

      LocalImageStore.saveCustomerImage(_selectedCustomerId, finalUrl, _phone.text, _name.text);

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _photoUrl = finalUrl;
          _uploadingImage = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Rasm olishda xatolik: $e';
          _uploadingImage = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _ok() {
    final rate = context.read<CurrencyController>().usdRate;
    final paidUzsVal = parseInput(_paidUzs.text) ?? 0.0;
    final paidUsdVal = parseInput(_paidUsd.text) ?? 0.0;
    if (paidUzsVal < 0 || paidUsdVal < 0) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'To‘lov manfiy bo‘lishi mumkin emas';
      });
      return;
    }
    final totalEquivalent = paidUzsVal + (paidUsdVal * rate);
    final debt = (widget.total - totalEquivalent).clamp(0, double.infinity).toDouble();
    if (_isOrder) {
      if (_name.text.trim().isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Buyurtma uchun mijoz ismini kiritish shart';
        });
        return;
      }
    } else {
      if (debt > 0.5 && _name.text.trim().isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Nasiya uchun mijoz ismini kiriting';
        });
        return;
      }
    }
    final effectivePaid = totalEquivalent > widget.total ? widget.total : totalEquivalent;
    Navigator.pop(
      context,
      _CheckoutInput(
        paid: effectivePaid,
        currencyRate: rate,
        paidUzs: paidUzsVal,
        paidUsd: paidUsdVal,
        status: _isOrder ? 'order' : 'completed',
        note: _note.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _note.text.trim() : null,
        customerId: _selectedCustomerId,
        name: _name.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _name.text.trim() : null,
        phone: _phone.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _phone.text.trim() : null,
        passport: _passport.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _passport.text.trim() : null,
        photoUrl: _photoUrl,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final rate = context.watch<CurrencyController>().usdRate;
    final totalUsd = rate > 0 ? widget.total / rate : 0.0;
    final paidUzsVal = parseInput(_paidUzs.text) ?? 0.0;
    final paidUsdVal = parseInput(_paidUsd.text) ?? 0.0;
    final totalPaidEquivalent = paidUzsVal + (paidUsdVal * rate);
    final diff = totalPaidEquivalent - widget.total;
    final isOverpaid = diff > 0.5;
    final hasDebt = diff < -0.5;
    final debt = hasDebt ? -diff : 0.0;
    final change = isOverpaid ? diff : 0.0;

      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,

class _DesktopQrScannerDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _DesktopQrScannerDialog({required this.onCartUpdated});
  final VoidCallback onCartUpdated;

  @override
  State<_DesktopQrScannerDialog> createState() => _DesktopQrScannerDialogState();
}

class _DesktopQrScannerDialogState extends State<_DesktopQrScannerDialog> {
  final _inputCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _focusNode = FocusNode();

  String? _statusMessage;
  bool _isError = false;
  Product? _lastProduct;
  double _lastQty = 1.0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _focusNode.requestFocus();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _inputCtrl.dispose();
    _focusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _processCode(String rawCode) async {
    final code = rawCode.trim();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;

    if (isReceiptQr(code)) {
      final saleId = extractSaleId(code);
      if (saleId != null) {
        try {
          final sales = await context.read<AppRepositories>().sales.listSales(limit: 500);
          final matched = sales.where((s) => s.id == saleId).firstOrNull;
          if (matched != null && mounted) {
            HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
            SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click);
            _inputCtrl.clear();
            await ReceiptDialog.show(context, matched);
            return;
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    try {
      final repo = context.read<AppRepositories>().products;
      final p = await repo.findByCode(code);
      if (!mounted) return;

      if (p != null) {
        HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
        SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click);

        context.read<CartController>().add(p, quantity: 1);
        widget.onCartUpdated();

        setState(() {
          _isError = false;
          _statusMessage = '“${p.name}” savatga qo‘shildi (+1 ${_u(p.unit)})';
          _lastProduct = p;
          _lastQty = 1.0;
          _inputCtrl.clear();
        });
        _focusNode.requestFocus();
      } else {
        HapticFeedback.vibrate();
        setState(() {
          _isError = true;
          _statusMessage = 'Mahsulot topilmadi: "$code"';
        });
        _focusNode.requestFocus();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isError = true;
          _statusMessage = 'Xatolik: $e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _updateLastQty(double delta) {
    if (_lastProduct == null) return;
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();
    final p = _lastProduct!;

    if (delta > 0) {
      cart.add(p, quantity: delta);
      setState(() {
        _lastQty += delta;
      });
    } else if (delta < 0) {
      final existing = cart.lines.where((l) => l.product.id == p.id);
      if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
        final l = existing.first;
        if (l.quantity + delta > 0.001) {
          cart.update(l, quantity: l.quantity + delta);
          setState(() {
            _lastQty += delta;
          });
        } else {
          cart.remove(l);
          setState(() {
            _lastProduct = null;
            _lastQty = 1.0;
          });
        }
      }
    }
    widget.onCartUpdated();
    _focusNode.requestFocus();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cart = context.watch<CartController>();

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(22),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 40,
                    height: 40,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF132D21) : AppColors.greenSoft,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded, color: AppColors.green, size: 22),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          'QR / Barkod skaneri',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          'USB skaner yoki kod kiritish (F2)',

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import '../state/auth_controller.dart';
import 'common.dart';

class ProductionScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProductionScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ProductionScreen> createState() => _ProductionScreenState();
}

class _ProductionScreenState extends State<ProductionScreen> {
  late Future<List<ProductionTask>> _future;
  String _selectedFilter = 'Barchasi';
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();

  ProductionRepository get _repo => context.read<AppRepositories>().production;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _future = _repo.list();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reload() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final nextFuture = _repo.list();
    setState(() {
      _future = nextFuture;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _report(ProductionTask t) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => _ProductionReportDialog(task: t, repo: _repo),
    );

    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Bajarilgan ish omborga kirim qilindi');
      _reload();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _create() async {
    final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => TaskCreateDialog(
        productionRepo: repos.production,
        productRepo: repos.products,
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Topshiriq muvaffaqiyatli biriktirildi');
      _reload();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isAdmin = context.watch<AuthController>().user?.role == Role.admin;
    final filters = ['Barchasi', 'Jarayonda', 'Yakunlangan'];

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
      floatingActionButton: isAdmin
          ? FloatingActionButton.extended(
              onPressed: _create,
              icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded, color: AppColors.neonLime),
              label: const Text('Yangi topshiriq'),
            )
          : null,
      body: FutureBuilder<List<ProductionTask>>(
        future: _future,
        builder: (context, snap) {
          if (snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (snap.hasError) {
            return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reload);
          }

          final allTasks = snap.data ?? [];
          var displayTasks = List<ProductionTask>.from(allTasks);

          if (_selectedFilter == 'Jarayonda') {
            displayTasks = displayTasks.where((t) => t.status != 'done').toList();
          } else if (_selectedFilter == 'Yakunlangan') {
            displayTasks = displayTasks.where((t) => t.status == 'done').toList();
          }

          final q = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (q.isNotEmpty) {
            displayTasks = displayTasks.where((t) {
              final pName = t.productName.toLowerCase();
              final wName = t.workerName.toLowerCase();
              return pName.contains(q) || wName.contains(q) || t.id.toString() == q;
            }).toList();
          }

          final total = allTasks.length;
          final inProgress = allTasks.where((t) => t.status != 'done').length;
          final done = allTasks.where((t) => t.status == 'done').length;
          final totalPlanned = allTasks.fold<double>(0, (a, b) => a + b.planned);
          final totalProduced = allTasks.fold<double>(0, (a, b) => a + b.produced);
          final completionRate = totalPlanned > 0 ? (totalProduced / totalPlanned * 100).clamp(0, 100) : 0.0;

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async {
              _reload();
              await _future;
            },
            child: LayoutBuilder(
              builder: (context, constraints) {
                final isDesktop = constraints.maxWidth >= 720;

                return ListView(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(isDesktop ? 28.0 : 12.0, 8, isDesktop ? 28.0 : 12.0, 80),
                  children: [
                    // Yuqori statistika paneli
                    if (isDesktop)
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Jami Topshiriqlar',
                              '$total ta',
                              Icons.precision_manufacturing_rounded,
                              AppColors.neonLime,
                              true,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Jarayondagi Ishlar',
                              '$inProgress ta',
                              Icons.pending_actions_rounded,
                              const Color(0xFFC77700),
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Bajarilgan Ishlar',
                              '$done ta',
                              Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                              AppColors.green,
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Umumiy Ish Quvvati',
                              '${completionRate.toStringAsFixed(1)}%',
                              Icons.speed_rounded,
                              const Color(0xFF3B82F6),
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),

                      )
                    else ...[

                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Row(

                                                foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),

                                              label: const Text('Hisobot', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 11)),
                                            ),

                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                                      Row(
                                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                                        children: [
                                          Text(

                                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13),

                                    ],

                          );
                        },
                      ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStat(BuildContext context, String title, String value, IconData icon, Color color, bool isHeroCard) {
    final isDarkTheme = context.isDark;
    final isHero = isHeroCard && !isDarkTheme;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 38,
            height: 38,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF22262B) : color.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 20),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

                Text(
                  title,
                  style: TextStyle(color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF8E959E) : context.mutedColor, fontSize: 11),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  value,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: isHero ? Colors.white : context.inkColor,
                    fontSize: 17,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,

              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class TaskCreateDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const TaskCreateDialog({super.key, required this.productionRepo, required this.productRepo});
  final ProductionRepository productionRepo;
  final ProductRepository productRepo;

  @override
  State<TaskCreateDialog> createState() => _TaskCreateDialogState();
}

class _TaskCreateDialogState extends State<TaskCreateDialog> {
  late Future<({List<Product> products, List<AppUser> workers})> _loadFuture;
  int? _selectedProductId;
  int? _selectedWorkerId;
  final _planCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadFuture = _loadData();
  }

  Future<({List<Product> products, List<AppUser> workers})> _loadData() async {
    final p = await widget.productRepo.list();
    var w = await widget.productionRepo.workers();
    if (w.isEmpty && mounted) {
      // Fallback: Agar maxsus ishchi topilmasa, tizimdagi faol xodimlarni olamiz
      final all = await context.read<AppRepositories>().users.list();
      w = all.where((u) => u.isActive).toList();
    }
    if (p.isNotEmpty) _selectedProductId = p.first.id;
    if (w.isNotEmpty) _selectedWorkerId = w.first.id;
    return (products: p, workers: w);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _planCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_selectedProductId == null || _selectedWorkerId == null) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Mahsulot va ishchini tanlang';
      });
      return;
    }
    final planned = parseInput(_planCtrl.text);
    if (planned == null || planned <= 0) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Reja miqdorini to‘g‘ri kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      await widget.productionRepo.create(
        productId: _selectedProductId!,
        workerId: _selectedWorkerId!,
        plannedQty: planned,
      );
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _busy = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<({List<Product> products, List<AppUser> workers})>(
      future: _loadFuture,
      builder: (ctx, snap) {
        if (!snap.hasData) {
          return const AlertDialog(
            content: SizedBox(
              height: 100,
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            ),
          );
        }

        final products = snap.data!.products;
        final workers = snap.data!.workers;

        if (products.isEmpty) {
          return AlertDialog(
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
            title: const Text('Mahsulotlar mavjud emas'),
            content: const Text('Topshiriq berish uchun avval "Mahsulotlar" bo‘limidan mahsulot qo‘shing.'),
            actions: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('OK')),
            ],
          );
        }

        if (workers.isEmpty) {
          return AlertDialog(
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
            title: const Text('Xodimlar mavjud emas'),
            content: const Text('Topshiriq biriktirish uchun "Xodimlar" bo‘limidan ishchi qo‘shing.'),
            actions: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('OK')),
            ],
          );
        }

        _selectedProductId ??= products.first.id;
        _selectedWorkerId ??= workers.first.id;

        final selProd = products.where((p) => p.id == _selectedProductId).firstOrNull ?? products.first;

        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
          title: const Text('Yangi Ishlab Chiqarish Topshirig‘i', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 380,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                    value: _selectedProductId,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Ishlab chiqariladigan mahsulot'),
                    items: [for (final p in products) DropdownMenuItem(value: p.id, child: Text(p.name))],
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedProductId = v;
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                    value: _selectedWorkerId,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Biriktirilgan ishchi'),
                    items: [for (final w in workers) DropdownMenuItem(value: w.id, child: Text(w.fullName))],
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      setState(() {
                        _selectedWorkerId = v;
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _planCtrl,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Rejadagi miqdor (${selProd.unit})',
                      hintText: 'masalan: 120',
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_error != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                      child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12)),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Bekor'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 12),
              ),
              child: _busy
                  ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                  : const Text('Topshiriq berish', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _ProductionReportDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ProductionReportDialog({required this.task, required this.repo});
  final ProductionTask task;
  final ProductionRepository repo;

  @override
  State<_ProductionReportDialog> createState() => _ProductionReportDialogState();
}

class _ProductionReportDialogState extends State<_ProductionReportDialog> {
  late final double _remaining;
  late final TextEditingController _ctrl;
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _remaining = (widget.task.planned - widget.task.produced).clamp(0, double.infinity).toDouble();
    _ctrl = TextEditingController(text: qty(_remaining > 0 ? _remaining : 1));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _ctrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final v = parseInput(_ctrl.text);
    if (v == null || v <= 0) {
      setState(() => _error = 'Miqdorni to‘g‘ri kiriting');
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await widget.repo.report(widget.task.id, v);
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _busy = false;
          _error = e.toString();
        });
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = widget.task;
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      title: Text(
        '${t.productName}: Ish hisoboti',
        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18),
      ),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 360,
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: context.pillColor,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, color: AppColors.muted, size: 20),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'Reja: ${qty(t.planned)} ${t.unit}  ·  Bajarilgan: ${qty(t.produced)} ${t.unit}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            TextField(
              controller: _ctrl,
              autofocus: true,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Yangi ishlab chiqarilgan miqdor (${t.unit})',
              ),
              onChanged: (_) {
                if (_error != null) setState(() => _error = null);
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              children: [
                if (_remaining > 0)
                  ActionChip(
                    label: Text('Qoldiqni yakunlash (${qty(_remaining)})'),
                    onPressed: () {
                      setState(() => _ctrl.text = qty(_remaining));
                    },
                  ),
                ActionChip(
                  label: const Text('+1 dona/m²'),
                  onPressed: () {
                    final cur = parseInput(_ctrl.text) ?? 0;
                    setState(() => _ctrl.text = qty(cur + 1));
                  },
                ),
                ActionChip(
                  label: const Text('+5'),
                  onPressed: () {
                    final cur = parseInput(_ctrl.text) ?? 0;
                    setState(() => _ctrl.text = qty(cur + 5));
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (_error != null)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12)),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
          child: const Text('Bekor'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit,
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
            foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
          ),
          child: _busy
              ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
              : const Text('Yuborish'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class ProductsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProductsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ProductsScreen> createState() => _ProductsScreenState();
}

class _ProductsScreenState extends State<ProductsScreen> {
  final _search = TextEditingController();
  late Future<List<Product>> _future;
  String _selectedFilter = 'Barchasi';

  ProductRepository get _repo => context.read<AppRepositories>().products;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _future = _repo.list();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reload() {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _future = _repo.list();
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _edit([Product? p]) async {
    final saved = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => ProductDialog(repo: _repo, product: p),
    );
    if (saved == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, p == null ? 'Yangi mahsulot saqlandi' : 'Mahsulot yangilandi');
      _reload();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showQrLabel(Product p) async {
    await showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => ProductQrLabelDialog(
        productName: p.name,
        qrCode: p.qrCode.isNotEmpty ? p.qrCode : (p.sku.isNotEmpty ? p.sku : 'STX-${p.id}'),
        sku: p.sku,
        price: p.price,
        unit: p.unit,
        product: p,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _delete(Product p) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
        title: const Text('Mahsulotni faolsizlantirish', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        content: Text(
          '"${p.name}" ro‘yxatdan olib tashlansinmi?\n(Oldingi savdo va ombor tarixi saqlanadi)',
          style: const TextStyle(height: 1.4, color: AppColors.muted),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Bekor'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.danger),
            child: const Text('O‘chirish'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    try {
      await _repo.deactivate(p.id);
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, '${p.name} ro‘yxatdan olindi');
        _reload();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(context, e.toString(), error: true);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filters = ['Barchasi', 'Toshlar (m²)', 'Sortli', 'Dona', 'Kam qolgan'];

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton.extended(
        onPressed: () => _edit(),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded, color: AppColors.neonLime),
        label: const Text('Mahsulot qo‘shish'),

      body: FutureBuilder<List<Product>>(
        future: _future,

            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());

  Widget _buildMiniStat({
    required BuildContext context,
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color accentColor,
    required bool isHeroCard,
    bool isCompact = false,
  }) {
    final isDarkTheme = context.isDark;
    final isHero = isHeroCard && !isDarkTheme;

    return Container(
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(isCompact ? 12 : 18),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: isCompact ? 34 : 40,
            height: isCompact ? 34 : 40,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF22262B) : accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: accentColor, size: isCompact ? 18 : 20),
          ),
          SizedBox(width: isCompact ? 8 : 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  title,
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF8E959E) : context.mutedColor,
                    fontSize: isCompact ? 10.5 : 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                FittedBox(
                  fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Text(
                    value,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: isHero ? Colors.white : context.inkColor,
                      fontSize: isCompact ? 15 : 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// Mahsulot qo'shish va tahrirlash dialogi

class ProductDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ProductDialog({super.key, required this.repo, this.product});
  final ProductRepository repo;
  final Product? product;

  @override
  State<ProductDialog> createState() => _ProductDialogState();
}

class _ProductDialogState extends State<ProductDialog> {
  late final _name = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.name);
  late final _sku = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.product?.sku.isNotEmpty == true
        ? widget.product!.sku
        : (widget.product?.qrCode ?? ''),
  );
  late final _price = TextEditingController(text: widget.product == null ? '' : qty(widget.product!.price));
  late final _cost = TextEditingController(text: widget.product == null ? '' : qty(widget.product!.costPrice));
  late final _thickness = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.thickness != null ? qty(widget.product!.thickness!) : '');
  late final _tileLength = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.tileLength != null ? qty(widget.product!.tileLength!) : '');
  late final _tileWidth = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.tileWidth != null ? qty(widget.product!.tileWidth!) : '');
  late final _boxPieces = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.boxPieces != null ? widget.product!.boxPieces.toString() : '');
  late final _imageUrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.imageUrl);
  final _stock = TextEditingController();
  final _stockPachka = TextEditingController();
  late final _minStock = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.product?.minStock != null
        ? (widget.product!.minStock == widget.product!.minStock.roundToDouble()
            ? widget.product!.minStock.toInt().toString()
            : widget.product!.minStock.toString())
        : '15',
  );
  final _minStockPachka = TextEditingController();
  late final _sort = TextEditingController(text: widget.product?.sort ?? widget.product?.color ?? "");
  late String? _category = widget.product?.category;
  late String _unit = widget.product?.unit ?? 'm2';
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;
  bool _uploadingImage = false;

  static const _units = ['m2', 'dona', 'kg', 'm', 'litr'];

  double? _calcTileDonaM2() {
    final l = parseInput(_tileLength.text);
    final w = parseInput(_tileWidth.text);
    if (l != null && l > 0 && w != null && w > 0) {
      return (l * w) / 10000.0;
    }
    return null;
  }

  double? _calcTileBoxM2() {
    final dona = _calcTileDonaM2();
    final pcs = int.tryParse(_boxPieces.text.trim());
    if (dona != null && pcs != null && pcs > 0) {
      return dona * pcs;
    }
    return null;
  }

  static String _formatNum(double v) {
    if (v == v.roundToDouble()) {
      return v.toInt().toString();
    }
    return v.toStringAsFixed(2).replaceAll(RegExp(r'0+$'), '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'\.$'), '');
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final boxM2 = widget.product?.effectiveBoxM2;
    if (boxM2 != null && boxM2 > 0) {
      final minM2 = parseInput(_minStock.text);
      if (minM2 != null) {
        _minStockPachka.text = _formatNum(minM2 / boxM2);
      }
    }
  }

    _name.dispose();
    _sku.dispose();
    _price.dispose();
    _cost.dispose();
    _thickness.dispose();
    _tileLength.dispose();
    _tileWidth.dispose();
    _boxPieces.dispose();
    _imageUrl.dispose();
    _stock.dispose();
    _stockPachka.dispose();
    _minStock.dispose();
    _minStockPachka.dispose();
    _sort.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  double? _effectiveBoxM2() {
    return _calcTileBoxM2() ?? widget.product?.effectiveBoxM2;
  }

  void _onStockPachkaChanged(String val) {
    final boxM2 = _effectiveBoxM2();
    if (boxM2 == null || boxM2 <= 0) return;
    final p = parseInput(val);
    if (p != null) {
      final m2 = p * boxM2;
      final formatted = _formatNum(m2);
      if (_stock.text != formatted) {
        _stock.value = TextEditingValue(
          text: formatted,
          selection: TextSelection.collapsed(offset: formatted.length),
        );
      }
    } else if (val.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (_stock.text.isNotEmpty) {
        _stock.value = const TextEditingValue(text: "");
      }
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _recalculatePachkasWhenDimensionsChange() {
    final boxM2 = _effectiveBoxM2();
    if (boxM2 != null && boxM2 > 0) {
      final sVal = parseInput(_stock.text);
      if (sVal != null) {
        final p = _formatNum(sVal / boxM2);
        if (_stockPachka.text != p) _stockPachka.text = p;
      }
      final mVal = parseInput(_minStock.text);
      if (mVal != null) {
        final p = _formatNum(mVal / boxM2);
        if (_minStockPachka.text != p) _minStockPachka.text = p;
      }
    }
  }

  IconData _getCategoryIcon(String cat) {
    switch (cat.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'granit':

      case 'kerama granit':
        return Icons.grid_view_rounded;
      case 'kafel':
        return Icons.dashboard_customize_rounded;
      case 'marmar':
        return Icons.diamond_outlined;
      case 'tayyor mahsulot':
        return Icons.inventory_2_outlined;
      case 'xomashyo':
        return Icons.architecture_rounded;
      case 'qo‘shimcha':
      case 'qoshimcha':
        return Icons.extension_outlined;
      default:
        return Icons.category_rounded;
    }

  Color _getCategoryColor(String cat) {
    switch (cat.toLowerCase()) {

      case 'kafel':
        return const Color(0xFF0D9488);
      case 'marmar':
        return const Color(0xFF8B5CF6);
      case 'tayyor mahsulot':
        return const Color(0xFF2563EB);

        return const Color(0xFFEA580C);
      case 'qo‘shimcha':

        return const Color(0xFFE11D48);
      default:
        return AppColors.green;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _pickAndUploadImage() async {
    setState(() {
      _uploadingImage = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final picker = ImagePicker();
      final picked = await picker.pickImage(
        source: ImageSource.gallery,
        maxWidth: 1200,
        maxHeight: 1200,
        imageQuality: 85,
      );

      if (picked == null) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _uploadingImage = false);
        return;
      }

      final fileBytes = await picked.readAsBytes();
      if (fileBytes.isEmpty) {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _uploadingImage = false);
        return;
      }

      final pickedFilename = picked.name.isNotEmpty
          ? picked.name
          : 'product_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}.jpg';

      // Rasmni avval ixcham qilib siqish (Base64)
      String finalImageValue;
      try {
        final decoded = img.decodeImage(Uint8List.fromList(fileBytes));
        if (decoded != null) {
          final resized = (decoded.width > 360 || decoded.height > 360)
              ? img.copyResize(
                  decoded,
                  width: decoded.width >= decoded.height ? 360 : null,
                  height: decoded.height > decoded.width ? 360 : null,
                )
              : decoded;
          final jpgBytes = img.encodeJpg(resized, quality: 78);
          finalImageValue = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(jpgBytes)}';
        } else {
          finalImageValue = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(fileBytes)}';
        }
      } catch (_) {
        finalImageValue = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,${base64Encode(fileBytes)}';
      }

      // Agar serverda upload yo'li mavjud bo'lsa, yuklashga urinib ko'ramiz
      try {
        final uploadedUrl = await widget.repo.uploadImage(
          fileBytes,
          pickedFilename,
        );
        if (uploadedUrl.isNotEmpty) {
          finalImageValue = uploadedUrl;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        // Serverda upload yo'li bo'lmasa yoki xato bersa, siqilgan Base64 rasm bevosita ishlatiladi
      }

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _imageUrl.text = finalImageValue;
          _uploadingImage = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _uploadingImage = false;
          _error = 'Rasm tanlashda xatolik: $e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _autoGenerateBarcode() {
    final cleanName = _name.text
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Z0-9]'), '-')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'-+'), '-');
    final suffix = (DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch % 900) + 100;
    final code = cleanName.isNotEmpty ? 'STX-$cleanName' : 'STX-PROD-$suffix';
    setState(() {
      _sku.text = code;
    });
  }

  void _autoGenerateQr() => _autoGenerateBarcode();

  void _previewQrLabel(BuildContext context) {
    final qrData = _sku.text.trim();
    if (qrData.isEmpty) return;
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => ProductQrLabelDialog(
        productName: _name.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _name.text.trim() : 'Nomsiz Mahsulot',
        qrCode: qrData,
        sku: qrData,
        price: parseInput(_price.text) ?? (widget.product?.price ?? 0),
        unit: _unit,
        product: widget.product,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final thick = parseInput(_thickness.text);
    final price = parseInput(_price.text);
    final cost = _cost.text.trim().isEmpty ? 0.0 : parseInput(_cost.text);
    final rawStock = _stock.text.trim().isEmpty ? 0.0 : parseInput(_stock.text);
    final rawMinStock = _minStock.text.trim().isEmpty ? 15.0 : parseInput(_minStock.text);

    if (_name.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Nomini kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }
    if (price == null || price < 0) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Sotuv narxini to‘g‘ri kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }
    if (cost == null || cost < 0 || rawStock == null || rawStock < 0 || rawMinStock == null || rawMinStock < 0) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Raqamlarni to‘g‘ri kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }

    final barcode = _sku.text.trim();
    final isTile = _category != null &&
        (_category!.trim().toLowerCase() == 'kafel' ||
            _category!.trim().toLowerCase() == 'kerama granit');
    final tLen = isTile ? parseInput(_tileLength.text) : null;
    final tWid = isTile ? parseInput(_tileWidth.text) : null;
    final bPieces = isTile ? int.tryParse(_boxPieces.text.trim()) : null;
    double? calculatedDonaM2;
    double? calculatedBoxM2;
    if (isTile && tLen != null && tLen > 0 && tWid != null && tWid > 0) {
      calculatedDonaM2 = (tLen * tWid) / 10000.0;
      if (bPieces != null && bPieces > 0) {
        calculatedBoxM2 = calculatedDonaM2 * bPieces;
      }
    }

    final boxM2 = calculatedBoxM2 ?? widget.product?.effectiveBoxM2;
    double effectiveStock = rawStock;
    if (effectiveStock == 0 && _stockPachka.text.trim().isNotEmpty && boxM2 != null && boxM2 > 0) {
      effectiveStock = (parseInput(_stockPachka.text) ?? 0.0) * boxM2;
    }

    double effectiveMinStock = rawMinStock;
    if (effectiveMinStock == 0 && _minStockPachka.text.trim().isNotEmpty && boxM2 != null && boxM2 > 0) {
      effectiveMinStock = (parseInput(_minStockPachka.text) ?? 0.0) * boxM2;
    }

    final p = Product(
      id: widget.product?.id ?? 0,
      name: _name.text.trim(),
      category: _category,
      sku: barcode,
      qrCode: barcode,
      unit: _unit,
      donaM2: isTile
          ? calculatedDonaM2
          : (_unit == 'm2' ? (widget.product?.donaM2 ?? Units.stoneDonaM2) : null),
      thickness: (_category?.trim().toLowerCase() == 'granit' && thick != null && thick > 0)
          ? thick
          : null,
      tileLength: tLen,
      tileWidth: tWid,
      boxPieces: bPieces,
      boxM2: calculatedBoxM2,
      sort: _sort.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _sort.text.trim() : null,
      hasSorts: false,
      color: _sort.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _sort.text.trim() : null,
      price: price,
      costPrice: cost,
      minStock: effectiveMinStock,
      imageUrl: _imageUrl.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? _imageUrl.text.trim() : null,
    );

    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      if (widget.product == null) {
        final created = await widget.repo.create(p, initialStock: effectiveStock);
        LocalImageStore.saveImage(created.id, p.imageUrl, created.name);
      } else {
        LocalImageStore.saveImage(p.id, p.imageUrl, p.name);
        await widget.repo.update(p);
      }
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

                      builder: (_) {
                        try {
                          if (currentUrl.startsWith('data:image/') || currentUrl.contains(';base64,')) {
                            final comma = currentUrl.indexOf(',');

                            errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const Center(
                              child: Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined, size: 36, color: AppColors.muted),

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  boxShadow: const [

                child: Column(

                          decoration: const BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFF0F9D58), shape: BoxShape.circle),

                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        const Text(
                          'NTM ERP',

                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    QrImageView(
                      data: qrData,

                    const SizedBox(height: 6),

                        fontSize: 11,

                    if (_name.text.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[

                      Text(

                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(

                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, size: 17),
                  tooltip: 'Kodni nusxalash',
                  onPressed: () {
                    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: qrData));
                    showMessage(context, 'QR kod nusxalandi: $qrData');
