```dart
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ] else ...[
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
              alignment: Alignment.center,
              child: Column(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.qr_code_2_rounded, size: 36, color: AppColors.muted),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Text(
                    'QR kod hali kiritilmagan',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: AppColors.muted),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  FilledButton.tonalIcon(
                    onPressed: _autoGenerateQr,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, size: 15),
                    label: const Text('Avtomatik QR yaratish', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5)),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isNew = widget.product == null;

    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      title: Text(isNew ? 'Yangi Mahsulot Qo‘shish' : 'Mahsulotni Tahrirlash',
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18)),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 480,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              _buildImagePicker(context),
              TextField(
                controller: _name,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Mahsulot nomi'),
                onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    flex: 1,
                    child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: standardProductCategories.contains(_category) ? _category : null,
                      dropdownColor: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E2631) : Colors.white,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      elevation: 8,
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded, size: 20),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: context.inkColor,
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Kategoriya',
                        prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.category_rounded, size: 18),
                        suffixIcon: _category != null
                            ? IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_rounded, size: 16),
                                tooltip: 'Tozalash',
                                onPressed: () => setState(() => _category = null),
                              )
                            : null,
                        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 12),
                      ),
                      hint: const Text('Tanlang', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5)),
                      selectedItemBuilder: (BuildContext context) {
                        return standardProductCategories.map<Widget>((String cat) {
                          final color = _getCategoryColor(cat);
                          return Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(5),
                                ),
                                child: Icon(_getCategoryIcon(cat), size: 13, color: color),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Flexible(
                                child: Text(
                                  cat,
                                  maxLines: 1,
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    color: context.inkColor,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          );
                        }).toList();
                      },
                      items: [
                        for (final cat in standardProductCategories)
                          DropdownMenuItem(
                            value: cat,
                            child: Builder(
                              builder: (context) {
                                final isSel = _category == cat;
                                final color = _getCategoryColor(cat);
                                return Row(
                                  children: [
                                    Container(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                        color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                      ),
                                      child: Icon(_getCategoryIcon(cat), size: 16, color: color),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        cat,
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 13,
                                          fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                                          color: isSel
                                              ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : color)
                                              : context.inkColor,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    if (isSel)
                                      Icon(
                                        Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                        size: 18,
                                        color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : color,
                                      ),
                                  ],
                                );
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _category = v),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Expanded(
                    flex: 1,
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: _sort,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Turi (Sort, Rang...)',
                        hintText: '1-sort, Qora...',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.style_outlined, size: 18),
                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 12),
                      ),
                      onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: _sku,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Shtrix kod (Barcode)',
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.qr_code_scanner_rounded, size: 20),
                  suffixIcon: IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, size: 18),
                    tooltip: 'Avto-kod generatsiya qilish',
                    onPressed: _autoGenerateBarcode,
                  ),
                ),
                onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: _unit,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Bazaviy o‘lchov birligi'),
                items: [for (final u in _units) DropdownMenuItem(value: u, child: Text(u))],
                onChanged: (v) {
                  setState(() {
                    _unit = v ?? _unit;
                  });
                },
              ),


              if (_category != null &&
                  (_category!.trim().toLowerCase() == 'kafel' ||
                      _category!.trim().toLowerCase() == 'kerama granit')) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF1B2028) : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0D9488)).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                      width: 1.2,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            _getCategoryIcon(_category!),
                            size: 18,
                            color: _getCategoryColor(_category!),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            '$_category o‘lchamlari va Pachka hisobi',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              color: context.inkColor,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: _tileLength,
                              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Bo‘yi (sm)',
                                hintText: '60 yoki 120',
                                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.height_rounded, size: 18),
                              ),
                              onChanged: (_) {
                                _recalculatePachkasWhenDimensionsChange();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: _tileWidth,
                              keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Eni (sm)',
                                hintText: '60',
                                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.straighten_rounded, size: 18),
                              ),
                              onChanged: (_) {
                                _recalculatePachkasWhenDimensionsChange();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: TextField(
                              controller: _boxPieces,
                              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                                labelText: 'Pachkada (dona)',
                                hintText: '4',
                                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.all_inbox_rounded, size: 18),
                              ),
                              onChanged: (_) {
                                _recalculatePachkasWhenDimensionsChange();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      Builder(
                        builder: (context) {
                          final donaM2 = _calcTileDonaM2();
                          final boxM2 = _calcTileBoxM2();
                          if (donaM2 == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
                          final donaFormatted = donaM2.toStringAsFixed(4).replaceAll(RegExp(r'0+$'), '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'\.$'), '');
                          final boxFormatted = boxM2 != null ? boxM2.toStringAsFixed(4).replaceAll(RegExp(r'0+$'), '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'\.$'), '') : null;
                          return Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0D9488)).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0D9488)).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  Icon(
                                    Icons.calculate_rounded,
                                    size: 18,
                                    color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0F766E),
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      '1 dona = $donaFormatted m²'
                                      '${boxFormatted != null ? '  •  1 pachka (${_boxPieces.text.trim()} dona) = $boxFormatted m²' : ''}',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF0F766E),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              if (_category != null && _category!.trim().toLowerCase() == 'granit') ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: _thickness,
                  keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Granit qalinligi (sm)',
                    hintText: 'Masalan: 2.0 yoki 1.8',
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.layers_outlined, size: 20),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: _price,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Sotuv narxi (so‘m / $_unit)',
                ),
                onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: _cost,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Tannarx (so‘m)'),
              ),
              if (isNew) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _buildDualStockCard(
                  title: 'Boshlang‘ich ombor qoldig‘i',
                  subtitle: 'Yangi mahsulot uchun ombordagi dastlabki miqdor',
                  m2Controller: _stock,
                  pachkaController: _stockPachka,
                  onM2Changed: _onStockM2Changed,
                  onPachkaChanged: _onStockPachkaChanged,
                  icon: Icons.inventory_2_outlined,
                  iconColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.green,
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildDualStockCard(
                title: 'Minimal ombor qoldig‘i',
                subtitle: 'Omborda kamida qancha bo‘lishi kerak (ogohlantirish chegarasi)',
                m2Controller: _minStock,
                pachkaController: _minStockPachka,
                onM2Changed: _onMinStockM2Changed,
                onPachkaChanged: _onMinStockPachkaChanged,
                icon: Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
                iconColor: const Color(0xFFD97706),
              ),

              // Haqiqiy jonli QR-kod stiker ko'rinishi
              _buildLiveQrPreview(context),

              if (_error != null)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                  child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12)),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
          child: const Text('Bekor'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _save,
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
            foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
          ),
          child: _busy
              ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
              : const Text('Saqlash'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class ProductQrLabelDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProductQrLabelDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.productName,
    required this.qrCode,
    this.sku = '',
    required this.price,
    this.unit = 'm2',
    this.product,
  });

  final String productName;
  final String qrCode;
  final String sku;
  final double price;
  final String unit;
  final Product? product;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final cleanCode = qrCode.trim().isNotEmpty ? qrCode.trim() : 'NO-CODE';

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 420),
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // Sarlavha
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 36,
                    height: 36,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF132D21) : AppColors.greenSoft,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    ),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.qr_code_2_rounded, color: AppColors.green, size: 20),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  const Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text('Mahsulot QR Yorlig‘i',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        Text('Chop etish va kassa skaneri uchun stiker',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.muted)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 18),

              // Oq chop etiladigan stiker kartasi
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 280,
                  constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: math.max(200.0, MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width - 80.0)),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 14),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFD0D7DE), width: 1.2),
                    boxShadow: const [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Color(0x1A000000),
                        blurRadius: 16,
                        offset: Offset(0, 6),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      // Kompaniya logotipi / stiker sarlavhasi
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 8,
                            height: 8,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              color: Color(0xFF0F9D58),
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          const Text(
                            'NTM MARBLE',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                              letterSpacing: 1.2,
                              color: Colors.black,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 1),
                      const Text(
                        'Tosh ishlab chiqarish majmuasi',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 8.5, color: Color(0xFF57606A), fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                      ),
                      const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                        child: Divider(color: Color(0xFFE1E4E8), height: 1, thickness: 1),
                      ),

                      // Haqiqiy skanerlanadigan QR Kod
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFEAECEF), width: 1),
                        ),
                        child: QrImageView(
                          data: cleanCode,
                          version: QrVersions.auto,
                          size: math.min(180.0, math.max(120.0, MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width - 130.0)),
                          backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                          eyeStyle: const QrEyeStyle(
                            eyeShape: QrEyeShape.square,
                            color: Colors.black,
                          ),
                          dataModuleStyle: const QrDataModuleStyle(
                            dataModuleShape: QrDataModuleShape.square,
                            color: Colors.black,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      const SizedBox(height: 8),

                      // QR Kod matni
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: const Color(0xFFF6F8FA),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE1E4E8)),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          cleanCode,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'monospace',
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.2,
                            color: Colors.black,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      const SizedBox(height: 8),

                      // Mahsulot nomi
                      Text(
                        productName,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                          color: Colors.black,
                        ),
                      ),

                      const SizedBox(height: 4),

                      // Narx va o'lchov birligi
                      Text(
                        '${money(price)} / $unit',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          color: Color(0xFF1B5E20),
                        ),
                      ),

                      const SizedBox(height: 6),

                      // Pastki izoh
                      Row(
                        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              sku.isNotEmpty ? 'SKU: $sku' : 'NTM ERP',
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: Color(0xFF6E7781), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(
                            'Sana: ${DateTime.now().year}-${DateTime.now().month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${DateTime.now().day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: Color(0xFF6E7781), fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 18),

              // Harakat tugmalari
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () {
                        Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: cleanCode));
                        showMessage(context, 'QR kod nusxalandi: $cleanCode');
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, size: 16),
                      label: const Text('Nusxalash', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5)),
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () {
                        showMessage(context, '🖨️ Yorliq chop etishga yuborildi: [$productName]');
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.print_rounded, size: 16),
                      label: const Text('Chop etish', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                        foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              if (product != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton.tonalIcon(
                    onPressed: () {
                      context.read<CartController>().add(product!);
                      showMessage(context, '✅ “$productName” kassa savatiga qo‘shildi!');
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_shopping_cart_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Kassa savatiga qo‘shish (Sinash)',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'common.dart';

class PurchasesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PurchasesScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PurchasesScreen> createState() => _PurchasesScreenState();
}

class _PurchasesScreenState extends State<PurchasesScreen> {
  late Future<List<StockMovementRecord>> _movementsFuture;
  late Future<List<Product>> _productsFuture;
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _dateFilter = 'Barchasi';

  StockRepository get _stockRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().stock;
  ProductRepository get _productRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().products;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _loadData() {
    setState(() {
      _movementsFuture = _stockRepo.movements();
      _productsFuture = _productRepo.list();
    });
  }

  bool _matchesDate(DateTime dt) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    switch (_dateFilter) {
      case 'Bugun':
        return dt.year == now.year && dt.month == now.month && dt.day == now.day;
      case 'Shu hafta':
        final startOfWeek = now.subtract(Duration(days: now.weekday - 1));
        final zeroStart = DateTime(startOfWeek.year, startOfWeek.month, startOfWeek.day);
        return dt.isAfter(zeroStart);
      case 'Shu oy':
        return dt.year == now.year && dt.month == now.month;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openNewPurchaseDialog(List<Product> products) async {
    if (products.isEmpty) {
      showMessage(context, 'Kirim qilish uchun avval mahsulot qo‘shilgan bo‘lishi kerak', error: true);
      return;
    }

    Product selected = products.first;
    final qtyCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final costCtrl = TextEditingController(text: selected.costPrice > 0 ? selected.costPrice.round().toString() : '');
    final supplierCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
    String paymentMethod = 'cash';
    bool inDona = false;
    bool inPachka = false;
    bool busy = false;
    String? errorText;

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) {
          final q = parseInput(qtyCtrl.text) ?? 0;
          final c = parseInput(costCtrl.text) ?? 0;
          final totalEst = q * c;

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
            title: const Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.add_shopping_cart_rounded, color: AppColors.neonLime, size: 24),
                SizedBox(width: 10),
                Text('Yangi Xarid Kirimi', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18)),
              ],
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 440,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    if (errorText != null)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.red.withOpacity(0.15),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          border: Border.all(color: Colors.red.withOpacity(0.3)),
                        ),
                        child: Text(errorText!, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 13)),
                      ),

                    // Mahsulot tanlash
                    DropdownButtonFormField<Product>(
                      value: selected,
                      isExpanded: true,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Xarid qilinayotgan tovar / xomashyo'),
                      items: products.map((p) => DropdownMenuItem(
                        value: p,
                        child: Text(
                          '${p.name} (Hozir: ${p.stock.toStringAsFixed(1)} ${p.unit})',
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      )).toList(),
                      onChanged: (p) {
                        if (p != null) {
                          setS(() {
                            selected = p;
                            inDona = false;
                            inPachka = false;
                            if (p.costPrice > 0) {
                              costCtrl.text = p.costPrice.round().toString();
                            }
                          });
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // Miqdor va O'lchov
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          flex: 3,
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: qtyCtrl,
                            keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Miqdor (${inPachka ? 'pachka' : (inDona ? 'dona' : selected.unit)})',
                              hintText: 'Masalan: 50',
                            ),
                            onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (selected.hasPachka) ...[
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          FilterChip(
                            label: Text('pachka (${qty(selected.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1)} m²)', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                            selected: inPachka,
                            onSelected: (v) => setS(() {
                              inPachka = v;
                              if (inPachka) inDona = false;
                            }),
                          ),
                        ] else if (selected.hasDona) ...[
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          FilterChip(
                            label: const Text('dona', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                            selected: inDona,
                            onSelected: (v) => setS(() {
                              inDona = v;
                              if (inDona) inPachka = false;
                            }),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // Xarid narxi (Tannarx)
                    TextField(
                      controller: costCtrl,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Birlik xarid narxi (so‘m)',
                        hintText: '1 ${selected.unit} narxi',
                        suffixText: 'so‘m',
                      ),
                      onChanged: (_) => setS(() {}),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // Jami xarid summasi indikatori
                    if (totalEst > 0)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: AppColors.neonLime.withOpacity(0.12),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: AppColors.neonLime.withOpacity(0.3)),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                          children: [
                            const Text('Jami xarid summasi:', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13)),
                            Text(money(totalEst), style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontSize: 16, color: AppColors.neonLime)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // Yetkazib beruvchi / Ta'minotchi
                    TextField(
                      controller: supplierCtrl,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Yetkazib beruvchi (Ta‘minotchi)',
                        hintText: 'Masalan: Navoiy Marmar MCHJ, Xurshid aka',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.business_rounded, size: 20),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // To'lov turi
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: paymentMethod,
                      isExpanded: true,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'To‘lov usuli'),
                      items: const [
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'cash', child: Text('Naqd pul', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'bank', child: Text('Bank o‘tkazmasi (Hisob raqam)', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'card', child: Text('Korporativ karta', overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (v) {
                        if (v != null) setS(() => paymentMethod = v);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),

                    // Qo'shimcha izoh / Yuk xati
                    TextField(
                      controller: noteCtrl,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Hujjat raqami / Izoh',
                        hintText: 'Masalan: Yuk xati #4582, Toshkent omboriga',
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.note_alt_rounded, size: 20),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
              ),
              FilledButton(
                onPressed: busy
                    ? null
                    : () async {
                        final qVal = parseInput(qtyCtrl.text);
                        final cVal = parseInput(costCtrl.text);
                        if (qVal == null || qVal <= 0) {
                          setS(() => errorText = 'Miqdorni to‘g‘ri kiriting');
                          return;
                        }
                        if (cVal == null || cVal < 0) {
                          setS(() => errorText = 'Xarid narxini to‘g‘ri kiriting');
                          return;
                        }

                        setS(() {
                          busy = true;
                          errorText = null;
                        });

                        final baseQty = (inPachka && selected.hasPachka)
                            ? qVal * (selected.effectiveBoxM2 ?? 1.0)
                            : ((inDona && selected.hasDona) ? qVal * selected.donaM2! : qVal);
                        final fullNoteParts = <String>[];
                        if (supplierCtrl.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                          fullNoteParts.add('Yetkazib beruvchi: ${supplierCtrl.text.trim()}');
                        }
                        if (paymentMethod != 'cash') {
                          fullNoteParts.add('To‘lov: $paymentMethod');
                        }
                        if (noteCtrl.text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                          fullNoteParts.add(noteCtrl.text.trim());
                        }
                        final combinedNote = fullNoteParts.isNotEmpty ? fullNoteParts.join(' • ') : 'Xarid kirimi';

                        try {
                          await _stockRepo.purchase(
                            productId: selected.id,
                            quantity: baseQty,
                            unitCost: cVal,
                            note: combinedNote,
                          );
                          if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                        } catch (e) {
                          setS(() {
                            busy = false;
                            errorText = e.toString();
                          });
                        }
                      },
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime, foregroundColor: AppColors.ink),
                child: busy
                    ? const SizedBox(width: 20, height: 20, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                    : const Text('Kirim qilish', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Xarid muvaffaqiyatli kirim qilindi');
      _loadData();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: FutureBuilder<List<dynamic>>(
        future: Future.wait([_movementsFuture, _productsFuture]),
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return Center(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text('Xatolik: ${snapshot.error}', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _loadData,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
                    label: const Text('Qayta yuklash'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }

          final movements = snapshot.data![0] as List<StockMovementRecord>;
          final products = snapshot.data![1] as List<Product>;
          final prodMap = {for (final p in products) p.id: p};

          // Filter faqat xaridlar (purchase)
          final purchases = movements.where((m) => m.kind == 'purchase').toList();
          final query = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase();

          final filtered = purchases.where((p) {
            if (!_matchesDate(p.createdAt)) return false;
            if (query.isNotEmpty) {
              final prod = prodMap[p.productId];
              final pName = p.productName ?? prod?.name ?? '';
              final note = p.note ?? '';
              final user = p.createdByName ?? '';
              if (!pName.toLowerCase().contains(query) &&
                  !note.toLowerCase().contains(query) &&
                  !user.toLowerCase().contains(query)) {
                return false;
              }
            }
            return true;
          }).toList();

          // Statistika
          double totalSpent = 0;
          for (final p in filtered) {
            final prod = prodMap[p.productId];
            final cost = p.unitCost ?? prod?.costPrice ?? 0;
            totalSpent += p.qtyDelta.abs() * cost;
          }

          return RefreshIndicator(
            onRefresh: () async => _loadData(),
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              children: [
                // Top header
                Wrap(
                  alignment: WrapAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                  spacing: 12,
                  runSpacing: 12,
                  children: [
                    Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        const Text(
                          'Xaridlar & Ta‘minot',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        Text(
                          'Xomashyo va tovarlar xaridi, yetkazib beruvchilar va tannarx hisoboti',
                          style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 13),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    FilledButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () => _openNewPurchaseDialog(products),
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime,
                        foregroundColor: AppColors.ink,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                      ),
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.add_shopping_cart_rounded, size: 18),
                      label: const Text('Yangi Xarid Kirimi', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // KPI Stat Cards
                LayoutBuilder(
                  builder: (context, constraints) {
                    final isSmall = constraints.maxWidth < 440;
                    final cardWidth = isSmall
                        ? (constraints.maxWidth < 360 ? constraints.maxWidth : (constraints.maxWidth - 12) / 2)
                        : (constraints.maxWidth < 800 ? (constraints.maxWidth - 24) / 3 : 220.0);
                    return Wrap(
                      spacing: 12,
                      runSpacing: 12,
                      children: [
                        _kpiCard(
                          context,
                          title: 'Jami Xaridlar Summasi',
                          value: money(totalSpent),
                          icon: Icons.account_balance_rounded,
                          color: AppColors.neonLime,
                          width: cardWidth,
                        ),
                        _kpiCard(
                          context,
                          title: 'Xarid Operatsiyalari',
                          value: '${filtered.length} ta',
                          icon: Icons.shopping_bag_rounded,
                          color: const Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                          width: cardWidth,
                        ),
                        _kpiCard(
                          context,
                          title: 'Ombordagi Mahsulotlar',
                          value: '${products.length} xil',
                          icon: Icons.inventory_2_rounded,
                          color: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                          width: cardWidth,
                        ),
                      ],
                    );
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 18),

                // Search & Filter controls
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: context.cardBg,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    children: [
                      TextField(
                        controller: _searchCtrl,
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Mahsulot nomi, yetkazib beruvchi, izoh yoki xodim...',
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded),
                          suffixIcon: _searchCtrl.text.isNotEmpty
                              ? IconButton(
                                  icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_rounded),
                                  onPressed: () {
                                    _searchCtrl.clear();
                                    setState(() {});
                                  },
                                )
                              : null,
                          isDense: true,
                        ),
                        onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      SingleChildScrollView(
                        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            for (final d in ['Barchasi', 'Bugun', 'Shu hafta', 'Shu oy'])
                              Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                                child: ChoiceChip(
                                  label: Text(d, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                                  selected: _dateFilter == d,
                                  onSelected: (sel) {
                                    if (sel) setState(() => _dateFilter = d);
                                  },
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Xaridlar ro'yxati
                if (filtered.isEmpty)
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 48),
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.shopping_bag_outlined, size: 52, color: context.subtextColor.withOpacity(0.5)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Text(
                          'Birorta ham xarid yozuvi topilmadi',
                          style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  )
                else
                  for (final item in filtered)
                    _purchaseCard(context, item, prodMap[item.productId]),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _kpiCard(BuildContext context, {
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    double? width,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: width ?? 220,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.cardBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 22),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  title,
                  style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                FittedBox(
                  fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: Text(
                    value,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _purchaseCard(BuildContext context, StockMovementRecord m, Product? prod) {
    final pName = m.productName ?? prod?.name ?? 'Mahsulot #${m.productId}';
    final unit = prod?.unit ?? 'birlik';
    final cost = m.unitCost ?? prod?.costPrice ?? 0;
    final totalCost = m.qtyDelta.abs() * cost;

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.cardBg,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            ),
            child: const Icon(Icons.arrow_downward_rounded, color: Color(0xFF10B981), size: 22),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 14),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        pName,
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      '+${m.qtyDelta.toStringAsFixed(1)} $unit',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                        fontSize: 15,
                        color: Color(0xFF10B981),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 12,
                  runSpacing: 4,
                  children: [
                    if (cost > 0) ...[
                      Text(
                        'Tannarx: ${money(cost)} / $unit',
                        style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        'Jami: ${money(totalCost)}',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.neonLime),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
                if (m.note != null && m.note!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.12),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      m.note!,
                      style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 12),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 12,
                  runSpacing: 4,
                  crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.access_time_rounded, size: 13, color: context.subtextColor),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text(
                          formatDateTime(m.createdAt),
                          style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, fontSize: 11),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    if (m.createdByName != null)
                      Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
```

```dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:camera/camera.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:image/image.dart' as img;
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:zxing2/qrcode.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import '../state/cart_controller.dart';
import 'common.dart';
import 'receipt_dialog.dart';

String _u(String unit) => unit == 'm2' ? 'm²' : unit;

String? _decodeQrFromBytes(Uint8List bytes) {
  try {
    var image = img.decodeImage(bytes);
    if (image == null) return null;
    if (image.width > 640) {
      image = img.copyResize(image, width: 480);
    }
    final width = image.width;
    final height = image.height;
    final rgba = image.convert(numChannels: 4).getBytes(order: img.ChannelOrder.rgba);
    final int32List = rgba.buffer.asInt32List();
    final source = RGBLuminanceSource(width, height, int32List);
    final bitmap = BinaryBitmap(HybridBinarizer(source));
    final reader = QRCodeReader();
    final result = reader.decode(bitmap);
    return result.text;
  } catch (_) {
    return null;
  }
}

class _ScannerHolePainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ScannerHolePainter({required this.holeRect, required this.borderRadius});
  final Rect holeRect;
  final double borderRadius;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()..color = Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.58);
    final bgPath = Path()..addRect(Rect.fromLTWH(0, 0, size.width, size.height));
    final holePath = Path()
      ..addRRect(RRect.fromRectAndRadius(holeRect, Radius.circular(borderRadius)));
    final combined = Path.combine(PathOperation.difference, bgPath, holePath);
    canvas.drawPath(combined, paint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _ScannerHolePainter old) =>
      old.holeRect != holeRect || old.borderRadius != borderRadius;
}

class _ReticleCorner extends StatelessWidget {
  const _ReticleCorner({required this.isTop, required this.isLeft});
  final bool isTop;
  final bool isLeft;

  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const double size = 26;
    const double thickness = 3.5;

              width: size,

              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: color,

              ),

          ),

            top: isTop ? 0 : null,
            bottom: !isTop ? 0 : null,

/// Mobil qurilmalar uchun to‘liq ekranli, keng va qulay QR kod kamera skaneri
class QrScannerScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const QrScannerScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.onCartUpdated,
    this.onGoToCart,
  });

  final VoidCallback onCartUpdated;
  final VoidCallback? onGoToCart;

  @override
  State<QrScannerScreen> createState() => _QrScannerScreenState();
}

class _QrScannerScreenState extends State<QrScannerScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _laserCtrl;
  CameraController? _cameraController;
  List<CameraDescription> _cameras = [];
  int _currentCameraIndex = 0;
  bool _cameraInitializing = false;
  bool _hasCamera = false;
  bool _isScanningFrame = false;
  Timer? _scanTimer;
  bool _torchOn = false;

  String? _currentLockedCode;
  int _emptyFramesCount = 0;

  Product? _lastProduct;
  double _lastQty = 1.0;
  String? _statusMessage;
  bool _isError = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _laserCtrl = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1600),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);

    // Ekranni to'sib qo'ymasligi uchun klaviatura AVTOMATIK OCHILMAYDI. Toza kamera ochiladi.
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _initCamera();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scanTimer?.cancel();
    _cameraController?.dispose();
    _laserCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _initCamera() async {
    if (Platform.isWindows) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _hasCamera = false;
          _cameraInitializing = false;
        });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _cameraInitializing = true);
    try {
      _cameras = await availableCameras();
      if (_cameras.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        final backIdx = _cameras.indexWhere((c) => c.lensDirection == CameraLensDirection.back);
        _currentCameraIndex = backIdx >= 0 ? backIdx : 0;
        await _setupController(_cameras[_currentCameraIndex]);
      } else {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _hasCamera = false);
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _hasCamera = false);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _cameraInitializing = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _setupController(CameraDescription camera) async {
    try {
      _scanTimer?.cancel();
      await _cameraController?.dispose();
      final controller = CameraController(
        camera,
        ResolutionPreset.medium,
        enableAudio: false,
        imageFormatGroup: ImageFormatGroup.jpeg,
      );
      _cameraController = controller;
      await controller.initialize();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _hasCamera = true;
        _torchOn = false;
      });
      _startPeriodicScanning();
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _hasCamera = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleTorch() async {
    if (_cameraController == null || !_cameraController!.value.isInitialized) return;
    try {
      _torchOn = !_torchOn;
      await _cameraController!.setFlashMode(_torchOn ? FlashMode.torch : FlashMode.off);
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _switchCamera() async {
    if (_cameras.length <= 1) return;
    _currentCameraIndex = (_currentCameraIndex + 1) % _cameras.length;
    await _setupController(_cameras[_currentCameraIndex]);
  }

  void _startPeriodicScanning() {
    _scanTimer?.cancel();
    _scanTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 600), (_) async {
      if (!_hasCamera || _cameraController == null || !_cameraController!.value.isInitialized) return;
      if (_isScanningFrame) return;
      _isScanningFrame = true;
      try {
        final xFile = await _cameraController!.takePicture();
        final bytes = await xFile.readAsBytes();
        try {
          File(xFile.path).deleteSync();
        } catch (_) {}

        final code = _decodeQrFromBytes(bytes);
        if (code != null && code.isNotEmpty) {
          _emptyFramesCount = 0;
          if (mounted) {
            _processCode(code);
          }
        } else {
          // Kamerada QR kod ko'rinmay qolganda (boshqa tovar olish uchun siljitilganda)
          _emptyFramesCount++;
          if (_emptyFramesCount >= 2) {
            _currentLockedCode = null;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {
      } finally {
        _isScanningFrame = false;
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _processCode(String rawCode) async {
    final code = rawCode.trim();
    if (code.isEmpty) return;

    // Bir marta skanerlangandan keyin kamera shu kod ustida tursa, qayta-qayta qo'shavermasin!
    if (_currentLockedCode == code) {
      return;
    }

    // 1. Agar skanerlangan kod CHEK (RECEIPT) QR-kodi bo'lsa:
    if (isReceiptQr(code)) {
      _currentLockedCode = code;
      final saleId = extractSaleId(code);
      if (saleId != null) {
        try {
          final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
          final sales = await repos.sales.listSales(limit: 500);
          final matched = sales.where((s) => s.id == saleId).firstOrNull;
          if (matched != null && mounted) {
            HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
            SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click);
            setState(() {
              _isError = false;
              _statusMessage = 'Chek #${matched.id} rasmi va ma‘lumotlari ochildi';
            });
            await ReceiptDialog.show(context, matched);
            return;
          } else {
            HapticFeedback.vibrate();
            setState(() {
              _isError = true;
              _statusMessage = 'Chek #$saleId tizimdan topilmadi';
            });
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() {
              _isError = true;
              _statusMessage = 'Chekni ochishda xatolik: $e';
            });
          }
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    try {
      final repo = context.read<AppRepositories>().products;
      final p = await repo.findByCode(code);
      if (!mounted) return;

      if (p != null) {
        _currentLockedCode = code; // Qulflanadi: kamera ushbu kod ustida turganda faqat 1 marta qo'shiladi

        HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
        SystemSound.play(SystemSoundType.click);

        context.read<CartController>().add(p, quantity: 1);
        widget.onCartUpdated();

        setState(() {
          _isError = false;
          _statusMessage = '“${p.name}” savatga qo‘shildi';
          _lastProduct = p;
          _lastQty = 1.0;
        });
      } else {
        HapticFeedback.vibrate();
        setState(() {
          _isError = true;
          _statusMessage = 'Mahsulot topilmadi: "$code"';
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _isError = true;
          _statusMessage = 'Xatolik: $e';
        });
      }
    }
  }

  void _updateLastQty(double delta) {
    if (_lastProduct == null) return;
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();
    final p = _lastProduct!;

    if (delta > 0) {
      cart.add(p, quantity: delta);
      setState(() {
        _lastQty += delta;
        _statusMessage = '“${p.name}” miqdori: ${qty(_lastQty)} ${_u(p.unit)}';
      });
    } else if (delta < 0) {
      final existing = cart.lines.where((l) => l.product.id == p.id);
      if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
        final l = existing.first;
        if (l.quantity + delta > 0.001) {
          cart.update(l, quantity: l.quantity + delta);
          setState(() {
            _lastQty += delta;
            _statusMessage = '“${p.name}” miqdori: ${qty(_lastQty)} ${_u(p.unit)}';
          });
        } else {
          cart.remove(l);
          setState(() {
            _lastProduct = null;
            _lastQty = 1.0;
            _statusMessage = '“${p.name}” savatdan olindi';
          });
        }
      }
    }
    widget.onCartUpdated();
  }
```

```dart
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:printing/printing.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'common.dart';
import 'return_product_dialog.dart';

bool isReceiptQr(String code) {
  final c = code.trim().toUpperCase();
  return c.startsWith('NTM-CHEK-') ||
      c.startsWith('NTM-SALE-') ||
      c.startsWith('STONEX-CHEK-') ||
      c.startsWith('STONEX-SALE-') ||
      c.startsWith('CHEK-#') ||
      c.startsWith('CHEK-') ||
      c.startsWith('SALE-#') ||
      RegExp(r'#\d+').hasMatch(c);
}

int? extractSaleId(String code) {
  final reg = RegExp(r'#(\d+)');
  final match = reg.firstMatch(code);
  if (match != null) {
    return int.tryParse(match.group(1)!);
  }
  final digits = code.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), '');
  return int.tryParse(digits);
}

class ReceiptDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReceiptDialog({super.key, required this.sale});

  final SaleResult sale;

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, SaleResult sale) {
    return showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => ReceiptDialog(sale: sale),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<ReceiptDialog> createState() => _ReceiptDialogState();
}

class _ReceiptDialogState extends State<ReceiptDialog> {
  final GlobalKey _receiptKey = GlobalKey();
  bool _isPrinting = false;
  bool _isCapturing = false;

  String _buildPlainText() {
    final sale = widget.sale;
    final sb = StringBuffer();
    sb.writeln('================================');
    sb.writeln('   NTM — NAMUNA TOSH MARKAZI    ');
    sb.writeln('  Tabiiy tosh va granit markazi ');
    sb.writeln('   Tel: +998 (90) 123-45-67     ');
    sb.writeln('================================');
    sb.writeln('Chek №: #${sale.id.toString().padLeft(6, '0')}');
    sb.writeln('Sana: ${formatDateTime(sale.createdAt ?? DateTime.now())}');
    sb.writeln('Sotuvchi: ${sale.cashierName ?? 'Kassir'}');
    sb.writeln(
        'Xaridor: ${sale.customerName?.isNotEmpty == true ? sale.customerName : 'Chakana xaridor'}');
    if (sale.customerPhone?.isNotEmpty == true) {
      sb.writeln('Tel: ${sale.customerPhone}');
    }
    if (sale.customerPassport?.isNotEmpty == true) {
      sb.writeln('Pasport: ${sale.customerPassport}');
    }
    sb.writeln('--------------------------------');
    sb.writeln('Tovar           Miqdor     Jami');
    sb.writeln('--------------------------------');
    for (final it in sale.items) {
      final name = it.productName.length > 14
          ? '${it.productName.substring(0, 12)}..'
          : it.productName.padRight(14);
      final qStr = it.quantity.toStringAsFixed(1).padRight(6);
      final total = money(it.lineTotal);
      sb.writeln('$name $qStr $total');
    }
    sb.writeln('================================');
    if (sale.currencyRate != null && sale.currencyRate! > 0) {
      final rate = sale.currencyRate!;
      final totalUsd = sale.total / rate;
      sb.writeln('JAMI (So‘m):    ${money(sale.total)}');
      sb.writeln('JAMI (\$ USD):   ${moneyUsd(totalUsd)}');
      sb.writeln('Kurs:           \$1 = ${money(rate)}');
    } else {
      sb.writeln('JAMI SUMMA:     ${money(sale.total)}');
    }
    sb.writeln(
        'To‘landi:       ${money(sale.paid)} (${sale.paymentMethod == 'karta' ? 'Karta' : 'Naqd'})');
    if (sale.paidUsd != null && sale.paidUsd! > 0) {
      sb.writeln('To‘lov:         ${money(sale.paidUzs ?? 0)} + ${moneyUsd(sale.paidUsd!)}');
    }
    if (sale.debt > 0.005) {
      sb.writeln('Qoldiq nasiya:  ${money(sale.debt)}');
    }
    sb.writeln('================================');
    sb.writeln('   Xaridingiz uchun tashakkur!  ');
    sb.writeln(' Tovarlar sifati kafolatlangan. ');
    sb.writeln('================================');
    return sb.toString();
  }

  Future<Uint8List?> _captureReceiptPng() async {
    try {
      final boundary =
          _receiptKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject() as RenderRepaintBoundary?;
      if (boundary == null) return null;
      final image = await boundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3.0);
      final byteData = await image.toByteData(format: ui.ImageByteFormat.png);
      return byteData?.buffer.asUint8List();
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

                              : () {

                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFD97706),
                            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                            disabledBackgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade400,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                          ),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.assignment_return_rounded, size: 15),
                          label: Text(
                            widget.sale.status == 'returned' ? 'Qaytarilgan' : 'Qaytarish (10 kun)',
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 12),
                          ),
                        ),
                      FilledButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _isPrinting ? null : () => _printPdf(context),
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
                          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                        ),
                        icon: _isPrinting
                            ? const SizedBox(
                                width: 14,
                                height: 14,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white),
                              )
                            : const Icon(Icons.print_rounded, size: 15),

                          'Chop etish',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),

  static Widget _dashedLine() {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (context, constraints) {
        final count = (constraints.maxWidth / 7).floor();
        return Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: List.generate(
            count,
            (_) => const SizedBox(
              width: 4,
              height: 1.2,
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFFCBD5E1)),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  static Widget _receiptRow(
    String label,
    String value, {
    bool isBold = false,
    double fontSize = 12,
    Color? valueColor,
  }) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Flexible(
          flex: 4,
          child: Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Courier',
              fontSize: fontSize,
              color: const Color(0xFF64748B),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Flexible(
          flex: 6,
          child: Text(
            value,
            textAlign: TextAlign.right,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Courier',
              fontSize: fontSize,
              fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
              color: valueColor ?? const Color(0xFF1E293B),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```
