```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'common.dart';
import 'receipt_dialog.dart';

class ReturnProductDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ReturnProductDialog({super.key, required this.sale, this.onSuccess});

  final SaleResult sale;
  final VoidCallback? onSuccess;

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, SaleResult sale, {VoidCallback? onSuccess}) {
    return showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => ReturnProductDialog(sale: sale, onSuccess: onSuccess),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<ReturnProductDialog> createState() => _ReturnProductDialogState();
}

class _ReturnProductDialogState extends State<ReturnProductDialog> {
  late final Map<int, double> _returnQuantities;
  final _reasonCtrl = TextEditingController(text: 'Ortib qolgan butun mahsulot qaytarildi');
  bool _busy = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _returnQuantities = {};
    for (final it in widget.sale.items) {
      _returnQuantities[it.productId] = 0.0;
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _reasonCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int get _daysAgo {
    final created = widget.sale.createdAt ?? DateTime.now();
    return DateTime.now().difference(created).inDays;
  }

  bool get _isExpired => _daysAgo > 10;

  double get _totalRefund {
    double sum = 0;
    for (final it in widget.sale.items) {
      if (it.isCut) continue;
      final q = _returnQuantities[it.productId] ?? 0.0;
      sum += q * it.unitPrice;
    }
    return sum;
  }

  double get _debtReduction {
    final remDebt = widget.sale.debt;
    return _totalRefund < remDebt ? _totalRefund : remDebt;
  }

  double get _cashRefund {
    return _totalRefund - _debtReduction;
  }

  bool get _canSubmit {
    if (_isExpired || _busy) return false;
    return _totalRefund > 0;
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (!_canSubmit) return;
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final itemsToReturn = <({int productId, double quantity})>[];
      for (final it in widget.sale.items) {
        if (it.isCut) continue;
        final q = _returnQuantities[it.productId] ?? 0.0;
        if (q > 0) {
          itemsToReturn.add((productId: it.productId, quantity: q));
        }
      }

      if (itemsToReturn.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _busy = false;
          _error = 'Kamida bitta tovar qaytarish miqdorini tanlang';
        });
        return;
      }

      final repo = context.read<AppRepositories>().sales;
      final updated = await repo.returnSale(
        widget.sale.id,
        items: itemsToReturn,
        reason: _reasonCtrl.text.trim(),
      );

      if (!mounted) return;
      Navigator.pop(context);
      widget.onSuccess?.call();

      showMessage(
        context,
        'Chek #${widget.sale.id} bo‘yicha tovar muvaffaqiyatli qaytarildi!\nKassadan qaytarildi: ${money(_cashRefund)}',
      );

      // Yangilangan chekni ko'rsatish
      await ReceiptDialog.show(context, updated);
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = context.isDark;
    final sale = widget.sale;

    return Dialog(
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 24),
      child: ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620, maxHeight: 720),
        child: Column(

                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                            children: [
                              const Text('Kassadan qaytariladigan naqd pul:', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              Text(
                                money(_cashRefund),
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                                  color: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF047857),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Modal pastki harakatlar paneli
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 14),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor)),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  OutlinedButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    ),
                    child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _canSubmit ? _submit : null,
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                      foregroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                      disabledBackgroundColor: AppColors.muted.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    ),
                    icon: _busy
                        ? const SizedBox(width: 16, height: 16, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2))
                        : const Icon(Icons.assignment_return_rounded, size: 18),
                    label: Text(
                      _busy ? 'Qaytarilmoqda...' : 'Qaytarishni tasdiqlash (${money(_cashRefund)})',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildItemReturnCard(BuildContext context, SaleItemRecord it) {
    final isDark = context.isDark;
    final isCut = it.isCut;
    final selectedQty = _returnQuantities[it.productId] ?? 0.0;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isCut
            ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFF241517) : const Color(0xFFFEF2F2))
            : (selectedQty > 0
                ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFF1E281F) : const Color(0xFFF0FDF4))
                : context.cardColor),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isCut
              ? const Color(0xFFF87171).withValues(alpha: 0.4)
              : (selectedQty > 0
                  ? AppColors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                  : context.borderColor),
          width: selectedQty > 0 ? 1.5 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      it.productName,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: isCut ? (isDark ? const Color(0xFFFCA5A5) : const Color(0xFF991B1B)) : context.inkColor,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'Sotilgan narx: ${money(it.unitPrice)} • Jami olingan: ${qty(it.quantity)} dona/m²',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: AppColors.muted),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              if (isCut)
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: AppColors.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                    border: Border.all(color: AppColors.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
                  ),
                  child: const Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.block_rounded, size: 12, color: AppColors.danger),
                      SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(
                        'Kesilgan (Olinmaydi)',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: AppColors.danger),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                )
              else
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: AppColors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                  ),
                  child: const Text(
                    'Butun holatda ✅',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: AppColors.green),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),

          if (isCut) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            const Text(
              'Xaridor talabiga ko‘ra maxsus razmerda kesib berilgan kafellar nizom bo‘yicha qaytarib olinmaydi.',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: AppColors.danger, fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
            ),
          ] else ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Row(
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Qaytarish miqdori:',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: context.subtextColor),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                // Stepper: [-] [qty] [+]
                Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF1B232A) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.remove, size: 16),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                        onPressed: selectedQty > 0
                            ? () {
                                setState(() {
                                  final next = (selectedQty - 1).clamp(0.0, it.quantity);
                                  _returnQuantities[it.productId] = next;
                                });
                              }
                            : null,
                      ),
                      Container(
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44),
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        child: Text(
                          qty(selectedQty),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            color: selectedQty > 0 ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink) : AppColors.muted,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 16),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
                        onPressed: selectedQty < it.quantity
                            ? () {
                                setState(() {
                                  final next = (selectedQty + 1).clamp(0.0, it.quantity);
                                  _returnQuantities[it.productId] = next;
                                });
                              }
                            : null,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                TextButton(
                  style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                  ),
                  onPressed: () {
                    setState(() {
                      _returnQuantities[it.productId] = it.quantity;
                    });
                  },
                  child: const Text('Barchasi', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'common.dart';
import 'receipt_dialog.dart';
import 'return_product_dialog.dart';

class SalesHistoryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SalesHistoryScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SalesHistoryScreen> createState() => _SalesHistoryScreenState();
}

class _SalesHistoryScreenState extends State<SalesHistoryScreen> {
  late Future<List<SaleResult>> _salesFuture;
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _dateFilter = 'Barchasi'; // 'Barchasi', 'Bugun', 'Shu hafta', 'Shu oy'
  String _statusFilter = 'Barchasi'; // 'Barchasi', 'To‘langan', 'Nasiyali'

  SalesRepository get _repo => context.read<AppRepositories>().sales;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSales();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _loadSales() {
    setState(() {
      _salesFuture = _repo.listSales(limit: 150);
    });
  }

  bool _matchesDate(DateTime? dt) {
    if (dt == null) return _dateFilter == 'Barchasi';
    final now = DateTime.now();
    switch (_dateFilter) {
      case 'Bugun':
        return dt.year == now.year && dt.month == now.month && dt.day == now.day;
      case 'Shu hafta':
        final startOfWeek = now.subtract(Duration(days: now.weekday - 1));
        final zeroStart = DateTime(startOfWeek.year, startOfWeek.month, startOfWeek.day);
        return dt.isAfter(zeroStart);
      case 'Shu oy':
        return dt.year == now.year && dt.month == now.month;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  }

  bool _matchesStatus(SaleResult s) {
    switch (_statusFilter) {
      case 'To‘langan':
        return s.debt <= 0.005;
      case 'Nasiyali':
        return s.debt > 0.005;
      default:
        return true;
    }
  }

  bool _matchesSearch(SaleResult s, String query) {
    if (query.isEmpty) return true;
    final q = query.toLowerCase();
    if ('chek #${s.id}'.contains(q) || s.id.toString().contains(q)) return true;
    if (s.customerName?.toLowerCase().contains(q) == true) return true;
    if (s.customerPhone?.toLowerCase().contains(q) == true) return true;
    if (s.customerPassport?.toLowerCase().contains(q) == true) return true;
    if (s.cashierName?.toLowerCase().contains(q) == true) return true;
    for (final it in s.items) {
      if (it.productName.toLowerCase().contains(q)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  Future<void> _payDebtDialog(SaleResult sale) async {
    final ctrl = TextEditingController(text: sale.debt.round().toString());
    String method = 'cash';
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
          title: Text('Qarz to‘lash — Chek #${sale.id}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 17)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 340,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'Mijoz: ${sale.customerName ?? 'Noma’lum'}\nJami qarz: ${money(sale.debt)}',
                  style: TextStyle(color: context.subtextColor, height: 1.4),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: ctrl,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'To‘lov summasi (so‘m)'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  value: method,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'To‘lov usuli'),
                  items: const [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'cash', child: Text('Naqd pul')),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: 'card', child: Text('Plastik karta / Terminal')),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (v) {
                    if (v != null) setS(() => method = v);
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime, foregroundColor: AppColors.ink),
              child: const Text('To‘lovni qabul qilish'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      final val = parseInput(ctrl.text);
      if (val == null || val <= 0) {
        showMessage(context, 'Noto‘g‘ri summa', error: true);
        return;
      }
      try {
        final updated = await _repo.payDebt(sale.id, val, method: method);
        if (mounted) {
          showMessage(context, 'Chek #${sale.id} bo‘yicha ${money(val)} qabul qilindi');
          _loadSales();
          // Oyna ko'rsatish
          ReceiptDialog.show(context, updated);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (mounted) showMessage(context, e.toString(), error: true);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      body: FutureBuilder<List<SaleResult>>(
        future: _salesFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {

          }).toList();

          final totalPaid = filtered.fold<double>(0, (sum, s) => sum + s.paid);

          return RefreshIndicator(

                    return Wrap(

  Widget _kpiCard(BuildContext context, {

        color: context.cardBg,
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),

          child: ExpansionTile(

            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: hasDebt
                  ? const Color(0xFFEF4444).withOpacity(0.15)
                  : const Color(0xFF10B981).withOpacity(0.15),

            ),
            child: Icon(
              hasDebt ? Icons.pending_actions_rounded : Icons.check_circle_rounded,
              color: hasDebt ? const Color(0xFFEF4444) : const Color(0xFF10B981),

              Container(
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/format.dart';
import '../core/theme.dart';
import '../data/repositories.dart';
import '../domain/models.dart';
import 'common.dart';

class StockScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const StockScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<StockScreen> createState() => _StockScreenState();
}

class _StockScreenState extends State<StockScreen> {
  late Future<List<StockMovementRecord>> _movementsFuture;
  late Future<List<Product>> _productsFuture;
  late Future<List<dynamic>> _combinedFuture;
  String _selectedFilter = 'Barchasi';
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();

  StockRepository get _stockRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().stock;
  ProductRepository get _productRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().products;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _movementsFuture = _stockRepo.movements();
    _productsFuture = _productRepo.list();
    _combinedFuture = Future.wait([_movementsFuture, _productsFuture]);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reload() {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _movementsFuture = _stockRepo.movements();
        _productsFuture = _productRepo.list();
        _combinedFuture = Future.wait([_movementsFuture, _productsFuture]);
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _purchaseDialog() async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => StockPurchaseDialog(
        stockRepo: _stockRepo,
        productRepo: _productRepo,
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Xarid muvaffaqiyatli kirim qilindi');
      _reload();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _adjustDialog() async {
    final products = await _productRepo.list();
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (products.isEmpty) {
      return showMessage(context, 'Mahsulotlar yo‘q', error: true);
    }
    Product selected = products.first;
    final deltaCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
    String? error;
    bool busy = false;

    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setS) => AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
          title: const Text('Qoldiqni Tuzatish (Inventarizatsiya)', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 380,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  DropdownButtonFormField<Product>(
                    value: selected,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Mahsulot'),
                    items: products.where((p) => !p.isService).map((p) => DropdownMenuItem(value: p, child: Text(p.name))).toList(),
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      if (v != null) {
                        setS(() {
                          selected = v;
                        });
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    'Hozirgi hisobdagi qoldiq: ${qty(selected.stock)} ${selected.unit}',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: AppColors.muted),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: deltaCtrl,
                    keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(signed: true, decimal: true),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'O‘zgarish miqdori (+ yoki -)',
                      hintText: '+10 yoki -5 (${selected.unit})',
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: noteCtrl,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Tuzatish sababi (majburiy)',
                      hintText: 'Brak, qayta sanash, yo‘qotish va h.k.',
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (error != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                      child: Text(error!, style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12)),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Bekor'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: busy
                  ? null
                  : () async {
                      final d = parseInput(deltaCtrl.text);
                      final note = noteCtrl.text.trim();
                      if (d == null || d == 0) {
                        setS(() {
                          error = 'O‘zgarish miqdorini 0 dan farqli kiriting';
                        });
                        return;
                      }
                      if (note.isEmpty) {
                        setS(() {
                          error = 'Tuzatish sababini kiritish majburiy';
                        });
                        return;
                      }
                      setS(() {
                        busy = true;
                        error = null;
                      });
                      try {
                        await _stockRepo.adjust(productId: selected.id, delta: d, note: note);
                        if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                      } catch (e) {
                        setS(() {
                          busy = false;
                          error = e.toString();
                        });
                      }
                    },
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
              ),
              child: busy
                  ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                  : const Text('Tuzatish'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    deltaCtrl.dispose();
    noteCtrl.dispose();

    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Ombor qoldig‘i muvaffaqiyatli tuzatildi');
      _reload();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filters = ['Barchasi', 'Xaridlar', 'Sotuvlar', 'Ishlab chiqarish', 'Tuzatishlar'];

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
      floatingActionButton: Builder(
        builder: (context) {
          final isNarrow = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 450;
          return Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (isNarrow)
                FloatingActionButton(
                  heroTag: 'adjust_btn',
                  backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
                  foregroundColor: context.inkColor,
                  tooltip: 'Inventarizatsiya',
                  onPressed: _adjustDialog,
                  child: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded),
                )
              else
                FloatingActionButton.extended(
                  heroTag: 'adjust_btn',
                  backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
                  foregroundColor: context.inkColor,
                  onPressed: _adjustDialog,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded),
                  label: const Text('Inventarizatsiya'),
                ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              FloatingActionButton.extended(
                heroTag: 'purchase_btn',
                onPressed: _purchaseDialog,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add_shopping_cart_rounded, color: AppColors.neonLime),
                label: const Text('Xarid kirimi'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
      body: FutureBuilder<List<dynamic>>(
        future: _combinedFuture,
        builder: (context, snap) {
          if (snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }
          if (snap.hasError) {
            return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reload);
          }

          final allMovements = snap.data![0] as List<StockMovementRecord>;
          final products = snap.data![1] as List<Product>;
          final productMap = {for (final p in products) p.id: p};

          var displayList = List<StockMovementRecord>.from(allMovements);

          if (_selectedFilter == 'Xaridlar') {
            displayList = displayList.where((m) => m.kind == 'purchase' || m.kind == 'opening').toList();
          } else if (_selectedFilter == 'Sotuvlar') {
            displayList = displayList.where((m) => m.kind == 'sale').toList();
          } else if (_selectedFilter == 'Ishlab chiqarish') {
            displayList = displayList.where((m) => m.kind == 'production').toList();
          } else if (_selectedFilter == 'Tuzatishlar') {
            displayList = displayList.where((m) => m.kind == 'adjustment').toList();
          }

          final q = _searchCtrl.text.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (q.isNotEmpty) {
            displayList = displayList.where((m) {
              final pName = (productMap[m.productId]?.name ?? '').toLowerCase();

              return pName.contains(q) || note.contains(q);
            }).toList();
          }

          final purchaseTotal = allMovements.where((m) => m.kind == 'purchase').length;

                              context,
                              'Jami Harakatlar',
                              '${allMovements.length} ta',
                              Icons.history_rounded,
                              AppColors.neonLime,
                              true,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,

                              '$purchaseTotal ta partiya',
                              Icons.input_rounded,
                              AppColors.green,
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Sotuv Chiqimlari',
                              '$saleTotal ta operatsiya',
                              Icons.output_rounded,
                              const Color(0xFFC77700),
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildStat(
                              context,
                              'Ishlab Chiqarish',
                              '$prodTotal ta qabul',
                              Icons.precision_manufacturing_rounded,
                              const Color(0xFF245580),
                              false,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      )
                    else ...[
                      _buildStat(context, 'Jami Harakatlar', '${allMovements.length} ta', Icons.history_rounded, AppColors.neonLime, true),
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(child: _buildStat(context, 'Kirimlar', '$purchaseTotal ta', Icons.input_rounded, AppColors.green, false)),

                                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                              color: kindColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                            ),
                                            child: Text(
                                              kindLabel,
                                              style: TextStyle(color: kindColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 10),
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ],
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                      Text(
                                        '${m.note ?? 'Izohsiz'}  ·  ${m.createdAt.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}.${m.createdAt.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}.${m.createdAt.year} ${m.createdAt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${m.createdAt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
                                        maxLines: 1,
                                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                        style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.muted, fontSize: 12),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Text(
                                  '${isPositive ? '+' : ''}${qty(m.qtyDelta)} $unit',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: isPositive ? AppColors.green : AppColors.danger,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStat(BuildContext context, String title, String value, IconData icon, Color color, bool isHeroCard) {
    final isDarkTheme = context.isDark;
    final isHero = isHeroCard && !isDarkTheme;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: isHero ? AppColors.darkCard : context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 38,
            height: 38,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF22262B) : color.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 20),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text(
                  title,
                  style: TextStyle(color: isHero ? const Color(0xFF8E959E) : context.mutedColor, fontSize: 11),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  value,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: isHero ? Colors.white : context.inkColor,
                    fontSize: 17,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class StockPurchaseDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const StockPurchaseDialog({super.key, required this.stockRepo, required this.productRepo});
  final StockRepository stockRepo;
  final ProductRepository productRepo;

  @override
  State<StockPurchaseDialog> createState() => _StockPurchaseDialogState();
}

class _StockPurchaseDialogState extends State<StockPurchaseDialog> {
  late Future<List<Product>> _productsFuture;
  Product? _selected;
  final _qtyCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _costCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final _noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _productsFuture = widget.productRepo.list().then((products) {
      if (products.isNotEmpty) {
        _selected = products.first;
        if (_selected!.costPrice > 0) {
          _costCtrl.text = _selected!.costPrice.round().toString();
        }
      }
      return products;
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _qtyCtrl.dispose();
    _costCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    if (_selected == null) return;
    final q = parseInput(_qtyCtrl.text);
    final c = parseInput(_costCtrl.text);
    if (q == null || q <= 0 || c == null || c < 0) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Miqdor va narxni to‘g‘ri kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });
    try {
      await widget.stockRepo.purchase(
        productId: _selected!.id,
        quantity: q,
        unitCost: c,
        note: _noteCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : _noteCtrl.text.trim(),
      );
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return FutureBuilder<List<Product>>(
      future: _productsFuture,
      builder: (ctx, snap) {
        if (!snap.hasData) {
          return const AlertDialog(
            content: SizedBox(
              height: 100,
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            ),
          );
        }
        final products = snap.data!;
        if (products.isEmpty) {
          return AlertDialog(
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
            title: const Text('Mahsulotlar mavjud emas'),
            content: const Text('Xarid kirimi qilishdan oldin mahsulot yarating.'),
            actions: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false), child: const Text('OK')),
            ],
          );
        }

        _selected ??= products.first;

        return AlertDialog(
          backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
          title: const Text('Yangi Xarid Kirimi (Partiya)', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18)),
          content: SizedBox(
            width: 380,
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  DropdownButtonFormField<Product>(
                    value: _selected,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Mahsulot'),
                    items: products.where((p) => !p.isService).map((p) => DropdownMenuItem(value: p, child: Text(p.name))).toList(),
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      if (v != null) {
                        setState(() {
                          _selected = v;
                          if (_selected!.costPrice > 0) {
                            _costCtrl.text = _selected!.costPrice.round().toString();
                          }
                        });
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _qtyCtrl,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: 'Kirim miqdori (${_selected!.unit})'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _costCtrl,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: 'Xarid narxi (so‘m / ${_selected!.unit})'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _noteCtrl,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Izoh / Yetkazib beruvchi (ixtiyoriy)'),
                  ),
                  if (_error != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                      child: Text(_error!, style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12)),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Bekor'),
            ),
            FilledButton(
              onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit,
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 12),
              ),
              child: _busy
                  ? const SizedBox(width: 18, height: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white))
                  : const Text('Kirim qilish', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';

import '../core/theme.dart';

import '../state/cart_controller.dart';
import 'common.dart';

/// Toshga ishlov berish xizmatlari modeli
class StoneServiceDef {
  final String key;
  final String name;
  final String unit;
  final String description;
  final IconData icon;
  final String? assetIcon;
  final double defaultPrice;
  final int defaultProductId;

  const StoneServiceDef({
    required this.key,
    required this.name,
    required this.unit,
    required this.description,
    required this.icon,
    this.assetIcon,
    required this.defaultPrice,
    required this.defaultProductId,
  });
}

const List<StoneServiceDef> kStoneServices = [
  StoneServiceDef(
    key: 'cut',
    name: 'Razmer kesish',
    unit: 'metr',
    description: 'Eni va bo‘yi bo‘yicha plita va toshlarni aniq o‘lchamda kesish',
    icon: Icons.content_cut_rounded,
    assetIcon: 'assets/icons/service_cut.png',
    defaultPrice: 15000,
    defaultProductId: 19,
  ),
  StoneServiceDef(
    key: 'chamfer',
    name: 'Faska ochish',
    unit: 'metr',
    description: 'Zinapoya, podokonnik yoki plita chetlariga faska (qirra) berish',
    icon: Icons.architecture_rounded,
    assetIcon: 'assets/icons/service_chamfer.png',
    defaultPrice: 20000,
    defaultProductId: 20,
  ),
  StoneServiceDef(
    key: 'polish',
    name: 'Silliqlash',
    unit: 'metr',
    description: 'Granit va Keramogranit toshlari yuzasi yoki qirrasini jilolash',
    icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
    defaultPrice: 25000,
    defaultProductId: 21,
  ),
  StoneServiceDef(
    key: 'groove',
    name: 'Chizish',
    unit: 'metr',
    description: 'Zinapoyalarga sirpanishga qarshi (antislip) yo‘llar chizish',
    icon: Icons.line_weight_rounded,
    defaultPrice: 10000,
    defaultProductId: 22,
  ),
];

/// Xizmat narxlarini doimiy saqlash (in-memory + database sync)
class StoneServicesStore {
  static final Map<String, double> _prices = {
    'cut': 15000,
    'cut_meter': 15000,
    'cut_m2': 25000,
    'chamfer': 20000,
    'polish_granite': 30000,
    'polish_ceramics': 20000,
    'groove': 10000,
  };

  static double getPrice(String key) {
    if (key == 'polish') {
      return _prices['polish_granite'] ?? 30000;
    }
    if (key == 'cut') {
      return _prices['cut_meter'] ?? _prices['cut'] ?? 15000;
    }
    return _prices[key] ?? 10000;
  }

  static void setPrice(String key, double price) {
    _prices[key] = price;
    if (key == 'cut_meter') _prices['cut'] = price;
  }

  static Map<String, double> getAllPrices() => Map.unmodifiable(_prices);

  /// Repozitoriyadan eng so'nggi xizmat narxlarini yuklash
  static Future<void> syncFromRepo(ProductRepository repo) async {
    try {
      final list = await repo.list();
      for (final p in list) {
        final name = p.name.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (p.id == 19 || (name.contains('kesish') && (name.contains('metr') || !name.contains('kvadrat')))) {
          _prices['cut_meter'] = p.price;
          _prices['cut'] = p.price;
        } else if (p.id == 24 || (name.contains('kesish') && (name.contains('kvadrat') || name.contains('m2')))) {
          _prices['cut_m2'] = p.price;
        } else if (p.id == 20 || name.contains('faska')) {
          _prices['chamfer'] = p.price;
        } else if (p.id == 21 || (name.contains('silliq') && name.contains('granit'))) {
          _prices['polish_granite'] = p.price;
        } else if (p.id == 23 || (name.contains('silliq') && name.contains('keramo'))) {
          _prices['polish_ceramics'] = p.price;
        } else if (p.id == 22 || name.contains('chizish')) {
          _prices['groove'] = p.price;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

/// Kassada xizmatlarni tanlash va savatga qo'shish oynasi
class StoneServicesDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const StoneServicesDialog({super.key, required this.user});
  final AppUser user;

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context, {required AppUser user}) async {
    final msg = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: true,
      builder: (_) => StoneServicesDialog(user: user),
    );
    if (msg != null && context.mounted) {
      showMessage(context, msg);
    }
  }

  @override
  State<StoneServicesDialog> createState() => _StoneServicesDialogState();
}

class _StoneServicesDialogState extends State<StoneServicesDialog> {
  int _selectedServiceIdx = 0;

  // Kesish va o'lchamlar uchun controllerlar
  // Bo'yi faqat santimetrda (sm), Eni esa metrda (m) kiritiladi va hisoblanadi
  final _lengthCtrl = TextEditingController(text: '120'); // Bo'yi (sm)
  final _widthCtrl = TextEditingController(text: '0.6');   // Eni (m)
  final _piecesCtrl = TextEditingController(text: '1');

  // Kesish o'lchov birligi: 'meter' (Metrda) yoki 'm2' (Metr kvadratda)
  String _cutUnit = 'm2';
  final _manualMetersCtrl = TextEditingController(text: '1.0');

  // Silliqlash uchun tosh turi: 'granite' (Granit) yoki 'ceramics' (Keramogranit)
  String _polishStoneType = 'granite';

  final _noteCtrl = TextEditingController();
  bool _syncing = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadPrices();
  }

  Future<void> _loadPrices() async {
    setState(() => _syncing = true);
    final repo = context.read<AppRepositories>().products;
    await StoneServicesStore.syncFromRepo(repo);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _syncing = false);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _lengthCtrl.dispose();
    _widthCtrl.dispose();
    _piecesCtrl.dispose();
    _manualMetersCtrl.dispose();
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  double _parseVal(TextEditingController ctrl) {
    final v = parseInput(ctrl.text);
    return (v != null && v > 0) ? v : 0.0;
  }

  int _parsePieces() {
    final v = int.tryParse(_piecesCtrl.text.trim());
    return (v != null && v > 0) ? v : 1;
  }

  double get _effectiveLengthM {
    final raw = _parseVal(_lengthCtrl);
    return raw / 100; // Bo'yi faqat santimetrda (sm), metrga o'tkaziladi
  }

  double get _effectiveWidthM {
    final raw = _parseVal(_widthCtrl);
    return raw; // Eni har doim metrda (m) kiritiladi va hisoblanadi
  }

  /// Jami hisoblangan metr yoki miqdor
  double get _calculatedTotalMeters {
    final def = kStoneServices[_selectedServiceIdx];
    final pieces = _parsePieces();

    if (def.key == 'cut') {
      final w = _effectiveWidthM;
      final pieces = _parsePieces();
      if (_cutUnit == 'meter') {
        // Metrda: eni bo'yicha metr * dona
        final total = w * pieces;
        return double.parse(total.toStringAsFixed(2));
      } else {
        // Metr kvadratda: (Bo'yi_sm / 100) * Eni_m * dona
        final l = _effectiveLengthM;
        final area = l * w * pieces;
        return double.parse(area.toStringAsFixed(3));
      }
    }

    final m = _parseVal(_manualMetersCtrl);
    return m > 0 ? m : 1.0;
  }

  /// Joriy tanlangan xizmat narxi (so'm / metr)
  double get _activeUnitPrice {
    final def = kStoneServices[_selectedServiceIdx];
    if (def.key == 'cut') {
      return _cutUnit == 'meter'
          ? StoneServicesStore.getPrice('cut_meter')
          : (StoneServicesStore.getAllPrices()['cut_m2'] ?? 25000);
    }
    if (def.key == 'polish') {
      return _polishStoneType == 'granite'
          ? StoneServicesStore.getPrice('polish_granite')
          : StoneServicesStore.getPrice('polish_ceramics');
    }
    return StoneServicesStore.getPrice(def.key);
  }

  double get _calculatedTotalPrice {
    return _calculatedTotalMeters * _activeUnitPrice;
  }

  void _adjustPieces(int delta) {
    final cur = _parsePieces();
    final next = (cur + delta).clamp(1, 9999);
    _piecesCtrl.text = next.toString();
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _adjustManualMeters(double delta) {
    final cur = _parseVal(_manualMetersCtrl);
    final next = (cur + delta);
    if (next < 0.1) return;
    _manualMetersCtrl.text = next == next.roundToDouble() ? next.toInt().toString() : next.toStringAsFixed(1);
    setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _addToCart() async {
    final def = kStoneServices[_selectedServiceIdx];
    final qty = _calculatedTotalMeters;
    final price = _activeUnitPrice;
    final note = _noteCtrl.text.trim();
    final pieces = _parsePieces();
    final l = _effectiveLengthM;
    final w = _effectiveWidthM;

    final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
    final cart = context.read<CartController>();

    int targetProductId = def.defaultProductId;
    String serviceDisplayName = def.name;

    if (def.key == 'cut') {
      if (_cutUnit == 'meter') {
        targetProductId = 19;
        serviceDisplayName = 'Razmer kesish (Metrda)';
      } else {
        targetProductId = 24;
        serviceDisplayName = 'Razmer kesish (Kvadratda)';
      }
    } else if (def.key == 'polish') {
      if (_polishStoneType == 'granite') {
        targetProductId = 21;
        serviceDisplayName = 'Silliqlash (Granit)';
      } else {
        targetProductId = 23;
        serviceDisplayName = 'Silliqlash (Keramogranit)';
      }
    }

    Product? targetProduct;
    try {
      final prods = await repos.products.list();
      targetProduct = prods.where((p) =>
          p.id == targetProductId ||
          p.name.trim().toLowerCase() == serviceDisplayName.toLowerCase()).firstOrNull;
    } catch (_) {}

    targetProduct ??= Product(
      id: targetProductId,
      name: serviceDisplayName,
      category: 'Xizmat',
      unit: def.unit,
      price: price,
      costPrice: 0,
      stock: 999999,
      minStock: 0,
    );

    // O'lcham va spetsifikatsiya matni
    String specText;
    final lenVal = _parseVal(_lengthCtrl);
    final widVal = _parseVal(_widthCtrl);
    final lenStr = '${lenVal % 1 == 0 ? lenVal.toInt() : lenVal} sm';
    final widStr = '${widVal % 1 == 0 ? widVal.toInt() : widVal} m';

    final pStr = pieces > 1 ? ' · $pieces dona' : '';
    if (def.key == 'cut') {
      if (_cutUnit == 'meter') {
        specText = '$lenStr × $widStr$pStr (eni: $qty metr)';
      } else {
        specText = '$lenStr × $widStr$pStr ($qty m²)';
      }
    } else {
      specText = '$qty ${def.unit}';
    }

    if (note.isNotEmpty) {
      specText = '$specText — $note';
    }

    cart.add(
      targetProduct,
      quantity: qty,
      cutLength: l > 0 ? l : null,
      cutWidth: w > 0 ? w : null,
      cutPieces: pieces > 0 ? pieces : null,
      cutSpec: specText,
    );

    // Agar narx yangilangan bo'lsa override qo'llaymiz
    if (cart.lines.isNotEmpty) {
      final line = cart.lines.last;
      if (line.product.id == targetProduct.id && line.unitPrice != price) {
        cart.update(line, unitPriceOverride: price);
      }
    }

    if (mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context, '$serviceDisplayName ($qty ${def.unit}) savatga qo‘shildi');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openAdminPriceConfig() async {
    final updated = await showDialog<bool>(

/// Admin uchun xizmatlar narxini sozlash va belgilash oynasi
class ServicesPriceConfigDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const ServicesPriceConfigDialog({super.key});

  @override
  State<ServicesPriceConfigDialog> createState() => _ServicesPriceConfigDialogState();
}

class _ServicesPriceConfigDialogState extends State<ServicesPriceConfigDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _cutMeterCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _cutM2Ctrl;
  late final TextEditingController _chamferCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _polishGraniteCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _polishCeramicsCtrl;
  late final TextEditingController _grooveCtrl;

  bool _saving = false;
  String? _error;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _cutMeterCtrl = TextEditingController(text: StoneServicesStore.getPrice('cut_meter').round().toString());
    _cutM2Ctrl = TextEditingController(text: (StoneServicesStore.getAllPrices()['cut_m2'] ?? 25000).round().toString());
    _chamferCtrl = TextEditingController(text: StoneServicesStore.getPrice('chamfer').round().toString());
    _polishGraniteCtrl = TextEditingController(text: StoneServicesStore.getPrice('polish_granite').round().toString());
    _polishCeramicsCtrl = TextEditingController(text: StoneServicesStore.getPrice('polish_ceramics').round().toString());
    _grooveCtrl = TextEditingController(text: StoneServicesStore.getPrice('groove').round().toString());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _cutMeterCtrl.dispose();
    _cutM2Ctrl.dispose();
    _chamferCtrl.dispose();
    _polishGraniteCtrl.dispose();
    _polishCeramicsCtrl.dispose();
    _grooveCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    setState(() {
      _saving = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      final repos = context.read<AppRepositories>();
      final prods = await repos.products.list();

      final cutMeterVal = parseInput(_cutMeterCtrl.text);
      final cutM2Val = parseInput(_cutM2Ctrl.text);
      final chamferVal = parseInput(_chamferCtrl.text);
      final polishGraniteVal = parseInput(_polishGraniteCtrl.text);
      final polishCeramicsVal = parseInput(_polishCeramicsCtrl.text);
      final grooveVal = parseInput(_grooveCtrl.text);

      if (cutMeterVal != null && cutMeterVal >= 0) {
        StoneServicesStore.setPrice('cut_meter', cutMeterVal);
        StoneServicesStore.setPrice('cut', cutMeterVal);
      }
      if (cutM2Val != null && cutM2Val >= 0) StoneServicesStore.setPrice('cut_m2', cutM2Val);
      if (chamferVal != null && chamferVal >= 0) StoneServicesStore.setPrice('chamfer', chamferVal);
      if (polishGraniteVal != null && polishGraniteVal >= 0) StoneServicesStore.setPrice('polish_granite', polishGraniteVal);
      if (polishCeramicsVal != null && polishCeramicsVal >= 0) StoneServicesStore.setPrice('polish_ceramics', polishCeramicsVal);
      if (grooveVal != null && grooveVal >= 0) StoneServicesStore.setPrice('groove', grooveVal);

      // Bazadagi mahsulotlarni yangilash
      for (final p in prods) {
        final name = p.name.trim().toLowerCase();
        double? newPrice;

        if (p.id == 19 || (name.contains('kesish') && !name.contains('kvadrat'))) {
          newPrice = cutMeterVal;
        } else if (p.id == 24 || (name.contains('kesish') && name.contains('kvadrat'))) {
          newPrice = cutM2Val;
        } else if (p.id == 20 || name == 'faska ochish') {
          newPrice = chamferVal;
        } else if (p.id == 21 || (name.contains('silliq') && name.contains('granit'))) {
          newPrice = polishGraniteVal;
        } else if (p.id == 23 || (name.contains('silliq') && name.contains('keramo'))) {
          newPrice = polishCeramicsVal;
        } else if (p.id == 22 || name == 'chizish') {
          newPrice = grooveVal;
        }

        if (newPrice != null && newPrice >= 0 && newPrice != p.price) {
          try {
            await repos.products.update(p.copyWith(price: newPrice));
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      }

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _saving = false;
          _error = 'Xatolik: $e';
        });
      }
    }
  }
```

```dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class UsersScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const UsersScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<UsersScreen> createState() => _UsersScreenState();
}

class _UsersScreenState extends State<UsersScreen> {
  int _currentTab = 0; // 0: Xodimlar, 1: Davomat (Keldi-Ketdi), 2: Oylik hisobi

  // Tab 0: Xodimlar
  late Future<List<AppUser>> _usersFuture;
  String _selectedFilter = 'Barchasi';
  final _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();

  // Tab 1: Davomat
  DateTime _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
  late Future<List<AttendanceRecord>> _attendanceFuture;
  final _attSearchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  String _attFilter = 'Barchasi'; // 'Barchasi', 'Kelganlar', 'Hali kelmaganlar', 'Kechikkanlar'

  // Tab 2: Oylik hisobi
  DateTime _selectedMonth = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  final int _totalWorkingDays = 26;
  late Future<List<SalaryReportItem>> _salaryFuture;

  UserRepository get _usersRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().users;
  AttendanceRepository get _attRepo => context.read<AppRepositories>().attendance;

  String get _dateStr =>
      '${_selectedDate.year}-${_selectedDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${_selectedDate.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

  String get _monthStr =>
      '${_selectedMonth.year}-${_selectedMonth.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _reloadUsers();
    _reloadAttendance();
    _reloadSalary();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    _attSearchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _reloadUsers() {
    setState(() {
      _usersFuture = _usersRepo.list();
    });
  }

  void _reloadAttendance() {
    setState(() {
      _attendanceFuture = _attRepo.list(date: _dateStr);
    });
  }

  void _reloadSalary() {
    setState(() {
      _salaryFuture = _attRepo.getSalaryReport(
        month: _monthStr,
        totalWorkingDays: _totalWorkingDays,
      );
    });
  }

  void _reloadAll() {
    _reloadUsers();
    _reloadAttendance();
    _reloadSalary();
  }

  // --- Xodim qo'shish va tahrirlash ---
  Future<void> _addUser() async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => UserDialog(repo: _usersRepo),
    );
    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Yangi xodim muvaffaqiyatli qo‘shildi');
      _reloadAll();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editUser(AppUser user) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => UserDialog(repo: _usersRepo, user: user),
    );
    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Xodim ma’lumotlari yangilandi');
      _reloadAll();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _toggleUserStatus(AppUser user) async {
    final action = user.isActive ? 'bloklash' : 'faollashtirish';
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22)),
        title: Text(
          user.isActive ? 'Xodimni bloklash' : 'Xodimni faollashtirish',
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18),
        ),
        content: Text(
          user.isActive
              ? '"${user.fullName}" hisobini bloklamoqchimisiz? U tizimga kira olmaydi.'
              : '"${user.fullName}" hisobini qayta faollashtirmoqchimisiz?',
          style: const TextStyle(height: 1.4, color: AppColors.muted),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Bekor'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: user.isActive ? AppColors.danger : AppColors.darkCard,
            ),
            child: Text(user.isActive ? 'Bloklash' : 'Faollashtirish'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    try {
      await _usersRepo.update(
        user.id,
        fullName: user.fullName,
        role: user.role,
        isActive: !user.isActive,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, 'Xodim muvaffaqiyatli $action qilindi');
        _reloadAll();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(context, 'Xatolik: $e', error: true);
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Davomat amallari ---
  Future<void> _checkIn(AppUser user, {String status = 'present'}) async {
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      if (status == 'late' || status == 'absent') {
        final rec = AttendanceRecord(
          id: 0,
          userId: user.id,
          userName: user.fullName,
          date: _dateStr,
          status: status,
          checkIn: status == 'absent' ? null : now,
          workedHours: 0,
        );
        await _attRepo.saveRecord(rec);
      } else {
        await _attRepo.checkIn(user.id, time: now);
      }
      if (mounted) {
        final statusLabel = status == 'late'
            ? 'kechikkan'
            : (status == 'absent' ? 'kelmagan' : 'keldi');
        showMessage(
          context,
          '✓ ${user.fullName} $statusLabel deb qayd etildi (${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')})',
        );
        _reloadAttendance();
        _reloadSalary();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(context, 'Xatolik: $e', error: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkInAllAbsent(List<AppUser> absentUsers) async {
    if (absentUsers.isEmpty) return;
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(

          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Hali kelmagan ${absentUsers.length} nafar xodim uchun hozirgi vaqt bilan kirish (keldi) qayd etilsinmi?',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
          ),
          FilledButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: AppColors.green,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
            ),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 18),
            label: const Text('Ha, barchasini belgilash'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true) return;

    final now = DateTime.now();
    int count = 0;
    try {
      await _attRepo.bulkCheckIn(absentUsers.map((u) => u.id).toList(), time: now, date: _dateStr);
      count = absentUsers.length;
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback
      for (final u in absentUsers) {
        try {
          await _attRepo.checkIn(u.id, time: now);
          count++;
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        if (count > 0) {
          showMessage(context, '✓ $count nafar xodim keldi deb belgilandi');
        }
        _reloadAttendance();
        _reloadSalary();
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkOut(AppUser user) async {
    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      await _attRepo.checkOut(user.id, time: now);
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          '✓ ${user.fullName} ketdi deb qayd etildi (${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')})',
        );
        _reloadAttendance();
        _reloadSalary();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(context, 'Xatolik: $e', error: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkOutAllWorking(List<AppUser> workingUsers) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFFEA580C).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: const Icon(Icons.logout_rounded, color: Color(0xFFEA580C), size: 20),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            const Text('Hammasini ketdi qilish', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ],
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Barcha hozir ishlayotgan xodimlarning (${workingUsers.length} ta) ish vaqtini yakunlamoqchimisiz?\nChiqish vaqti hozirgi vaqt deb belgilanadi.',
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Bekor qilish'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEA580C),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
            ),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Ha, barchasini yakunlash', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;

    try {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      for (final u in workingUsers) {
        await _attRepo.checkOut(u.id, time: now);
      }
      if (mounted) {
        showMessage(
          context,
          '✓ ${workingUsers.length} ta xodimning ish vaqti yakunlandi (${now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')})',
        );
        _reloadAttendance();
        _reloadSalary();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) showMessage(context, 'Xatolik: $e', error: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _editAttendance(AppUser user, AttendanceRecord? rec) async {
    final ok = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => AttendanceDialog(
        repo: _attRepo,
        user: user,
        date: _dateStr,
        record: rec,
      ),
    );
    if (ok == true && mounted) {
      showMessage(context, 'Davomat ma’lumotlari saqlandi');
      _reloadAttendance();
      _reloadSalary();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.scaffoldBg,
      floatingActionButton: _buildFab(),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // 1. Yuqori zamonaviy Tab Switcher
          _buildTopTabs(),

          // 2. Tab mazmuni
          Expanded(
            child: IndexedStack(
              index: _currentTab,
              children: [
                _buildUsersTab(),
                _buildAttendanceTab(),
                _buildSalaryTab(),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget? _buildFab() {
    if (_currentTab == 0) {
      return FloatingActionButton.extended(
        backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
        foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
        onPressed: _addUser,
        icon: Icon(Icons.person_add_rounded, color: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : AppColors.neonLime),
        label: const Text('Xodim qo‘shish', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
      );
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Top Tabs (Burchaksiz zamonaviy kapsula / Segmented UI)

    final tabs = [

      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.cardColor,
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6))),
      ),
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF161E28) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
            border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7)),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) ...[
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () => setState(() => _currentTab = i),

                          size: 16,

                              ? (isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)

                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        Text(
                          tabs[i].$1,

                            fontSize: 13,

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // TAB 0: Xodimlar Ro'yxati
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _buildUsersTab() {
    final filterOptions = ['Barchasi', 'Adminlar', 'Kassirlar', 'Ishchilar', 'Haydovchilar', 'Dasturga kiradiganlar', 'Faqat ro‘yxatdagilar', 'Bloklanganlar'];

    return FutureBuilder<List<AppUser>>(
      future: _usersFuture,
      builder: (context, snap) {
        if (snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snap.hasError) {
          return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reloadUsers);
        }

        final allUsers = snap.data ?? [];
        final totalCount = allUsers.length;
        final adminCount = allUsers.where((u) => u.role == Role.admin).length;
        final cashierCount = allUsers.where((u) => u.role == Role.kassir).length;
        final workerCount = allUsers.where((u) => u.role == Role.ishchi).length;
        final driverCount = allUsers.where((u) => u.role == Role.haydovchi).length;
        final blockedCount = allUsers.where((u) => !u.isActive).length;

        var users = allUsers.where((u) {
          final query = _searchCtrl.text.toLowerCase().trim();
          final matchesSearch = query.isEmpty ||
              u.fullName.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
              u.username.toLowerCase().contains(query);

          if (!matchesSearch) return false;

          switch (_selectedFilter) {
            case 'Adminlar':
              return u.role == Role.admin && u.isActive;
            case 'Kassirlar':
              return u.role == Role.kassir && u.isActive;
            case 'Ishchilar':
              return u.role == Role.ishchi && u.isActive;
            case 'Haydovchilar':
              return u.role == Role.haydovchi && u.isActive;
            case 'Dasturga kiradiganlar':
              return u.canLogin && u.isActive;
            case 'Faqat ro‘yxatdagilar':
              return !u.canLogin && u.isActive;
            case 'Bloklanganlar':
              return !u.isActive;
            default:
              return true;
          }
        }).toList();

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async => _reloadUsers(),
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            children: [
              // KPI Kartalari
              Row(
                children: [
                  _buildKpiCard('Jami Xodimlar', '$totalCount ta', Icons.badge_rounded, AppColors.ink),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _buildKpiCard('Adminlar', '$adminCount ta', Icons.admin_panel_settings_rounded, AppColors.neonLime),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _buildKpiCard('Kassirlar', '$cashierCount ta', Icons.point_of_sale_rounded, AppColors.green),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _buildKpiCard('Ishchilar', '$workerCount ta', Icons.precision_manufacturing_rounded, const Color(0xFFD97706)),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // Qidiruv va Filter
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: SizedBox(
                      height: 42,
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: _searchCtrl,
                        onChanged: (_) => setState(() {}),
                        decoration: InputDecoration(
                          hintText: 'Xodim nomi yoki logini bo‘yicha qidirish...',
                          prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, size: 20),
                          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 0),
                          filled: true,
                          fillColor: context.cardColor,
                          border: OutlineInputBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            borderSide: BorderSide(color: context.borderColor),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),

              // Filter teglari
              SingleChildScrollView(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                child: Row(
                  children: filterOptions.map((f) {
                    final isSel = _selectedFilter == f;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                      child: ChoiceChip(
                        label: Text(f, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500)),
                        selected: isSel,
                        onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _selectedFilter = f),
                        visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // Xodimlar ro'yxati
              if (users.isEmpty)
                Center(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(40),
                    child: Column(
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.person_off_rounded, size: 48, color: context.mutedColor.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        Text('Xodimlar topilmadi', style: TextStyle(color: context.mutedColor, fontSize: 14)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                )
              else
                for (final u in users) _buildUserCard(u),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(

                              'Kirish ruxsati bor',
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: AppColors.green),
                            ),
```
