```dart
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // TAB 1: Davomat (Keldi / Ketdi) - Zamonaviy, qulay va tezkor UI
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _buildAttendanceTab() {
    return FutureBuilder<List<dynamic>>(
      future: Future.wait([_usersFuture, _attendanceFuture]),
      builder: (context, snap) {
        if (snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snap.hasError) {
          return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reloadAttendance);
        }

        final users = (snap.data?[0] as List<AppUser>?)?.where((u) => u.isActive).toList() ?? [];
        final attendances = (snap.data?[1] as List<AttendanceRecord>?) ?? [];

        final attMap = <int, AttendanceRecord>{};
        for (final a in attendances) {
          attMap[a.userId] = a;
        }

        final presentCount = attendances.where((a) => a.checkIn != null).length;
        final lateCount = attendances.where((a) => a.status == 'late').length;
        final totalActive = users.length;
        final absentUsers = users.where((u) => attMap[u.id]?.checkIn == null).toList();
        final absentCount = absentUsers.length;
        final workingUsers = users.where((u) {
          final a = attMap[u.id];
          return a?.checkIn != null && a?.checkOut == null;
        }).toList();

        // Qidiruv va filtr bo'yicha saralash
        final query = _attSearchCtrl.text.toLowerCase().trim();
        final filteredUsers = users.where((u) {
          final matchesSearch = query.isEmpty ||
              u.fullName.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
              u.username.toLowerCase().contains(query);
          if (!matchesSearch) return false;

          final att = attMap[u.id];
          final hasCheckedIn = att?.checkIn != null;
          final isLate = att?.status == 'late';

          switch (_attFilter) {
            case 'Kelganlar':
              return hasCheckedIn;
            case 'Hali kelmaganlar':
              return !hasCheckedIn;
            case 'Kechikkanlar':
              return isLate;
            default:
              return true;
          }
        }).toList();

        final isToday = _isToday(_selectedDate);

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async => _reloadAttendance(),
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            children: [
              // 1. Sana boshqaruvi (O‘ng tomonga yopishtirilgan, yaxlit va qulay zamonaviy kapsula)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4, vertical: 3.5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.cardColor,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                      border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: context.isDark ? 0.25 : 0.04),
                          blurRadius: 8,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        // Tezkor 'Kecha' va 'Bugun'
                        _buildQuickDateChip('Kecha', DateTime.now().subtract(const Duration(days: 1))),
                        const SizedBox(width: 3),
                        _buildQuickDateChip('Bugun', DateTime.now()),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),

                        // Ajratuvchi nozik chiziq
                        Container(
                          width: 1,
                          height: 22,
                          color: context.borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),

                        // Oldingi kun <
                        IconButton(
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded, size: 22),
                          onPressed: () {
                            setState(() {
                              _selectedDate = _selectedDate.subtract(const Duration(days: 1));
                              _reloadAttendance();
                            });
                          },
                          tooltip: 'Oldingi kun',
                          splashRadius: 18,
                          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        ),

                        // Markaziy interaktiv sana (Stonex Custom Kalendar)
                        InkWell(
                          onTap: () async {
                            final picked = await StonexDatePickerDialog.show(
                              context: context,
                              initialDate: _selectedDate,
                            );
                            if (picked != null) {
                              setState(() {
                                _selectedDate = picked;
                                _reloadAttendance();
                              });
                            }
                          },
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                          child: AnimatedContainer(
                            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 6.5),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: isToday
                                  ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.15) : const Color(0xFFF0FDF4))
                                  : context.pillColor,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
                              border: Border.all(
                                color: isToday
                                    ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF22C55E))
                                    : context.borderColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                                width: isToday ? 1.2 : 1.0,
                              ),
                            ),
                            child: Row(
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                                  size: 16,
                                  color: isToday
                                      ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A))
                                      : context.inkColor,
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                Text(
                                  _formatDateUz(_selectedDate),
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    color: isToday
                                        ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF15803D))
                                        : context.inkColor,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded,
                                  size: 16,
                                  color: isToday
                                      ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A))
                                      : context.mutedColor,
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),

                        // Keyingi kun >
                        IconButton(
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, size: 22),
                          onPressed: () {
                            setState(() {
                              _selectedDate = _selectedDate.add(const Duration(days: 1));
                              _reloadAttendance();
                            });
                          },
                          tooltip: 'Keyingi kun',
                          splashRadius: 18,
                          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // 2. KPI statistika kartalari
              Row(

  Widget _buildQuickDateChip(String label, DateTime targetDate) {
    final isSelected = _selectedDate.year == targetDate.year &&
        _selectedDate.month == targetDate.month &&
        _selectedDate.day == targetDate.day;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _selectedDate = targetDate;
          _reloadAttendance();
        });
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
          boxShadow: isSelected
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: context.isDark ? 0.25 : 0.1),
                    blurRadius: 4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                  ),
                ]
              : null,
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
            color: isSelected
                ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)
                : context.mutedColor,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _formatDateUz(DateTime dt) {
    const months = [
      'yanvar', 'fevral', 'mart', 'aprel', 'may', 'iyun',
      'iyul', 'avgust', 'sentabr', 'oktabr', 'noyabr', 'dekabr'
    ];
    const weekdays = [
      'Dushanba', 'Seshanba', 'Chorshanba', 'Payshanba', 'Juma', 'Shanba', 'Yakshanba'
    ];
    final dayName = weekdays[dt.weekday - 1];
    final monthName = months[dt.month - 1];
    return '${dt.day}-$monthName, ${dt.year} ($dayName)';
  }

  bool _isToday(DateTime d) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    return d.year == now.year && d.month == now.month && d.day == now.day;
  }

  String _getInitials(String name) {
    final parts = name.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+'));
    if (parts.isEmpty || parts[0].isEmpty) return '?';
    if (parts.length == 1) {
      return parts[0].substring(0, parts[0].length >= 2 ? 2 : 1).toUpperCase();
    }
    return '${parts[0][0]}${parts[1][0]}'.toUpperCase();
  }

  String _formatTime(DateTime dt) {
    return '${dt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // TAB 2: Oylik va Ish haqi hisoboti (Payroll)

  Widget _buildSalaryTab() {
    return FutureBuilder<List<SalaryReportItem>>(
      future: _salaryFuture,
      builder: (context, snap) {
        if (snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
          return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
        }
        if (snap.hasError) {
          return ErrorView(message: snap.error.toString(), onRetry: _reloadSalary);
        }

        final reports = snap.data ?? [];
        final totalNet = reports.fold(0.0, (sum, r) => sum + r.netSalary);
        final totalBase = reports.fold(0.0, (sum, r) => sum + r.baseSalary);
        final totalDeductions = reports.fold(0.0, (sum, r) => sum + r.deduction);

        return RefreshIndicator(
          onRefresh: () async => _reloadSalary(),
          child: ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            children: [
              // Oy tanlash paneli
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.cardColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded),
                      onPressed: () {
                        setState(() {
                          _selectedMonth = DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month - 1);
                          _reloadSalary();
                        });
                      },
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Center(
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            const Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded, size: 16, color: AppColors.neonLime),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              '$_monthStr Oylik Ish Haqi Hisoboti',
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, color: context.inkColor),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded),
                      onPressed: () {
                        setState(() {
                          _selectedMonth = DateTime(_selectedMonth.year, _selectedMonth.month + 1);
                          _reloadSalary();
                        });
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // KPI kartalari
              Row(
                children: [
                  _buildKpiCard('Jami Hisoblangan', money(totalNet), Icons.payments_rounded, AppColors.neonLime),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _buildKpiCard('Rejadagi Fond', money(totalBase), Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded, AppColors.ink),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _buildKpiCard('Kechikish jarimalari', '-${money(totalDeductions)}', Icons.gavel_rounded, AppColors.danger),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // Xodimlarning oylik hisobot kartalari
              for (final rep in reports) _buildSalaryItemCard(rep),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSalaryItemCard(SalaryReportItem r) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      r.fullName,
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 14.5, color: context.inkColor),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'Stavka: ${money(r.baseSalary)} / ${r.salaryType == "daily" ? "kun" : (r.salaryType == "hourly" ? "soat" : (r.salaryType == "trip" ? "reys" : "oy"))}',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: context.mutedColor),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    money(r.netSalary),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, fontSize: 16, color: AppColors.green),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    'To‘lanadigan sof maosh',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: context.mutedColor),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: context.pillColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  '📅 Davomat: ${r.daysWorked}/$_totalWorkingDays kun (${r.hoursWorked.toStringAsFixed(1)} soat)',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: context.inkColor),
                ),
                if (r.daysLate > 0)
                  Text(
                    '⚠ ${r.daysLate} kun kechikdi (-${money(r.deduction)})',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: AppColors.danger),
                  )
                else
                  const Text(
                    '✓ Intizomli',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: AppColors.green),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildKpiCard(String label, String value, IconData icon, Color color) {
    return Expanded(
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.cardColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(icon, size: 14, color: color),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    label,
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: context.mutedColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              value,
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w900, color: context.inkColor),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Xodim qo'shish va tahrirlash dialogi
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class UserDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const UserDialog({super.key, required this.repo, this.user});
  final UserRepository repo;
  final AppUser? user;

  @override
  State<UserDialog> createState() => _UserDialogState();
}

class _UserDialogState extends State<UserDialog> {
  late final _userCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.user?.username ?? '');
  late final _nameCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.user?.fullName ?? '');
  final _passCtrl = TextEditingController();
  late Role _role = widget.user?.role ?? Role.ishchi;
  late String _salaryType = widget.user?.salaryType ?? (_role == Role.haydovchi ? 'trip' : 'monthly');
  late final _salaryCtrl = TextEditingController(
    text: widget.user != null
        ? widget.user!.salary.toInt().toString()
        : (_role == Role.haydovchi ? '0' : '5000000'),
  );
  late bool _isActive = widget.user?.isActive ?? true;
  late bool _canLogin = widget.user?.canLogin ?? (_role != Role.ishchi);

  String? _error;
  bool _busy = false;

  bool get _isEditing => widget.user != null;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _userCtrl.dispose();
    _nameCtrl.dispose();
    _passCtrl.dispose();
    _salaryCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    final n = _nameCtrl.text.trim();
    final sal = double.tryParse(_salaryCtrl.text.replaceAll(' ', '')) ?? 0;

    if (n.isEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _error = 'Xodimning to‘liq ismini kiriting';
      });
      return;
    }

    final u = _userCtrl.text.trim();
    final p = _passCtrl.text;

    if (_canLogin) {
      if (u.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Dasturga kirish uchun loginni kiriting';
        });
        return;
      }
      if (!_isEditing && p.isEmpty) {
        setState(() {
          _error = 'Dasturga kirish uchun parol kiritish shart';
        });
        return;
      }
    }

    setState(() {
      _busy = true;
      _error = null;
    });

    try {
      if (_isEditing) {
        await widget.repo.update(
          widget.user!.id,
          username: _canLogin ? u : null,
          fullName: n,
          password: (_canLogin && p.isNotEmpty) ? p : null,
          role: _role,
          canLogin: _canLogin,
          salary: sal,
          salaryType: _salaryType,
          isActive: _isActive,
        );
      } else {
        await widget.repo.create(
          username: _canLogin ? u : null,
          fullName: n,
          password: _canLogin ? p : null,
          role: _role,
          canLogin: _canLogin,
          salary: sal,
          salaryType: _salaryType,
        );
      }
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      setState(() {
        _busy = false;
        _error = e.toString();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: context.pillColor,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(
              _isEditing ? Icons.manage_accounts_rounded : Icons.person_add_rounded,
              color: context.inkColor,
              size: 20,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Text(
            _isEditing ? 'Xodimni tahrirlash' : 'Yangi xodim qo‘shish',
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 18),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 420,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // 1. To'liq ismi (F.I.O)
              TextField(
                controller: _nameCtrl,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'To‘liq ismi (F.I.O)',
                  hintText: 'masalan: Bobur Rahimov',
                  prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.badge_outlined),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // 2. Tizimdagi roli
              DropdownButtonFormField<Role>(
                value: _role,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Tizimdagi roli',
                  prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.work_outline_rounded),
                ),
                items: Role.values
                    .map((r) => DropdownMenuItem(
                          value: r,
                          child: Text(r.label),
                        ))
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: (v) {
                  setState(() {
                    _role = v ?? _role;
                    if (_role == Role.admin || _role == Role.kassir || _role == Role.haydovchi) {
                      _canLogin = true;
                    }
                    if (_role == Role.haydovchi) {
                      _salaryType = 'trip';
                      if (_salaryCtrl.text == '5000000' || _salaryCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
                        _salaryCtrl.text = '0';
                      }
                    } else if (_salaryType == 'trip') {
                      _salaryType = 'monthly';
                      if (_salaryCtrl.text == '0') {
                        _salaryCtrl.text = '5000000';
                      }
                    }
                  });
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // 3. Dasturga kirish huquqi (Login & Parol) switch card
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: context.pillColor,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(color: context.borderColor),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      _canLogin ? Icons.lock_open_rounded : Icons.lock_clock_rounded,
                      size: 20,
                      color: _canLogin
                          ? (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.ink)
                          : context.mutedColor,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          const Text(
                            'Dasturga kirish huquqi',
                            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 13),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            _canLogin
                                ? 'Login va parol orqali tizimga kira oladi'
                                : 'Faqat ro‘yxatda (dasturga kirmaydi, login/parol shart emas)',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: _canLogin ? AppColors.green : context.mutedColor,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Switch(
                      value: _canLogin,
                      activeColor: AppColors.green,
                      onChanged: (_role == Role.admin || _role == Role.kassir)
                          ? null
                          : (v) => setState(() => _canLogin = v),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // 4. Login & Parol maydonlari (agar dasturga kirishi kerak bo'lsa)
              if (_canLogin) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: _userCtrl,
                  enabled: !_isEditing,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Login (foydalanuvchi nomi)',
                    hintText: 'masalan: bobur_uz',
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.alternate_email_rounded),
                    helperText: _isEditing ? 'Loginni o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi' : null,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: _passCtrl,
                  obscureText: true,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: _isEditing ? 'Yangi parol (ixtiyoriy)' : 'Parol',
                    hintText: _isEditing ? 'O‘zgartirmaslik uchun bo‘sh qoldiring' : 'Kamida 6 ta belgi',
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.password_rounded),
                  ),
                ),
              ] else ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A)).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: (context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A)).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                        size: 18,
                        color: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Xodim faqat ro‘yxatda saqlanadi. U ishlab chiqarish vazifalarida (kesish, faska, silliqlash), davomatda va oylik hisobida to‘liq qatnashadi, ammo dasturga kirish uchun login va parol talab etilmaydi.',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            height: 1.4,
                            color: context.inkColor,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // 5. Maosh stavkasi
              TextField(
                controller: _salaryCtrl,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: _salaryType == 'trip'
                      ? 'Reys stavkasi (0 bo‘lsa buyurtmadagi yo‘l haqi)'
                      : 'Maosh stavkasi (so‘m)',
                  hintText: _salaryType == 'trip' ? '0' : '5000000',
                  helperText: _salaryType == 'trip'
                      ? '0 bo‘lsa, yetkazilgan buyurtmalardagi yo‘l haqi summasi to‘lanadi'
                      : null,
                  prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.payments_outlined),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // 6. Maosh hisoblash turi
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                value: _salaryType,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Maosh hisoblash turi',
                  prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded),
                ),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'monthly', child: Text('Oylik (oybay fixed)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'daily', child: Text('Kunlik (kunbay stavka)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'hourly', child: Text('Soatlik (soatbay stavka)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'trip', child: Text('Reysbay (yetkazilgan buyurtmalardan)')),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) {
                  setState(() {
                    _salaryType = v ?? 'monthly';
                    if (_salaryType == 'trip' && _salaryCtrl.text == '5000000') {
                      _salaryCtrl.text = '0';
                    }
                  });
                },
              ),
              if (_isEditing) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: context.pillColor,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            const Text('Xodim holati', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 13)),
                            Text(
                              _isActive ? 'Faol xodim' : 'Hisob bloklangan',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                color: _isActive ? AppColors.green : AppColors.danger,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      Switch(
                        value: _isActive,
                        activeColor: AppColors.green,
                        onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _isActive = v),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              if (_error != null)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.isDark ? const Color(0xFF331616) : const Color(0xFFFFECEB),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      _error!,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.danger, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
          child: const Text('Bekor'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit,
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
            foregroundColor: context.isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 12),
          ),
          child: _busy
              ? const SizedBox(
                  width: 18,
                  height: 18,
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: Colors.white),
                )
              : Text(_isEditing ? 'Saqlash' : 'Qo‘shish', style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Davomatni tahrirlash dialogi
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class AttendanceDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const AttendanceDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.repo,
    required this.user,
    required this.date,
    this.record,
  });

  final AttendanceRepository repo;
  final AppUser user;
  final String date;
  final AttendanceRecord? record;

  @override
  State<AttendanceDialog> createState() => _AttendanceDialogState();
}

class _AttendanceDialogState extends State<AttendanceDialog> {
  late TimeOfDay _checkInTime;
  late TimeOfDay _checkOutTime;
  late String _status = widget.record?.status ?? 'present';
  late final _noteCtrl = TextEditingController(text: widget.record?.note ?? '');
  bool _hasCheckIn = false;
  bool _hasCheckOut = false;
  bool _busy = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.record?.checkIn != null) {
      _hasCheckIn = true;
      _checkInTime = TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(widget.record!.checkIn!);
    } else {
      _checkInTime = const TimeOfDay(hour: 8, minute: 30);
    }

    if (widget.record?.checkOut != null) {
      _hasCheckOut = true;
      _checkOutTime = TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(widget.record!.checkOut!);
    } else {
      _checkOutTime = const TimeOfDay(hour: 18, minute: 0);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _noteCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _submit() async {
    setState(() => _busy = true);

    DateTime? inDt;
    DateTime? outDt;
    final parts = widget.date.split('-');
    final y = int.parse(parts[0]);
    final m = int.parse(parts[1]);
    final d = int.parse(parts[2]);

    if (_hasCheckIn) {
      inDt = DateTime(y, m, d, _checkInTime.hour, _checkInTime.minute);
    }
    if (_hasCheckOut) {
      outDt = DateTime(y, m, d, _checkOutTime.hour, _checkOutTime.minute);
    }

    double worked = 0;
    if (inDt != null && outDt != null) {
      worked = double.parse((outDt.difference(inDt).inMinutes / 60.0).clamp(0.0, 24.0).toStringAsFixed(1));
    }

    final rec = AttendanceRecord(
      id: widget.record?.id ?? 0,
      userId: widget.user.id,
      userName: widget.user.fullName,
      date: widget.date,
      checkIn: inDt,
      checkOut: outDt,
      workedHours: worked,
      status: _status,
      note: _noteCtrl.text.trim(),
    );

    try {
      await widget.repo.saveRecord(rec);
      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _busy = false);
        showMessage(context, 'Xatolik: $e', error: true);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      backgroundColor: context.dialogBg,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      title: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: AppColors.greenSoft,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: const Icon(Icons.access_time_rounded, color: AppColors.darkCard, size: 20),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Text(widget.user.fullName, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 16)),
                Text('${widget.date} davomati', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: context.mutedColor)),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 380,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // Kelish vaqti
              CheckboxListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Text('Kelgan vaqti: ${_checkInTime.format(context)}'),
                value: _hasCheckIn,
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _hasCheckIn = v ?? false),
                secondary: IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.schedule_rounded),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final t = await showTimePicker(context: context, initialTime: _checkInTime);
                    if (t != null) setState(() => _checkInTime = t);
                  },
                ),
              ),
              // Ketish vaqti
              CheckboxListTile(
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                title: Text('Ketgan vaqti: ${_checkOutTime.format(context)}'),
                value: _hasCheckOut,
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _hasCheckOut = v ?? false),
                secondary: IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.schedule_rounded),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final t = await showTimePicker(context: context, initialTime: _checkOutTime);
                    if (t != null) setState(() => _checkOutTime = t);
                  },
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                value: _status,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Davomat holati'),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'present', child: Text('✓ Kelgan (Vaqtida)')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'late', child: Text('⚠ Kechikkan')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'half_day', child: Text('⏱ Yarim kun')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'absent', child: Text('✕ Kelmagan')),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _status = v ?? 'present'),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                controller: _noteCtrl,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'Izoh / Sababi',
                  hintText: 'masalan: Navbatchilikda bo‘ldi, ruxsat olgan...',
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false), child: const Text('Bekor')),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: _busy ? null : _submit,
          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: AppColors.neonLime,
            foregroundColor: AppColors.ink,
          ),
          child: const Text('Saqlash', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Stonex ERP Maxsus Zamonaviy Sana Tanlash Dialogi (StonexDatePickerDialog)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class StonexDatePickerDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  final DateTime initialDate;
  final DateTime firstDate;
  final DateTime lastDate;

  const StonexDatePickerDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.initialDate,
    required this.firstDate,
    required this.lastDate,
  });

  static Future<DateTime?> show({
    required BuildContext context,
    required DateTime initialDate,
    DateTime? firstDate,
    DateTime? lastDate,
  }) {
    return showDialog<DateTime>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: true,
      builder: (_) => StonexDatePickerDialog(
        initialDate: initialDate,
        firstDate: firstDate ?? DateTime(2025),
        lastDate: lastDate ?? DateTime(2030),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<StonexDatePickerDialog> createState() => _StonexDatePickerDialogState();
}

class _StonexDatePickerDialogState extends State<StonexDatePickerDialog> {
  late DateTime _selected;
  late DateTime _viewMonth;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _selected = widget.initialDate;
    _viewMonth = DateTime(_selected.year, _selected.month, 1);
  }

  void _prevMonth() {
    setState(() {
      _viewMonth = DateTime(_viewMonth.year, _viewMonth.month - 1, 1);
    });
  }

  void _nextMonth() {
    setState(() {
      _viewMonth = DateTime(_viewMonth.year, _viewMonth.month + 1, 1);
    });
  }

  bool _isSameDay(DateTime a, DateTime b) {
    return a.year == b.year && a.month == b.month && a.day == b.day;
  }

  String _monthNameUz(int m) {
    const months = [
      'Yanvar', 'Fevral', 'Mart', 'Aprel', 'May', 'Iyun',
      'Iyul', 'Avgust', 'Sentabr', 'Oktabr', 'Noyabr', 'Dekabr'
    ];
    return months[m - 1];
  }

  String _formatFullDate(DateTime dt) {
    const weekdays = [
      'Dushanba', 'Seshanba', 'Chorshanba', 'Payshanba', 'Juma', 'Shanba', 'Yakshanba'
    ];
    final wName = weekdays[dt.weekday - 1];
    final mName = _monthNameUz(dt.month).toLowerCase();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final isToday = _isSameDay(dt, now);
    final isYesterday = _isSameDay(dt, now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1)));
    final suffix = isToday ? ' · Bugun' : (isYesterday ? ' · Kecha' : '');
    return '${dt.day}-$mName, ${dt.year} ($wName)$suffix';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = context.isDark;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final daysInMonth = DateTime(_viewMonth.year, _viewMonth.month + 1, 0).day;
    final startOffset = _viewMonth.weekday - 1; // 0 for Mon .. 6 for Sun
    final totalCells = startOffset + daysInMonth;
    final rowCount = (totalCells / 7).ceil();

    return Dialog(
      backgroundColor: context.cardColor,
      surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24)),
      insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 24),
      child: Container(
        width: 360,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // 1. Sarlavha va yopish tugmasi
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(7),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.15) : const Color(0xFFDCFCE7),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.calendar_month_rounded,
                    size: 18,
                    color: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF16A34A),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    'Sana tanlash',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                      color: context.inkColor,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 20),
                  onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                  splashRadius: 18,
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // 2. Tanlangan sana ko'rsatgichi
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? const Color(0xFF161E28) : const Color(0xFFF1F5F9),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: isDark
                      ? AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.3)
                      : const Color(0xFF22C55E).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Tanlangan sana:',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: context.mutedColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(
                    _formatFullDate(_selected),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF15803D),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // 3. Tezkor tugmalar (Presets)
            SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  _presetButton('Bugun', now),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  _presetButton('Kecha', now.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  _presetButton('2 kun oldin', now.subtract(const Duration(days: 2))),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  _presetButton('Hafta boshi (Du)', now.subtract(Duration(days: now.weekday - 1))),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // 4. Oy va Yil almashtirish navigatori
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: context.pillColor,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left_rounded, size: 22),
                    onPressed: _prevMonth,
                    tooltip: 'Oldingi oy',
                    splashRadius: 18,
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    '${_monthNameUz(_viewMonth.month)} ${_viewMonth.year}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      color: context.inkColor,
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, size: 22),
                    onPressed: _nextMonth,
                    tooltip: 'Keyingi oy',
                    splashRadius: 18,
                    visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // 5. Hafta kunlari sarlavhasi
            Row(
              children: const ['Du', 'Se', 'Ch', 'Pa', 'Ju', 'Sh', 'Ya'].map((d) {
                final isWeekend = d == 'Sh' || d == 'Ya';
                return Expanded(
                  child: Center(
                    child: Text(
                      d,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: isWeekend ? AppColors.danger : context.mutedColor,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),

            // 6. Kalendar kunlari panjarasi (Grid)
            Column(
              children: [
                for (var r = 0; r < rowCount; r++)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2.5),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        for (var c = 0; c < 7; c++) ...[
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildDayCell(r * 7 + c, startOffset, daysInMonth, now),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // 7. Amallar: Bekor qilish va Tanlash
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextButton(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
                    ),
                    child: Text('Bekor qilish', style: TextStyle(color: context.mutedColor, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, _selected),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, size: 16),
                    label: const Text('Tanlash', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard,
                      foregroundColor: isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDayCell(int cellIndex, int startOffset, int daysInMonth, DateTime now) {
    final dayNum = cellIndex - startOffset + 1;
    if (dayNum < 1 || dayNum > daysInMonth) {
      return const SizedBox(height: 34);
    }

    final cellDate = DateTime(_viewMonth.year, _viewMonth.month, dayNum);
    final isSel = _isSameDay(cellDate, _selected);
    final isToday = _isSameDay(cellDate, now);
    final isWeekend = cellDate.weekday == DateTime.saturday || cellDate.weekday == DateTime.sunday;
    final isDark = context.isDark;

    return Center(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () {
          setState(() {
            _selected = cellDate;
          });
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
        child: Container(
          width: 34,
          height: 34,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: isSel
                ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard)
                : (isToday
                    ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime.withValues(alpha: 0.15) : const Color(0xFFDCFCE7))
                    : Colors.transparent),
            border: isToday && !isSel
                ? Border.all(
                    color: isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF22C55E),
                    width: 1.4,
                  )
                : null,
            boxShadow: isSel
                ? [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : Colors.black).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
                      blurRadius: 6,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                    ),
                  ]
                : null,
          ),
          child: Center(
            child: Text(
              '$dayNum',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12.5,
                fontWeight: (isSel || isToday) ? FontWeight.w900 : FontWeight.w600,
                color: isSel
                    ? (isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)
                    : (isToday
                        ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : const Color(0xFF15803D))
                        : (isWeekend ? AppColors.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.8) : context.inkColor)),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _presetButton(String label, DateTime targetDate) {
    final isSel = _isSameDay(_selected, targetDate);
    final isDark = context.isDark;
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        setState(() {
          _selected = targetDate;
          _viewMonth = DateTime(targetDate.year, targetDate.month, 1);
        });
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4.5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSel
              ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard)
              : context.pillColor,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(100),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSel
                ? (isDark ? AppColors.neonLime : AppColors.darkCard)
                : context.borderColor,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 11,
            fontWeight: isSel ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
            color: isSel
                ? (isDark ? AppColors.ink : Colors.white)
                : context.mutedColor,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

```python
"""Sozlamalar. Barchasi muhit o'zgaruvchilaridan yoki .env faylidan olinadi."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

# .env fayli mavjud bo'lsa, avtomatik yuklash
env_file = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".env"
if env_file.exists():
    with open(env_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line and not line.startswith("#") and "=" in line:
                k, v = line.split("=", 1)
                os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip())



class Settings:
    _raw_db: str = os.getenv(
        "DATABASE_URL",
        "mysql+pymysql://root:password@localhost:3306/stone_erp?charset=utf8mb4",
    )
    if _raw_db.startswith("postgres://"):
        _raw_db = _raw_db.replace("postgres://", "postgresql+psycopg2://", 1)
    elif _raw_db.startswith("postgresql://") and "+psycopg2" not in _raw_db:
        _raw_db = _raw_db.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+psycopg2://", 1)
    elif _raw_db.startswith("mysql://"):
        _raw_db = _raw_db.replace("mysql://", "mysql+pymysql://", 1)

    # Aiven va boshqa bulutli MySQL uchun ssl-mode parametrini tozalash (PyMySQL connect_args orqali oladi)
    _raw_db = _raw_db.replace("?ssl-mode=REQUIRED", "").replace("&ssl-mode=REQUIRED", "")
    _raw_db = _raw_db.replace("?ssl-mode=required", "").replace("&ssl-mode=required", "")

    database_url: str = _raw_db
    secret_key: str = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY", "dev-only-change-me")
    token_minutes: int = int(os.getenv("TOKEN_MINUTES", "720"))
    admin_username: str = os.getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME", "admin")
    admin_password: str = os.getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD", "admin12345")
    cors_origins: list[str] = [
        o.strip() for o in os.getenv("CORS_ORIGINS", "*").split(",") if o.strip()
    ]


settings = Settings()
```

```python
import ssl

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, sessionmaker

from .config import settings

_connect_args: dict = {}
if settings.database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
    _connect_args["check_same_thread"] = False
elif "aivencloud.com" in settings.database_url or "ssl" in settings.database_url.lower():
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    _connect_args["ssl"] = ctx

engine = create_engine(settings.database_url, pool_pre_ping=True, connect_args=_connect_args)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


def ensure_migrations():
    """Jadvallarga yangi ustunlarni xavfsiz qo'shish."""
    from . import models  # Modellar metadatasini yuklash
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

    table_names = inspector.get_table_names()
    if "products" in table_names:
        columns = [c["name"] for c in inspector.get_columns("products")]
        with engine.begin() as conn:

                conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN has_sorts BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE"))
            if "sort" not in columns:

            if "price_sort2" not in columns:

            if "tile_length" not in columns:
                conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN tile_length DECIMAL(14, 3) NULL"))
            if "tile_width" not in columns:
                conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN tile_width DECIMAL(14, 3) NULL"))

                conn.execute(text("ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN box_pieces INTEGER NULL"))

    if "customers" in table_names:
        c_columns = [c["name"] for c in inspector.get_columns("customers")]

    if "users" in table_names:
```

## 📄 Fayl: `backend/app/deps.py`

```python
"""Autentifikatsiya va ruxsatlar. Rol HAR SAFAR bazadan olinadi — tokenga ishonilmaydi."""
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from .config import settings
from .database import get_db
from .models import User
from .security import decode_token

_bearer = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def get_current_user(
    creds: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None = Depends(_bearer),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    unauth = HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "Kirish talab qilinadi")
    if creds is None:
        raise unauth
    sub = decode_token(creds.credentials, settings.secret_key)
    if sub is None:
        raise unauth
    user = db.get(User, int(sub))
    if user is None or not user.is_active:
        raise unauth
    return user


def require_roles(*roles: str):
    def checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
        if user.role not in roles:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Bu amal uchun ruxsat yo'q")
        return user

    return checker
```

```python
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from .config import settings
from .database import Base, engine, ensure_migrations
from .routers import (
    attendance,
    auth,
    customers,
    deliveries,
    finance,
    notifications,
    production,
    products,
    sales,
    stock,
    users,
)

uploads_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "uploads"
uploads_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_: FastAPI):
    # Jadvallarni yaratish va yangi ustunlarni migratsiya qilish
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    try:
        ensure_migrations()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Migratsiya xabari: {e}")
    try:
        from .seed import main as seed_db
        seed_db()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Boshlang'ich seed xabari: {e}")
    yield


app = FastAPI(title="NTM ERP API", version="0.1.0", lifespan=lifespan)
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
                   allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"])

app.mount("/uploads", StaticFiles(directory=str(uploads_dir)), name="uploads")

for r in (auth, users, products, stock, customers, sales, production, finance, notifications, attendance, deliveries):
    app.include_router(r.router)
```

## 📄 Fayl: `backend/app/routers/attendance.py`

```python
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from .. import roles
from ..database import get_db
from ..deps import get_current_user, require_roles
from ..models import Attendance, User, Delivery
from ..schemas import (
    AttendanceBulkCheckIn,
    AttendanceCheckIn,
    AttendanceCheckOut,
    AttendanceOut,
    AttendanceRecordIn,
    SalaryReportItem,
)

router = APIRouter(prefix="/attendance", tags=["attendance"])


def _today_str() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _calc_hours(check_in: datetime | None, check_out: datetime | None) -> Decimal:
    if not check_in or not check_out:
        return Decimal(0)
    cin = check_in.replace(tzinfo=None) if check_in.tzinfo else check_in
    cout = check_out.replace(tzinfo=None) if check_out.tzinfo else check_out
    diff = (cout - cin).total_seconds()
    hours = max(0.0, diff / 3600.0)
    return Decimal(str(round(hours, 2)))


@router.get("", response_model=list[AttendanceOut])
def list_attendance(
    date: str | None = None,
    month: str | None = None,
    user_id: int | None = None,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    q = select(Attendance).order_by(Attendance.date.desc(), Attendance.id.desc())
    if date:
        q = q.where(Attendance.date == date)
    elif month:
        q = q.where(Attendance.date.startswith(month))

    if user_id:
        if user.role != roles.ADMIN and user.id != user_id:
            raise HTTPException(403, "Ruxsat berilmagan")
        q = q.where(Attendance.user_id == user_id)
    elif user.role != roles.ADMIN:
        q = q.where(Attendance.user_id == user.id)

    records = db.scalars(q).all()
    out = []
    for r in records:
        u_name = r.user.full_name if r.user else None
        out.append(
            AttendanceOut(
                id=r.id,
                user_id=r.user_id,
                user_name=u_name,
                date=r.date,
                check_in=r.check_in,
                check_out=r.check_out,
                worked_hours=r.worked_hours,
                status=r.status,
                note=r.note,
            )
        )
    return out


@router.post("/check-in", response_model=AttendanceOut)
def check_in(
    data: AttendanceCheckIn,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if current_user.role != roles.ADMIN and current_user.id != data.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Boshqa xodim nomidan kirish belgilab bo'lmaydi")

    u = db.get(User, data.user_id)
    if not u or not u.is_active:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Xodim topilmadi")

    date_str = data.date or _today_str()
    record = db.scalar(
        select(Attendance).where(
            Attendance.user_id == data.user_id, Attendance.date == date_str
        )
    )

    now = data.check_in or datetime.now()
    # 09:15 dan kech kelsa late deb belgilaymiz
    is_late = now.hour > 9 or (now.hour == 9 and now.minute > 15)

    if record:
        record.check_in = now
        if record.check_out:
            record.worked_hours = _calc_hours(now, record.check_out)
        if is_late:
            record.status = "late"
        if data.note:
            record.note = data.note
    else:
        record = Attendance(
            user_id=data.user_id,
            date=date_str,
            check_in=now,
            status="late" if is_late else "present",
            note=data.note,
        )
        db.add(record)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    return AttendanceOut(
        id=record.id,
        user_id=record.user_id,
        user_name=u.full_name,
        date=record.date,
        check_in=record.check_in,
        check_out=record.check_out,
        worked_hours=record.worked_hours,
        status=record.status,
        note=record.note,
    )


@router.post("/check-out", response_model=AttendanceOut)
def check_out(
    data: AttendanceCheckOut,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if current_user.role != roles.ADMIN and current_user.id != data.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Ruxsat berilmagan")

    u = db.get(User, data.user_id)
    if not u:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Xodim topilmadi")

    date_str = data.date or _today_str()
    record = db.scalar(
        select(Attendance).where(
            Attendance.user_id == data.user_id, Attendance.date == date_str
        )
    )

    now = data.check_out or datetime.now()
    if not record:
        record = Attendance(
            user_id=data.user_id,
            date=date_str,
            check_out=now,
            status="present",
            note=data.note,
        )
        db.add(record)
    else:
        record.check_out = now
        record.worked_hours = _calc_hours(record.check_in, now)
        if data.note:
            record.note = data.note

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(record)
    return AttendanceOut(
        id=record.id,
        user_id=record.user_id,
        user_name=u.full_name,
        date=record.date,
        check_in=record.check_in,
        check_out=record.check_out,
        worked_hours=record.worked_hours,
        status=record.status,
        note=record.note,
    )


@router.post("/bulk-check-in", response_model=list[AttendanceOut])
def bulk_check_in(
    data: AttendanceBulkCheckIn,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
):
    if current_user.role != roles.ADMIN:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Faqat admin barcha xodimlarni bir vaqtda keldi qila oladi")

    date_str = data.date or _today_str()
    now = data.check_in or datetime.now()
    if now.tzinfo:
        now = now.replace(tzinfo=None)
    is_late = now.hour > 9 or (now.hour == 9 and now.minute > 15)

    results = []
    for uid in data.user_ids:
        u = db.get(User, uid)
        if not u or not u.is_active:
            continue
        record = db.scalar(
            select(Attendance).where(
                Attendance.user_id == uid, Attendance.date == date_str
            )
        )
        if record:
            if not record.check_in:
                record.check_in = now
                record.status = "late" if is_late else "present"
            if record.check_out:
                record.worked_hours = _calc_hours(record.check_in, record.check_out)
        else:
            record = Attendance(
                user_id=uid,
                date=date_str,
                check_in=now,
                worked_hours=Decimal(0),
                status="late" if is_late else "present",
            )
            db.add(record)
        results.append((record, u.full_name))

    db.commit()
    out = []
    for rec, uname in results:
        db.refresh(rec)
        out.append(
            AttendanceOut(
                id=rec.id,
                user_id=rec.user_id,
                user_name=uname,
                date=rec.date,
                check_in=rec.check_in,
                check_out=rec.check_out,
                worked_hours=rec.worked_hours,
                status=rec.status,
                note=rec.note,
            )
        )
    return out


@router.post("/record", response_model=AttendanceOut)
def record_attendance(
    data: AttendanceRecordIn,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_roles(roles.ADMIN)),
):
    u = db.get(User, data.user_id)
    if not u:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Xodim topilmadi")

    if data.id:
        rec = db.get(Attendance, data.id)
        if not rec:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Davomat yozuvi topilmadi")
    else:
        rec = db.scalar(
            select(Attendance).where(
                Attendance.user_id == data.user_id, Attendance.date == data.date
            )
        )
        if not rec:
            rec = Attendance(user_id=data.user_id, date=data.date)
            db.add(rec)

    rec.check_in = data.check_in
    rec.check_out = data.check_out
    rec.status = data.status
    rec.note = data.note
    if data.worked_hours > 0:
        rec.worked_hours = data.worked_hours
    elif data.check_in and data.check_out:
        rec.worked_hours = _calc_hours(data.check_in, data.check_out)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(rec)
    return AttendanceOut(
        id=rec.id,
        user_id=rec.user_id,
        user_name=u.full_name,
        date=rec.date,
        check_in=rec.check_in,
        check_out=rec.check_out,
        worked_hours=rec.worked_hours,
        status=rec.status,
        note=rec.note,
    )


@router.get("/salary-report", response_model=list[SalaryReportItem])
def get_salary_report(
    month: str = Query(..., description="YYYY-MM formati"),
    total_working_days: int = Query(26, ge=1, le=31),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_roles(roles.ADMIN)),
):
    users = db.scalars(select(User).where(User.is_active == True).order_by(User.id)).all()
    attendances = db.scalars(
        select(Attendance).where(Attendance.date.startswith(month))
    ).all()

    user_att: dict[int, list[Attendance]] = {}
    for a in attendances:
        user_att.setdefault(a.user_id, []).append(a)

    report: list[SalaryReportItem] = []
    for u in users:
        atts = user_att.get(u.id, [])
        worked_atts = [a for a in atts if a.status != "absent"]
        days_worked = len(worked_atts)
        hours_worked = sum((a.worked_hours for a in worked_atts), Decimal(0))
        days_late = sum(1 for a in atts if a.status == "late")

        base_sal = u.salary or Decimal(0)
        sal_type = u.salary_type or "monthly"

        # Davomat bo'yicha hisoblash
        if sal_type == "trip" or u.role == roles.DRIVER:
            completed_deliveries = db.scalars(
                select(Delivery).where(
                    Delivery.status == "delivered",
                    Delivery.driver_name.ilike(f"%{u.full_name}%"),
                )
            ).all()
            month_deliveries = [
                d for d in completed_deliveries
                if (d.delivered_time and d.delivered_time.strftime("%Y-%m") == month)
                or (not d.delivered_time and d.created_at and d.created_at.strftime("%Y-%m") == month)
            ]
            if base_sal > 0:
                calc_sal = base_sal * Decimal(len(month_deliveries))
            else:
                calc_sal = sum((d.delivery_fee or Decimal(0) for d in month_deliveries), Decimal(0))
            days_worked = len(month_deliveries) if month_deliveries else days_worked
            deduction = Decimal(0)
            net = calc_sal
        elif sal_type == "daily":
            calc_sal = base_sal * Decimal(days_worked)
            day_rate = base_sal
            deduction = Decimal(str(round(float(day_rate * Decimal(0.1) * Decimal(days_late)), 2)))
            net = max(Decimal(0), calc_sal - deduction)
        elif sal_type == "hourly":
            calc_sal = base_sal * hours_worked
            day_rate = base_sal * Decimal(8)
            deduction = Decimal(str(round(float(day_rate * Decimal(0.1) * Decimal(days_late)), 2)))
            net = max(Decimal(0), calc_sal - deduction)
        else:  # monthly
            per_day = base_sal / Decimal(total_working_days) if total_working_days else Decimal(0)
            calc_sal = Decimal(str(round(float(per_day * Decimal(days_worked)), 2)))
            day_rate = (base_sal / Decimal(total_working_days)) if total_working_days else Decimal(0)
            deduction = Decimal(str(round(float(day_rate * Decimal(0.1) * Decimal(days_late)), 2)))
            net = max(Decimal(0), calc_sal - deduction)

        report.append(
            SalaryReportItem(
                user_id=u.id,
                full_name=u.full_name,
                role=u.role,
                base_salary=base_sal,
                salary_type=sal_type,
                days_worked=days_worked,
                hours_worked=hours_worked,
                days_late=days_late,
                calculated_salary=calc_sal,
                bonus=Decimal(0),
                deduction=deduction,
                net_salary=net,
                is_paid=False,
            )
        )

    return report
```

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ..config import settings
from ..database import get_db

from ..models import User

router = APIRouter(prefix="/auth", tags=["auth"])


@router.post("/login", response_model=LoginOut)
def login(data: LoginIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.username == data.username.strip()))
    if user is None or not user.is_active or not getattr(user, 'can_login', True) or not verify_password(data.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(401, "Login yoki parol noto'g'ri")
    # Ekranda rol tanlash hech narsani bermaydi: haqiqiy rol bazadan tekshiriladi.
    if data.role and data.role != user.role:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Bu akkaunt tanlangan rol uchun emas")
    token = create_token(str(user.id), settings.secret_key, settings.token_minutes)
    return LoginOut(access_token=token, user=UserOut.model_validate(user))


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserOut)
def me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return user
```

```python
            delivery.dispatch_time = datetime.utcnow()
        elif data.status == "delivered" and not delivery.delivered_time:
            delivery.delivered_time = datetime.utcnow()

    if data.dispatch_time is not None:
        delivery.dispatch_time = data.dispatch_time
    if data.delivered_time is not None:
        delivery.delivered_time = data.delivered_time

    if data.items is not None:
        # replace items
        delivery.items.clear()
        for item in data.items:
            d_item = m.DeliveryItem(
                delivery_id=delivery.id,
                product_id=item.product_id,
                product_name=item.product_name.strip(),

    if delivery.driver_id and delivery.driver_id != current_user.id:

    )
    delivery = db.scalars(stmt).first()
    if delivery is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Yetkazib berish yozuvi topilmadi")

    delivery.driver_id = None
    delivery.driver_name = "Ochiq (barchaga)"
    delivery.driver_phone = None
    delivery.status = "loading"
    rejection_tag = f"[{current_user.full_name} rad etdi]"
    if delivery.note:
        if rejection_tag not in delivery.note:
            delivery.note = f"{delivery.note} | {rejection_tag}"
    else:
        delivery.note = rejection_tag

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(delivery)
    return delivery
```
